blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Since the rise of supervised deep learning modelet dets, researchers has attempt to solve infrared small targection using various models like conventional neural networks, GANS, Transformers, Mixture of Experts and recent graph/hypergraph neural networks. Moreover, these deep neural networks methods surpassed the traditional unsupervised models and the low-rank and sparse decomposition unsupervised models reviewed in "Traditional and Recent Approaches for Infrared Small Target Detection : Overview, Challenges and Perspectives (Part 1). In this context, the aim of this paper is to provide a complete survey of the deep learning models in infrared small target detection. First, we categorize the different approaches found in the literature in terms of the modeling models of strategies. Then, we have discussed them in terms of the critical situations that they claim to handle. Furthermore, we present the specific performance evaluation. Then, we conclude with several promising directions for future research.
blocks.zh: 自被监管的深层学习模型德特兴起后,研究人员一直尝试利用常规神经网络,GANS,变形器,专家混合和最近的图/通谱神经网络等多种模型来解决红外小凝固. 此外,这些深层神经网络方法超越了传统的无监督模型以及"红外小目标探测的传统和近期方法:概览、挑战和视角"(第一部分)所审查的低等和稀有分解的无监督模型。 在这方面,本文的目的是提供红外小目标探测中深层学习模型的完整调查. 首先,我们从战略模型的模型方面对文献中发现的不同方法进行分类。 然后,我们讨论了他们声称处理的危急局势。 此外,我们提出了具体的绩效评估。 然后,我们最后为今后的研究提出几个有希望的方向。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Infrared small target detection is a crucial task in military and civilian fields and deep neural networks supervised methods are suitable for this field. Indeed, model-based methods require the manual design of complex regularization constraints to extract prior features from infrared images. But real scenes present complex with dramatic changes target size, shape, and clutter background and it is difficult to use handcrafted features and fixed hyper-parameters to handle such variations. In contrast, data-based methods can automatically learn feature representations through training without the need for hand-crafted constraints. Note that the reader can refer to the introduction of the paper titled "Unsupervised and Supervised Approaches for Infrared Small Target Detection : Overview, Challenges and Perspectives (Part 1)" to have more details about the context of IRSTD. significant success. However, these recent supervised methods are based on various deep neural network methods and they can be either single-frame or multi-frame according to the employed architecture. Thus, we present the different DNNs models to highlight the main new advances in their applications in IRSTD: 1. Conventional Neural Networks : Convolutional Neural Networks are the most employed both in for the detection and the segmentation methods. In this context, we have categorize the various architectures, employed loss functions, attention and guidance mechanisms developed in literature to highlight the main trends. We follow the same scheme for wavelets based methods, Mamba-based state space model, transformers-based neural networks, adversarial networks and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE). 2. Language Models that are applied for IRSTD since 2026 with Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision-Language Models (VFMs). These methods allow to employ textual information with image modalities but also required specific datasets. 3. Graph/Hypergraph Learning Methods: GNNS are deep learning methods that use graph data as input. Graph Neural Networks is divided into two branches: Spectral-based GNNs where graph spectral theory was applied to learn node representations, and spatial-based GNNs based on local-dependence assumption of graph structured data that graph convolution is defined in the spatial domain as aggregating and transforming local information. Thus, spectral-based Spatial-based GNNs describe the pairwise relations between objects. Transductive and inductive learning schemes are possible ( 1 ) . The rest of this paper is organized as follows: Fist, Section 2 presents an overview for novices about key features of deep neural neural networks such as architectures, optimization schemes, the notion of loss-function and the training. Section 4 reviews the convolutional neural networks methods employed in IRSTD. Section 5 survey Wavelet based methods. Section 6 and Section 7 review Mamba-based State Space Models and Transformers based methods, respectively. Then, we focus on recent applications of learning models based on large languages models in Section 10 and graph neural networks in Section 11 . In Section 12 , we present specific performance evaluation for deep learning based methods. Finally, we provide a conclusion and perspectives for future research.

blocks.en: 2 Preliminaries
blocks.zh: 2 初步情况

blocks.en: With the progress of GPU and the storage of Big Data, deep neural networks gains attention in the area of 2000’s with new deep learning concepts such as Deep Belief Networks in 2006 and Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) in 2014. Liu et al. classified the deep neural network architectures in the following categories: restricted Boltzmann machines (RBMs), deep belief networks (DBNs), autoencoders(AEs) network and deep Convolutional Neural Network (CNNs). More recently, more efficient architectures have been developed for language and vision tasks such as Large Language Models (LLMs), Vision Language Models (VLMs), Fundation Models, Mamba and Transformers. Morover, graph represention have been also introduced into deep neural networks providing Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs) and Graph Neural Networks (GNNs).
blocks.zh: 随着GPU的进步和Big Data的存储,深层神经网络随着2006年的深层信仰网络和2014年的Generative Aversarial Networks(GANs)等新的深度学习概念在2000年代领域获得了关注. 刘等. 深层神经网络架构分为以下几类:受限的波尔茨曼机(RBM),深层信仰网络(DBN),自动编码器(AE)网络和深层革命神经网络(CNN). 最近,为大语言模型(LLM),远景语言模型(VLM),基金模型(Fundation Models),曼巴(Mamba)和变形器等语言和视觉任务开发了更有效的架构. Morover,图代表也引入了提供Graph Curvolution Network(GCN)和Graph神经网络(GNN)的深神经网络.

blocks.en: Thus, Deep Neural Networks are characterized by their architecture that is more and more sophisticated over time. An architecture comprises different layers categorized into input layer, hidden layer and output layer. Each layers contains a number of neurons that are activated or not following an activation function. This activation function can be considered as the mapping of the input to the output via a nonlinear transform function at each node. In literature, different activation functions can be found such as the sigmoid function ( 2 ) , Rectified Linear Unit (ReLU) ( 3 ) , and Probabilistic ReLU (PReLU) ( 3 ) . Once the architecture is determined and the activation function is chosen, the DNN need to be trained using a large-scale dataset. To this end, the architecture is exposed to the training dataset to learn the weights of each neurons in each layer. The parameters are learned via a cost function that are minimized with a loss function on the desired output and the predicted one. The most common method for training is the back-propagation. Commonly, the gradient of the error function computed on the correct output and the predicted one is propagated back to the beginning of the network in order to update its parameters. For this, it requires a gradient descent algorithm. Batch normalization which normalizes mini-batches can also be employed to accelerate learning because it uses higher learning rates, and also regularizes the learning. For vocabulary, an epoch is a complete pass through a given dataset, and thus is the number of time where the neural network has been exposed to every record of the dataset once. An epoch is not an iteration which corresponds to one update of the neural net models parameters. Many iterations can occur before an epoch is over. Epoch and iteration are only identical if the parameters are updated once for each pass through the whole dataset.
blocks.zh: 因此,深神经 网络的特点是其结构随着时间推移越来越复杂。 一个架构包含不同的层,分为输入层,隐藏层和输出层. 每个层都包含一些被激活或不遵循激活功能的神经元. 这个激活函数可以被认为是通过每个节点的非线性变换函数对输出的输入进行映射. 在文献中,可以找到不同的激活函数,如sigmoid函数(2),Recorized Linear Unit(ReLU)(3),以及Probabilistic ReLU(PRELU)(3). 一旦确定了架构并选择了激活功能,DNN就需要使用大型数据集来训练. 为此,该架构暴露在训练数据集中,以学习每层每个神经元的权重. 参数是通过成本函数学习的,成本函数最小化,损失函数为预期产出和预测产出。 最常用的训练方法是反向传播. 通常情况下,根据正确的输出计算出错误函数的梯度和预测的梯度会传播到网络的开始,以便更新其参数. 为此,它需要一个梯度下降算法. 还可以利用使小枪炮正常化的批量正常化来加速学习,因为它使用较高的学习率,同时也使学习正规化。 对于词汇,一个时代是完全通过一个给定的数据集,因此是神经网络曾一次接触到数据集的每一个记录的时间数. 一个时代并不是一个重复,它与神经网模型参数的一个更新相对应。 在一个时代结束前,许多迭代可能发生. Epoch 和迭代只有在每个参数经过整个数据集一次更新时才相同.

blocks.en:
In summary, the key characteristics of the deep neural networks are
the following ones: 1. Architecture: The number,the size and the type of the layers are key characteristics of an architecture as well as the classes of functions that can be approximated by a feed-forward neural network. The key issue is how the selected architecture impact expressiveness. 2. Optimization: It concerns the way to train the DNNs. This issue contains two aspects which are the datasets used for the training, and mostly the algorithm to optimize the network. 3. Loss Functions: Most the time, a conventional loss function is employed such as the l 2 l_{2} loss function but several loss functions have been developed to be more adapted to the target applications. 4. Training: The dataset should be sufficiently large to learn all the kinds of scenes to avoid discrepancy in the performance when unseen scenes appear. Data augmentation can be used to solve this problem. In addition, several attention and guidance mechanisms can be added according to the target application to improve the capture of diverse characteristics. Deep neural networks may also present a multi-branch structure. Modules can also be plug and play modules that can be employed in existing methods to improve their performance.
blocks.zh:
总之,深层神经网络的关键特征是:
以下各点: 1. 结构: 层的数量,大小和类型是架构的关键特征,以及可以被馈送神经网络所近似的功能类别. 关键问题是选定架构如何影响表达性。 2. 优化: 这关系到训练DNN的方式. 这个问题包含两个方面,即用于培训的数据集,以及大多数优化网络的算法。 3. 函数损失: 多数时候,采用传统的损失函数,如l2 l_{2}损失函数,但开发了几种损失函数,以便更适应目标应用。 4. 培训: 数据集应当足够大,可以学习各种场景,避免在出现不见场景时表现的差异. 数据增强可以用来解决这个问题. 此外,还可以根据目标应用增加几个关注和指导机制,以改善对不同特征的捕捉. 深神经网络也可能呈现多分支结构. 模块也可以是插件和播放模块,在现有方法中可以使用这些模块来改进其性能.

blocks.en: 3 Application of Deep Neural Networks in Infrared Small Target Detection
blocks.zh: 3 深神经网络在红外小目标探测中的应用

blocks.en: The adequacy of deep neural networks with the infrared small target detection relies on its specific constraints. For example, these constraints are not present in the original detection methods such as YOLO based ones, DETER based ones and SAM based ones. These constraints concern robustness to noise (i.e heteroscedastic noise ( 4 ) ), the spatial and temporal constraints, the need of real-time implementations, and the ability to deal with the challenges met in infrared imaging sequences. In practice, researchers have proposed dedicated methods which attempt to take into account these specific constraints by acting on its key characteristics (Architectures, loss functions, attention and guidance mechanisms, etc.). In infrared small target detection, the following dedicated adaptations have been developed in the literature.
blocks.zh: 具有红外小目标探测的深神经网络的充足性取决于其具体制约因素. 例如,这些限制在最初的检测方法中并不存在,如基于YOLO的方法、基于DETER的方法和基于SAM的方法。 这些限制涉及噪音的强性(即异形噪音(4)),空间和时间的限制,实时执行的需要,以及应对红外成像序列中遇到的挑战的能力。 在实践中,研究人员提出了专门的方法,试图根据其主要特征(建筑、损失功能、注意力和指导机制等)考虑这些具体制约因素。 在红外小目标探测中,文献中开发了以下专用改编.

blocks.en: 3.1 Conceptual Neural Networks
blocks.zh: 3.1 概念神经网络

blocks.en:
About kinds of deep neural networks, convolutional neural networks can extract local features of infrared small targets but they have shortcomings in capturing long-distance global features between the target and its background. CNNs expand the semantic receptive field through stacked convolutional layers to extract features, but they face difficulties to capture global context and low level detail features—both crucial for small target detection ( 5 ) . In summary, CNNs have the following limitations for infrared small target detection as indicated in the work of Li et al. ( 6 ) : 1. Target Loss Risk: CNNs typically employ successive downsampling operations. For small infrared targets occupying only a handful of pixels, this process easily cause target features to degrade or entirely disappear in deeper network layers. 2. Lack of Long Range Dependencies: The restricted receptive fields related to standard convolutions prevent the model from capturing global spatial relationships across the broader image context. This means the network faces difficulties to distinguish true targets from background noise with similar shapes unless it can reference global contextual information. To address these limitations, some researchers employ variants of CNNs such as Pinwheel Convolution Network (PCNs) ( 7 ; 8 ) and Chinese Knot Convolutional Network (CKCNs ) ( 9 ) or vision transformers to model global dependencies. Indeed, transformer-based methods can distinguish true targets from similar background noise by analyzing the background continuity across the entire image. The vision transformer (ViT) model can capture long-distance dependent and global features ( 10 ) . Even if transformers excel at capturing long range context through self-attention mechanisms, they still have the following limitations as indicated in the work of Li et al. ( 6 ) : 1. Low Pass Filtering Effect: Self-attention inherently generates a low-pass filtering effect, tending to smooth feature maps. However, infrared small targets typically manifest as high frequency pulse signals and are easily suppressed as noise by the global smoothing mechanism. 2. High Computational Complexity: The computational complexity of transformers increases quadratically with image resolution. This causes a significant burden for small object detection tasks requiring high resolution feature retention. Thus, Transformer-based structures are insufficient in local feature extraction and are computationally expensive ( 11 ) with quadratic computational complexity. The reader can find in the work of Choi et al. ( 12 ) a comparative performance of CNN and Transformer in infrared small target detection. Nevertheless, Swin Transformers ( 13 ; 14 ; 15 ) appear to be more suitable for infrared small target detection. In this context, several researchers ( 10 ; 16 ; 17 ; 18 ; 19 ; 20 ; 21 ; 22 ; 23 ) provide combination of CNNs and ViT to compensate the shortcomings of CNNs in modeling long-distance global features. Nevertheless, these methods still have the following issues ( 5 ) : 1. Detail vs. Noise Balance: To address background noise and
expand semantic range in infrared images, continuous down-sampling
is often used. But this process can lead to significant
loss of target details due to their small and faint nature. 2. Complexity vs. Locality Balance: The self-attention mechanism in ViTs requires quadratic complexity leading to low computational efficiency. However, different variations of the Mamba such as the integration of the 2D-Selective-Scan (SS2D) technique, appears as an alternative to CNN– and Transformer-based methods ( 11 ) . Several researchers also employ Kolmogorov–Arnold Networks (KAN) ( 24 ; 25 ; 26 ; 27 ; 28 ) because it explicitly models nonlinear mapping curves. This flexible function modeling mechanism is well suited to the localized and nonlinear saliency patterns of infrared small targets. Finally, several research works on the feature domain ( 29 ; 30 ; 31 ) .
blocks.zh:
关于各种深层神经网络,进化神经网络可以提取红外小目标的地方特征,但它们在捕捉目标与其背景之间的长距离全球特征方面有缺陷. CNN通过堆叠的演化层来扩展语义接受域以提取特征,但它们在捕捉全球背景和低级细节特征方面面临困难——这两者对于小目标探测(5)都是至关重要的. 简而言之,有线电视新闻网对红外小目标探测有如下限制,如李等人的工作所示. (6) : 1. 目标损失风险:有线电视新闻网通常采用连续的下取样操作。 对于只占用少数像素的小型红外目标,这一过程很容易使目标特征在更深的网络层中降解或完全消失. 2. 缺乏长距离依赖: 与标准演化有关的有限可接受领域使模型无法在更广泛的图像背景下捕捉全球空间关系。 这意味着网络在区分真实目标与类似形状的背景噪声方面面临困难,除非它能够参考全球背景信息. 为解决这些限制,一些研究者使用CNN的变体,如Pinwheel Convolution Network(PCNs)(7;8)和Chinese Knot Convolution Network(CKCNs)(9)或视觉变体来模拟全球的依赖性. 事实上,基于变压器的方法可以通过分析整个图像的背景连续性来区分真实目标与类似的背景噪声. 视变器(ViT)模型可以捕捉长途依赖和全球特征(10 ). 即使变压器通过自觉机制出色地捕捉长距离环境,它们仍然有李等人的著作中所指出的以下局限性. (6) : 1.低通滤波效应:自觉内在产生低通滤波效应,倾向于平滑特征图. 然而,红外小目标一般表现为高频脉冲信号,很容易被全球平滑机制压制为噪声. 2. 高计算法 复杂性 : 变压器的计算复杂性随着图像分辨率的四倍增加. 这对需要高分辨率特性保留的小物体探测任务造成了沉重的负担. 因此,基于变形器的结构在本地特征提取中是不够的,在计算上成本很高(11),具有四极计算的复杂性. 读者可以在Choi等人(12 )的作品中找到CNN和变形器在红外小目标探测中的比较性能. 尽管如此,Swin变形器(13;14;15)似乎更适合红外小目标探测. 在这方面,几位研究人员(10;16;17;18;19;20;21;22;23)提供CNN和VIT的组合,以弥补CNN在模拟长途全球特辑方面的缺点. 尽管如此,这些方法仍有下列问题(5): 1. 详细情况与噪音平衡: 处理背景噪音和
在红外图像中扩展语义范围, 持续下取样
经常被使用。 但是,这一进程可能导致重大
由于其小而微弱的性质,失去了目标细节. 2. 复杂性与局部性 余额 : ViTs中的自我关注机制需要四维复杂性,导致计算效率低. 然而,曼巴的不同变体,如2D-Selective-Scan(SS2D)技术的集成,作为CNN(CNN)和变形器方法(11)的替代品出现. 一些研究者还采用了Kolmogorov–Arnold Networks(KAN)(24;25;26;27;28),因为它明确地模拟了非线性绘图曲线. 这种灵活的功能建模机制非常适合红外小目标的局部和非线性显著性模式. 最后,一些关于特征域的研究(29;30;31).

blocks.en: Target Loss Risk: CNNs typically employ successive downsampling operations. For small infrared targets occupying only a handful of pixels, this process easily cause target features to degrade or entirely disappear in deeper network layers.
blocks.zh: 目标损失风险:CNN一般采用连续的下取样操作. 对于只占用少数像素的小型红外目标,这一过程很容易使目标特征在更深的网络层中降解或完全消失.

blocks.en: Lack of Long Range Dependencies: The restricted receptive fields related to standard convolutions prevent the model from capturing global spatial relationships across the broader image context. This means the network faces difficulties to distinguish true targets from background noise with similar shapes unless it can reference global contextual information.
blocks.zh: 缺乏长距离 依赖性 : 与标准演化有关的有限可接受领域使模型无法在更广泛的图像背景下捕捉全球空间关系。 这意味着网络在区分真实目标与类似形状的背景噪声方面面临困难,除非它能够参考全球背景信息.

blocks.en: Low Pass Filtering Effect: Self-attention inherently generates a low-pass filtering effect, tending to smooth feature maps. However, infrared small targets typically manifest as high frequency pulse signals and are easily suppressed as noise by the global smoothing mechanism.
blocks.zh: 低传滤波效应:自觉内在产生低传滤波效应,倾向于平滑特征图. 然而,红外小目标一般表现为高频脉冲信号,很容易被全球平滑机制压制为噪声.

blocks.en: High Computational Complexity: The computational complexity of transformers increases quadratically with image resolution. This causes a significant burden for small object detection tasks requiring high resolution feature retention.
blocks.zh: 高计算 复杂性 : 变压器的计算复杂性随着图像分辨率的四倍增加. 这对需要高分辨率特性保留的小物体探测任务造成了沉重的负担.

blocks.en:
Detail vs. Noise Balance: To address background noise and
expand semantic range in infrared images, continuous down-sampling
is often used. But this process can lead to significant
loss of target details due to their small and faint nature.
blocks.zh:
细节 v. 噪音余额 : 处理背景噪音和
在红外图像中扩展语义范围, 持续下取样
经常被使用。 但是,这一进程可能导致重大
由于其小而微弱的性质,失去了目标细节.

blocks.en: Complexity vs. Locality Balance: The self-attention mechanism in ViTs requires quadratic complexity leading to low computational efficiency.
blocks.zh: 复杂性与本地性 余额 : ViTs中的自我关注机制需要四维复杂性,导致计算效率低.

blocks.en: 3.2 Architectures
blocks.zh: 3.2 建筑

blocks.en: Several deep neural architectures have been developed for image tasks such as AlexNet ( 32 ) for image classification, VGG-Net ( 33 ) for large-scale image recognition, U-Net ( 34 ) for image segmentation, GoogLeNet ( 35 ) for computer vision, and Microsoft Residual Network (ResNet) ( 36 ) for image recognition. Nevertheless, none of these architectures have been designed for infrared imaging. Nevertheless, several architectures have been used infrared small target detection namely U-Net ( 37 ; 38 ; 39 ; 40 ) , Siamese U-Net ( 41 ) , ifUNet++ ( 42 ) , U2-Net ( 43 ) , U-shaped ( 44 ; 45 ; 46 ; 47 ; 48 ) , Deformable Convolutional UNet ( 49 ) , ResNet ( 50 ; 51 ) and Res2Net ( 52 ) .
blocks.zh: 已经为图像任务开发了若干深层神经架构,如AlexNet(32)用于图像分类,VGG-Net(33)用于大规模图像识别,U-Net(34)用于图像分割,GoogleNet(35)用于计算机视觉,微软剩余网络(ResNet)(36)用于图像识别. 尽管如此,这些建筑都没有为红外成像设计. 尽管如此,还是使用了多个红外小目标探测器,即U-Net(37;38;39;40),暹罗U-Net(41),如果UNet++(42),U2-Net(43),U-形状(44;45;46;47;48),变形变形UNet(49),ResNet(50;51)和Res2Net(52).

blocks.en:
Even if U-shaped architectures have enhanced baseline performance, existing methods still suffer from two limitations: insufficient spatial perception for tiny targets leads to target location loss and edge degradation and semantic ambiguity in deep feature reconstruction. To address these limitations, several researchers ( 53 ; 38 ; 54 ; 55 ; 56 ; 57 ; 58 ) have developed dense nested attention architecture. For example, Figure 1 shows three U-shape structures and a multi-scale nested interaction module. The basic U-shaped structure consists of an encoder, a decoder, and plain skip connections. The encoder allows to expand the receptive area and extract useful information. The decoder helps to recover features to the same size as the input. The plain skip connection acts as a bridge to transfer these low-level and high-level features from the encoder to the decoder sub-networks. Nested and dense structures are represented for UNet++ ( 59 ) , DNA-Net ( 53 ) and iSmallNet ( 58 ) . Due to the optimal receptive domains of targets with sizes varying greatly, the U-shaped sub-networks with different depths are suitable for targets of different sizes. Indeed, each node can receive the characteristics of its own layer and adjacent layers resulting in repeated multi-layer feature fusion. Thus, the representation
of small targets is kept in deep layers so that better results can be reached.
blocks.zh:
即使U形建筑提高了基线性能,但现有方法仍然受到两个限制:小目标空间感知不足导致目标位置丢失和边缘退化,以及深度特征重建中的语义模糊. 为了克服这些局限性,一些研究人员(53;38;54;55;56;57;58)发展了密集的巢状关注结构。 例如,图1显示了三个U形结构和一个多尺度的嵌套互动模块. 基本的U形结构包括一个编码器,一个解码器,以及普通跳过连接. 编码器允许扩展可接受区域并提取有用的信息. 解码器有助于恢复与输入大小相同的特性. plain跳过连接起到桥梁的作用,将这些低阶和高阶的特性从编码器转移到解码子网络上. 对UNet++(59),DNA-Net(53)和iSmallNet(58)来说,内嵌和密集的结构都有代表。 由于大小差异很大的目标最理想的可接受域,深度不同的U形子网络适合不同大小的目标. 事实上,每个节点都能获得自身地层和相邻地层的特征,从而导致重复的多层特征聚变. 因此,代表权
将小目标放在深层,以便取得更好的结果。

blocks.en: 3.3 Learning/Training
blocks.zh: 3.3 学习/培训

blocks.en: Deep neural networks needs to be trained on datasets requiring large amounts of costly and impractical annotated data. In addition, deep learning methods rely on supervised learning. To address these deployable limitations, deep neural networks models for infrared small target detection attract investigation of few-shot learning mechanisms ( 60 ) , and zero-annotation strategies ( 61 ) . In the case of small scale datasets, data augmentation strategies have been developed using Random-Cloning models ( 62 ) , Random-Erasing models ( 63 ) , prior-guided models ( 64 ) , thermodynamics-Inspired models ( 65 ) , GANs ( 66 ; 66 ; 67 ) , diffusion models ( 68 ; 69 ) and hybrid models ( 70 ) . However, even if the training is achieved on large-scale datasets, the performance of deep neural networks methods decrease in presence of unseen scenes requiring generalization investigation ( 71 ) .
blocks.zh: 深层神经网络需要接受数据集培训,需要大量成本高昂且不切实际的附加说明的数据. 此外,深层学习方法依赖监督学习. 为解决这些可部署的局限性,红外小目标探测的深度神经网络模型吸引了对几发学习机制(60)和零通知策略(61)的调查. 以小型数据集为例,采用随机克隆模型(62),随机提取模型(63),前导模型(64),热力学启发模型(65),GANs(66;66;67),扩散模型(68;69)和混合模型(70)制定数据增强策略. 然而,即使大规模数据集的培训得以实现,深层神经网络方法的性能在出现需要泛化调查的不见的场景时也会下降(71).

blocks.en: 3.4 Loss Functions
blocks.zh: 3.4 函数损失

blocks.en:
For infrared small target detection, the most common loss function is the Soft-IoU loss function. Nevertheless, the Soft-IoU loss does not consider the difference in importance among individual pixels. It assigns the same weight to all pixels, which may lead to insufficient attention to critical parts of the target (such as the centroid) during training. Thus, it impacts the prediction accuracy of the central region of the target. Several researchers have developed dedicated loss functions to overcome this limitation. The three main alternatives are the weighted Mean Squared Error (MSE) ( 72 ) loss function, the Binary Cross-Entropy (BCE) loss, and the Dice loss function, defined respectively as: 1. Weighted Mean Squared Error (MSE) ( 72 ) : Penalizes prediction errors with spatial weights that emphasize target pixels: ℒ MSE = 1 H ​ W ​ ∑ i , j w i ​ j ​ ( p i ​ j − g i ​ j ) 2 , \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{MSE}}=\frac{1}{HW}\sum_{i,j}w_{ij}(p_{ij}-g_{ij})^{2}, (1) where H H and W W are the image height and width, p i ​ j ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] p_{ij}\in[0,1] is the predicted probability, g i ​ j ∈ { 0 , 1 } g_{ij}\in\{0,1\} the ground-truth mask at pixel ( i , j ) (i,j) , and w i ​ j ≥ 0 w_{ij}\geq 0 a spatial weight map emphasizing target pixels. 2. Binary Cross-Entropy (BCE) ( 73 ) : Measures pixel-wise classification error: ℒ BCE = − 1 H ​ W ∑ i , j [ g i ​ j log p i ​ j + ( 1 − g i ​ j ) log ( 1 − p i ​ j ) ] , \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{BCE}}=-\frac{1}{HW}\sum_{i,j}\bigl[g_{ij}\log p_{ij}+(1-g_{ij})\log(1-p_{ij})\bigr], (2) where H H , W W , p i ​ j p_{ij} , and g i ​ j g_{ij} are defined above. 3. More elaborated loss functions have been recently developed such as the following ones: complete IoU (CIoU) loss function ( 74 ) , adaptive loss function ( 75 ) , fuzzy perceptual loss function ( 76 ) , multi-task weighted hybrid loss function ( 77 ) , multi-stage loss function ( 78 ) , multilevel cross-entropy loss function ( 79 ) , weighted-sigmoid-cross-entropy loss function ( 80 ) , mask-weighted heatmap loss ( 81 ) , DpT-k loss function ( 82 ) , boundary difference loss function ( 83 ) ), scale-based dynamic loss ( 7 ) , self-learning joint loss function ( 84 ) , self-supervised loss ( 4 ) , Physics-Constrained Loss (PCL) function ( 85 ) , Focal Loss function ( 86 ) , Adaptive Threshold Focal Loss (ATFL) function ( 87 ) , InfoNCE loss function ( 88 ) , Temperature Aware InfoNCE loss function (TAC) ( 89 ) , Boundary-aware Contrastive (BC) loss function ( 90 ) , basket-based hierarchical temporal consistency loss function ( 91 ) , Scale and Location Sensitive (SLS) loss function ( 40 ) , SCR-Guided Loss Reweighting function ( 92 ) , Smooth Wasserstein Loss (SWL) function ( 93 ) , Distribution-aware Pixel-wise Wasserstein Loss (DPWL) ( 94 ) , Structure–Confidence Hybrid (SCH) loss function ( 95 ) , SSQM loss function ( 96 ) and Hyperbolic Loss Function (HLF) ( 97 ) to be exhaustive as possible. The most elaborated loss function is the task-driven joint loss function ( 98 ) which combines intensity loss, Haar wavelet mask loss, and background residual loss.

blocks.en: 3.5 Attention and Guidance Mechanism
blocks.zh: 3.5 关注和指导机制

blocks.en: Several attention and guidance mechanisms are added to improve the capture of the various characteristics such as the local/global features, the semantic information, the motion information and the saliency information to cite a view. Most of the IRST methods based deep learning consist of three specific modules either in detection based methods ( 99 ) and segmentation based methods ( 46 ; 100 ; 101 ; 102 ; 103 ; 104 ; 103 ; 105 ) . Ablation studies enable to assess the role and the importance of each module about the challenges they aim to handle.
blocks.zh: 增加了一些关注和指导机制,以改进对各种特征的捕捉,如地方/全球特征、语义信息、运动信息和引申观点的显著信息。 大多数基于IRST的深层学习方法包括三个具体的模块,要么是检测方法(99),要么是分解方法(46;100;101;102;103;104;103;105)。 分析研究能够评估每个单元的作用和重要性,了解它们打算应对的挑战。

blocks.en: However, several IRST methods based deep learning propose plug and play modules (RRCA-Net ( 82 ) , SDG-ResNet ( 106 ) , LLCEFA ( 107 ) , DGGENet ( 108 ) ) that can be employed to consistent performance improvement in existing IRSTD methods. Plug and play modules are often available to provide a different learning mechanisms (PAL ( 109 ) , LESPS ( 110 ) , LSP ( 111 ) , DtoD ( 112 ) , TGPL ( 113 ) ).
blocks.zh: 然而,基于深层学习的几种IRST方法提出了插座和播放模块(RRCA-Net(82),SDG-ResNet(106),LLCEFA(107),DGGENet(108)),这些模块可用于在现有IRSTD方法中持续提高性能. 经常可以提供不同的学习机制(PAL(109),LESP(110),LSP(111),DtoD(112),TGPL(113))。

blocks.en: 3.6 Miscellaneous Mechanisms
blocks.zh: 3.6 杂项 机制

blocks.en: Several IRST methods based deep learning consist of multi-branch as dual branch mechanisms ( 39 ; 114 ; 115 ; 72 ; 102 ; 116 ; 117 ; 118 ; 119 ; 107 ) and triple branch mechanisms. ( 117 ) . In addition, several researchers employ various synergistic frameworks ( 107 ; 79 ; 120 ; 115 ; 121 ; 122 ; 123 ; 124 ; 125 ) . Other researchers developed refinement mechanisms (OSCAR ( 126 ) , SAFARI-net ( 127 ) , CPMamba ( 128 ) , AER-net ( 45 ) , MAPPR++-Net ( 129 ) ).
blocks.zh: 一些基于深层学习的IRST方法包括多分支作为双分支机制(39;114;115;72;102;116;117;118;119;107)和三分支机制(117)。 此外,一些研究人员还利用各种协同框架(107;79;120;115;121;122;123;124;125)。 其他研究人员制定了完善机制(OSCAR(126),SAFARI-net(127),CPMamba(128),AER-net(45),MAPPR++-Net(129))。

blocks.en: 3.7 Computational Cost
blocks.zh: 3.7 计算费用

blocks.en: Deep neural networks require extensive computational cost. In this context, network quantization allows to reduce the model size, memory footprint, and computational cost. It is achieved by representing float weights and activations with lower bit counterparts, which is essential for model deployment on resource-limited devices. In 2024, Li et al. ( 130 ) study the quantization sensitivity of small target segmentation network by looking at the sensitivity heterogeneity of different layers in the network. The analysis reveals that feature maps in shallow layers and encoder subnetwork are more vulnerable to information loss due to quantization as compared to deep layers and decoder subnetwork. Thus, Li et al. ( 130 ) assign a different bit width for each block according to their quantization sensitivity and propose a Symmetrically Progressive decreasing Mixed-precision Quantization (SPMix-Q 1 1 1 https://github.com/YeRen123455/SIRST-Quantization-Deployment ) to achieve high-performance segmentation under low-bit quantization (i.e., 2.42 bits for weights and 3.82 bits for activations). Experiments show that SPMix-Q provides similar detection with only 1/13 model size, 1/4.6 memory footprint, and 1/29 computational cost to the full-precision counterparts.
blocks.zh: 深神经网络需要大量的计算成本. 在这方面,网络量化可以减少模型大小、内存足迹和计算成本。 其方法是用较低的比特对应物表示浮标重量和激活,这对于在资源有限的设备上进行模型部署至关重要。 2024年,李等人(130人)通过考察网络中不同层的敏感度异质性,研究了小目标分解网络的量化敏感性. 分析显示,与深层和解码子网络相比,浅层和编码器子网络的特征图更容易遭受信息损失。 因此,Li等人(130人)根据其量化灵敏度为每个区块分配了不同的位宽度,并提出了对称递减的混合精度量化(SPMix-Q 1 1 1 https://github.com/YeRen123455/SIRST-Quantization-Dropment),以便在低位量化下实现高性能分化(即重量为2.42位,激活为3.82位). 实验显示SPMix-Q提供了类似的检测,只有1/13型号大小,1/4.6内存足迹,以及1/29对全精度对应方的计算成本.

blocks.en: Section 4 reviews conventional neural networks (i.e CNNs) based methods. Section 5 reviews Wavelets based methods. Section 6 and Section 7 survey Mamba based methods and Transformers based methods. Section 8 presents GANs based methods. Section 9 presents Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) based methods. Section 10 surveys the recent application of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision Language Models (VLMs). Finally, Section 11 presents the recent applications of graph/hypergraph representation and learning in IRSTD.
blocks.zh: 第四节审查基于常规神经网络(即CNN)的方法. 第5节审查基于波阵的方法。 第6节和第7节调查了基于曼巴的方法和基于变形器的方法。 第8节介绍了基于全球网络的方法。 第9节介绍了基于专家的混合方法。 第10节调查了最近应用大语言模型(LLM)和远景语言模型(VLM)的情况. 最后,第11节介绍了最近在IRSTD中应用图表/文字表述和学习的情况。

blocks.en: 4 Conventional Deep Neural Networks
blocks.zh: 4 常规深神经网络

blocks.en: Deep Neural Networks-based methods for infrared small target detection can be divided into two categories namely detection based methods and segmentation based methods ( 53 ) .
blocks.zh: 基于深神经网络的红外小目标探测方法可分为两类,即基于探测的方法和基于分解的方法(53 ).

blocks.en: 4.1 Detection based Methods
blocks.zh: 4.1 基于检测的方法

blocks.en:
In 2018, Liu et al. ( 269 ) first design a generic target detection
framework for infrared small target detection by using a
a Multi-Layer Perception (MLP) network with 5 5 layers for infrared small target detection. In 2020, McIntosh et al. ( 132 ) fine-tuned several generic target detection network and employ the optimized eigen-vectors as input to achieve improved performance. In general, the detection based methods can be classified into two categories: traditional general detectors (Faster R-CNN, SSD, YOLO series) and Transformer-based detectors (RT-DETR series ( 270 ) ). About the infrared small target-specific detectors, they fall in the same two categories as follows: 1. YOLO series such as IRSTD-YOLO ( 133 ) , YOLOSR-IST ( 134 ) , YOLO-MBL ( 135 ) , YOLO-TFFM ( 136 ) , SAYOLO ( 137 ) , BOH-YOLO ( 147 ) , YOLO-LCF ( 139 ) and IR-WSANet ( 140 ) . 2. DETR series such as RT-DETR-CST ( 143 ) , SEF-DETR ( 101 ) ), IRST-RTDETR ( 144 ) , REDETR-ISTD ( 145 ) , MI-DETR ( 146 ) , CSFPR-RTDETR-CR ( 147 ) , DCFD-DET ( 148 ) , GHRT-DETR ( 149 ) and FGOM-RTDETR ( 99 ) to cite the more representative algorithms.

blocks.en: 4.2 Segmentation based Methods
blocks.zh: 4.2 基于分块的方法

blocks.en: Segmentation-based methods have attracted increasing attention because these methods can produce both pixel-level classification and localization outputs.
blocks.zh: 基于分解的方法引起了越来越多的关注,因为这些方法既可以产生像素级的分类,也可以产生局部化的输出.

blocks.en:
1. The first category concerns dedicated methods with diverse strategies employing various mechanisms such as attention mechanisms (context ( 37 ; 38 ) , spatial ( 200 ) , direction-induced ( 202 ; 203 ; 73 ) ), diffusion mechanisms ( 207 ; 209 ) , learning mechanisms ( 271 ; 272 ) , feedback mechanisms ( 218 ; 219 ) , multi-branch mechanisms ( 39 ; 114 ; 121 ) , multi-scale mechanisms ( 40 ; 72 ; 273 ; 6 ) , motion mechanisms ( 146 ; 274 ; 275 ) , semantic mechanisms ( 77 ; 276 ; 104 ) , feature guidance ( 277 ; 278 ; 55 ) and ODE mechanisms ( 279 ; 221 ) to cite a few. Moreover, different architectures are employed based on Mamba ( 86 ; 280 ; 76 ) , on Transformers ( 235 ; 236 ; 237 ) and on wavelets ( 281 ; 282 ) . 2. The second category of segmentation based methods are in the Segment AnythingModel (SAM) series.(IRSAM ( 168 ) , SAM with IR Adapters ( 169 ) , SAM-SL ( 170 ) , E2SAM ( 171 ) , SimIR ( 173 ) , LSP-ST ( 174 ) , SAIST ( 249 ) , MIRSAM ( 250 ) ). SAM is a general object segmentation model designed by the Meta AI team. SAM provides strong generalization and versatility using training in large-scale, diverse datasets. Its core architecture comprises an image encoder, a prompt encoder, and a mask decoder. The image encoder employs Vision Transformer (ViT) to extract global features, the prompt encoder processes various forms of user prompts (such as points, boxes, or masks), and the mask decoder provides segmentation results using these prompts. Its architectural design allows real-time responsiveness to dynamically adjust input prompts and generate segmentation masks in real time. Nevertheless, their effectiveness on infrared small target detection remains limited ( 168 ) because of the significant domain discrepancy between pretraining datasets and infrared imagery, which typically exhibits strong noise, weak texture, low-contrast targets, and a severe imbalance between foreground and background information. IRSAM ( 168 ) and SAM-SL ( 170 ) typically employ handcrafted priors during fine-tuning while SAIST ( 249 ) incorporate scene-level priors from language models to improve infrared small target detection. But, handcrafted priors often suffer from poor generalizability and may hinder the model’s end-to-end
learning capacity ( 50 ) . To achieve adaptation for infrared small target
detection without compromising generalization and scalability, LSP-ST ( 174 ) addresses the limited adaptability of vision foundation models in infrared small target detection using a shape-aware inductive bias that guides adaptation beyond texture.

学习能力(50) 为了适应红外小目标

blocks.en: 4.3 Dedicated Architectures
blocks.zh: 4.3 专用建筑

blocks.en: This section reviews the designed architectures employed for infrared small target detection. In 2022, Hou et al. ( 159 ) design an infrared small target detection based on the U-Net architecture (ISTDU-Net). ISTDU-Net is a deep learning network based on a U-shaped structure. It converts a single frame infrared image into a target probability likelihood map of image pixels. ISTDU-Net employs feature map groups in network down-sampling and uses a fully connected layer in jump connection to avoid a large number of backgrounds with similar structures from the global receptive fields Experiments show that ISTDU-Net detects small infrared targets in complex backgrounds. ISTDU-Net provides better receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve with a low false alarm rate and with the area under curve (AUC) value is 0.9977.
blocks.zh: 本节审查红外小目标探测所使用的设计架构。 2022年,侯等编著. (159)基于U-Net架构(ISTDU-Net)设计红外小目标探测. ISTDU-Net是一个基于U形结构的深层学习网络. 它将单帧红外图像转换成图像像素的目标概率概率图. ISTDU-Net在网络下采样中使用特征映射组,并在跳转连接中使用一个完全连接的层,以避免来自全球可接受字段的具有类似结构的大量背景 实验显示,ISTDU-Net探测到复杂背景的小红外目标. ISTDU-Net提供了更好的接收器操作特性曲线,其假警报率低,曲线(AUC)值为0.9977.

blocks.en: In 2023, in the context of single-frame detection , Wu et al. ( 155 ) design a “U-Net in U-Net” (UIU-Net 3 3 3 https://github.com/danfenghong/IEEE ). UIU-Net embeds a tiny U-Net into a larger U-Net backbone allowing the multi-level and multi-scale representation learning of objects. UIU-Net is trained from scratch, and the learned features enhance global and local contrast information. The UIU-Net model consists of two modules. First, the resolution-maintenance deep supervision (RM-DS) integrates Residual U-blocks into a deep supervision network to provide deep multi-scale resolution-maintenance features while learning global context information. Second, the interactive-cross attention (IC-A) module encodes the local context information between the low-level details and high-level semantic features. Experiments on the SIRST and Synthetic datasets show that UIU-Net offers powerful generalization performance. Wu et al. ( 160 ) propose a learning efficient network via structural Re-Parameterization (RepISD-Net 4 4 4 https://github.com/dalinlin-Wu/RepISD-Net ) which uses different network architectures but equivalent model parameters for training and inference, respectively. In the training phase, a parallel multibranch Edge Compensation Block (ECB) captures the local salient features and finer contour characteristic. In the inference phase, a multi-branch topology structures are merged into a single branch with only cascaded 3 × 3 3\times 3 convolutions for fast inference. Experiments show that RepISD-Net offers similar orebetter detection performance with significant acceleration in inference speed as compared with previous SOTA methods.
blocks.zh: 2023年,在单帧探测的背景下,吴等人(155人)设计了"U-Net in U-Net"(UIU-Net 3 3s://github.com/danfenghong/IEE). UIU-Net将一个微小的U-Net嵌入一个更大的U-Net主干线,允许对物体进行多层次和多尺度的表示学习. UIU-Net从零开始接受训练,所学到的特征增强了全球和地方的对比信息. UIU-Net模型包括两个模块. 首先,分辨率维护深度监管(RM-DS)将残留U区块整合到深度监管网络中,在学习全球背景信息的同时提供深度的多尺度分辨率维护功能. 第二,交互式交叉关注(IC-A)模块将低层次细节和高级语义特征之间的本地上下文信息编码. 在SIRST和合成数据集上的实验显示UIU-Net提供了强大的概括性能. Wu等人(160人)提议通过结构再参数化(RepISD-Net 4 4 4 https://github.com/dalinlin-Wu/RepISD-Net)建立一个学习效率高的网络,分别使用不同的网络架构,但用于培训和推论的等效模型参数. 在培训阶段,一个平行的多分支边缘补偿区块(ECB)捕捉了当地的显著特征和精细的轮廓特征. 在推论阶段,一个多分支的地形结构被合并成一个单一分支,只有级联3×3 3\times 3的转录,用于快速推论. 实验表明,与以往的SOTA方法相比,RepISD-Net提供了类似的振荡探测性能,具有显著的加速推导速度.

blocks.en: In 2024, Lin et al. ( 50 ) develop a unified framework based on a ResNet architecture to learn Shape-Biased Representations (SBR) by incorporating shape information into model learning. SBR uses a large-kernel encoder and a shape-guided decoder to learn discriminative shape-biased representations in an end-to-end manner. The large-kernel encoder describes infrared images into shape-preserving representations by using a few convolutions whose kernel size is as large as 9 × 9 9\times 9 instead of 3 × 3 3\times 3 . The shape-guided decoder simultaneously achieves two tasks. First, it decodes the encoder representations through upsampling reconstruction to reconstruct the segmentation. Second, it hierarchically fuses the decoder representations and edge information through cascaded gated ResNet blocks to reconstruct the contour. Experiments show that SBR outperforms 18 previous SOTA methods. In a further approach, Lin et al. ( 51 ) improve SBR by designing a learning Contrast-Enhanced Shape-Biased Representations (CESBR) based on a ResNet architecture. CESBR employs a contrast-shape encoder and a shape-reconstructable decoder to learn discriminative representations that allow to identify target objects. The contrast-shape encoder uses a stem of central difference convolutions. Thus, few large-kernel convolutions allow to extract shape-preserving features. Second, a shape-reconstructable decoder captures the edge map and is learned by simultaneously optimizing two shape-related consistencies: the internal one decodes the encoder representations by upsampling reconstruction and constraints segmentation consistency. The encoder and decoder are learned in an end-to-end manner, and the resulting shape-biased encoder representations are suitable for identifying infrared small targets. Experiments show that CESBR outperforms previous SOTA algorithms.
blocks.zh: 2024年,林等编著. (50)在ResNet架构的基础上制定统一框架,通过将形状信息纳入模型学习来学习Shape-Biased Presentations(SBR). SBR使用一个大内核编码器和一个形状导解码器,以端到端的方式学习区别的形状偏差表示. 大内核编码器将红外图像描述为保持形状的表示方式,使用一些内核大小高达9×9 9\时9而不是3×3 3\时的演化. 页:1 形状导解码器同时完成两个任务. 首先,它通过重采样重建来解码编码编码器的表示,以重建分区. 第二,它通过连锁ResNet区块将解码器的表示和边缘信息分层连接起来,以重建轮廓。 实验显示,SBR比之前的18个SOTA方法表现得更好. Lin et al.(51)通过基于ResNet架构设计一个学习对比增强的形状比亚塞德代表(CESBR),改进了SBR. CESBR使用对比形状的编码器和形状可调节的解码器来学习能识别目标对象的歧视性表示. 对比-形状编码器使用中央差异演化的干线. 因此,很少有大内核进化允许提取形状保存特征. 其次,一个形状可重建的解码器可以捕捉边缘图,通过同时优化两个形状相关成分来学习: 内部一个通过对重建进行抽样和限制分化一致性来解码编码编码的表示. 编码器和解码器是用端到端的方式学习的,由此产生的形状偏差的编码器表示物适合于识别红外小目标. 实验显示,CESBR超过了之前的SOTA算法.

blocks.en: In 2024, in the context of single-frame detection , Kumar et al. ( 43 ) design STNet (Small Target detection Network) based on the U2-Net (Nested U-shape Network) architecture. STNet comprises two modules. First, the Multi-Layer Feature Fusion (MLFF) improves the model’s ability to capture and exploit features from multiple layers, combining low-level details with high-level semantic information. Second, the Fast Fourier Block (FFB) enhances the model’s performance by enabling feature extraction in the frequency domain. Experiments on the NUDT-SIRST and IRSTD-1K datasets show that STNet outperforms previous SORA methods in cluttered backgrounds.
blocks.zh: 2024年,在单帧检测的背景下,库马尔等人(43人)基于U2-Net(Nested U-shape Network)架构设计了STNet(小目标检测网络). STNet包括两个模块。 首先,多Layer Feature Fusion(MLFF)提高了模型从多层获取和利用特征的能力,将低层细节与高级语义信息结合起来. 其次,Fast Fourier Block(FFB)通过允许频率域中的特性提取来增强模型的性能. 在NUDT-SIRST和IRSTD-1K数据集上的实验显示,STNet在杂乱的背景中超越了之前的SORA方法.

blocks.en: In 2024, in the context of dense moving target detection , Chen et al. ( 161 ) develop a Linking-Aware Sliced Network (LASNet 5 5 5 https://github.com/UESTC-nnLab/DMIST ) which consists of visual feature extraction, motion feature extraction and motion-affinity fusion. Experiments show that LASNet outperforms previous SOTA methods in both sparse and dense target scenarios.
blocks.zh: 2024年,在密集移动目标探测中,Chen等人(161人)开发了一个Linking-Aware Sliced Network(LASNet 5 5 5 https://github.com/ULEC-nnLab/DMIST),由视觉特征提取,运动特征提取和运动富集组成. 实验显示,LASNet在稀少和密集的目标情景中都超过了以前的SOTA方法.

blocks.en: In 2025, Chen et al. ( 56 ) propose an Infrared Deep dense connection network based on an U-Net architecture (ID-UNet 6 6 6 https://github.com/AngryWaves/ID-UNet ). First, an Infrared Small Target Feature Extraction (ISTFE) module is embedded within the ID-UNet architecture to allow cross-layer and continuous interaction between deep high-level and shallow low-level features. Consecutive connections within ISTFE’s fusion allow the preservation of semantic information in deep layers, as well as the resolution information in shallow layers. Second, the UNet structure parameters are compressed reducing the parameters by 81 % 81\% compared to the conventional UNet. Experiments demonstrate that ID-UNet provides better performance than previous methods in segmentation metrics, including Intersection over Union (IoU), normalized IoU (nIoU), and F1 score. Zhu et al. ( 153 ) propose a Patch-wise Fast Fourier transform (PFFT). First, it divides the input image into patches and applies the Fourier transform to each patch. Second, convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are employed for learnable high- and low-frequency partitioning via a Learnable Frequency Augmentation module (FAM). More specifically, FAM captures the inter-frequency and intra-frequency feature. Third, a Frequency Spatial Fusion Module (FSFM) merges features from frequency and spatial domains. Experiments show that PFFT outperforms state-of-the-art methods. Sun et al. ( 154 ) propose a denoising detection framework named IR-SDTNet which adopts an enhanced feature representation via dual modeling of local and global features. More specifically, a multiscale feature fusion mechanism combined with a jump connection integrates the encoder’s multi-level features with the decoder’s up-sampling features. Experiments show that IR-SDTNet suppresses most noise and helps restore fine details under high-noise backgrounds.
blocks.zh: 2025年,陈等. (56)提议在U-Net架构(ID-UNet 6 6 6 https://github.com/AngryWaves/ID-UNet)的基础上建立一个红外线深密连接网络. 第一,在ID-UNet架构内嵌入一个红外线小目标地物提取模块(ISTFE),以允许深层和浅层地物特征之间的跨层持续互动. ISTFE聚变中的连续连接可以将语义信息保存在深层,以及解析信息保存在浅层. 第二,UNet结构参数被压缩,与常规UNet相比,参数减少了81% 81\%. 实验表明,ID-UNet在分化度量中提供比以往方法更好的性能,包括跨联盟(IoU),正常化的IoU(nIoU)和F1分数.  Zhu等. (153)提议采用Patch-wise-fast Fourier变换(PFFT). 首先,它将输入图像分为补丁,并将Fourier变换应用到每个补丁上. 第二,利用可学习频率增强模块(FAM)进行可学习的高频和低频分隔。 更具体地说,FAM捕捉到频率间和频率内的特点. 第三,频率空间融合模块(FSFM)从频率和空间域合并了特征. 实验显示,PFFT的性能超过了最先进的方法. 孙等. (154) 提出一个命名为IR-SDTNet的调试检测框架,通过对当地和全球特点的双重模型化,采用增强的特征代表。 更具体地说,一个多尺度的特性聚变机制与跳跃连接结合,将编码器的多层次特性与解码器的上标特性融合在一起. 实验显示IR-STTNet抑制大多数噪声,并有助于在高噪声背景下恢复细细的细节.

blocks.en: In 2025, in the context of Kolmogorov–Arnold Networks (KAN) , Wu et al. ( 24 ) design a Kolmogorov–Arnold Network (KPF-Net) which is based on a “Perception first, Fusion then” paradigm. First, a perception module uses convolutional Kolmogorov–Arnold Networks with learnable nonlinear activation functions to extract discriminative target–background features. These features dynamically parameterize convolutional kernels to guide detail fusion. Second, Wu et al. ( 24 ) reconstruct input tensors as attention weights for memory tensors. Experiments on the SIRST-v1 and IRSTD-1k datasets show that KPF-Net provides state-of-the-art probability of detection and normalized intersection over union. In a further work, Yuan et al. ( 25 ) propose a Sparse-sine Perception Kolmogorov–Arnold Network (SP-KAN 7 7 7 https://github.com/xdFai ) which aims to exploit the superior nonlinear ability of the Kolmogorov–Arnold theory. First, a compressed vision transformer encoder is employed to capture long-range spatial dependencies. Second, a Pattern Complementarity Module (PCM) captures their essential nonlinear interactions. More specifically, PCM unifies channel-wise mappings of tokenized representations with local spatial saliency of structured features. Third, a sparse-sine perception Kolmogorov–Arnold layer (SPKAL) captures the original nonlinear space and a sparse grid-based high-dimensional sinusoidal latent space at the pixel level. Experiments demonstrate that SP-KAN outperforms previous state-of-the-art IRSTD methods in accuracy, robustness, and generalization demonstrating its superior capability in sparse nonlinear modeling.
blocks.zh: 2025年,在Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks(KAN)的背景下,Wu等人(24人)设计了一个Kolmogorov-Arnold Network(KPF-Net),它基于一个"先接受,然后融合"的范式. 首先,感知模块使用具有可学习的非线性激活功能的演化型Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks来提取歧视性目标-背景特征. 这些特征能动态地参数化折叠内核以引导细节聚变. 第二,我们... Wu et al. (24 ) 重建输入式变压器作为记忆式变压器的注意力重量. 在SIRST-v1和IRSTD-1k数据集上的实验显示,KPF-Net提供了最先进的探测概率,并使结合上的交叉正常化. 在进一步的工作中,袁等人(25人)提出了一个Sparse-sine Perception Kolmogorov–Arnold Network(SP-KAN 7 7 7 https://github.com/xdFai),旨在利用Kolmogorov–Arnold理论的优越非线性能力. 首先,采用了压缩的视变器编码器来捕捉远程空间依赖性. 第二,模式互补模块(PCM)抓住了它们重要的非线性互动。 更具体地说,PCM统一了具有地方空间特征结构化特征的标致性表示的通道图. 第三,一个稀疏的Sine感知Kolmogorov-Arnold层(SPKAL)捕捉原始的非线性空间和一个稀疏的网格基高维度的像素层潜伏空间。 实验表明,SP-KAN在准确性、稳健性和概括性方面比以前最先进的IRSTD方法强,表明其在稀疏的非线性模型方面的优越能力。

blocks.en: In 2025, in the context of multi-frame detection , Zhang et al. ( 41 ) design an Accumulation-Difference-based Siamese U-Net (ADSUNet). First, multi-scale spatial salient features in inter-frame images are extracted by Siamese network. Second, a accumulation-difference attention module adaptively fuses the inter-frame feature maps. Third, a probability likelihood diagram is employed by a decoding network that restores the scale of feature map. Experiments show that ADSUNet outperforms model-based methods (MPCM, HBMLCM, WSLCM, RLCM, TLLCM, NIPPS ( 283 ) , RIPT, WLDM, FKRW, MGRG, STLCF) and data-based methods (ISTDU-Net ( 159 ) , RISTD-Net, DNA-Net ( 53 ) , DTUM-Net) in terms of target detectability, false alarm suppressibility, real-time performance, with AUC values of 0.993 and 0.998 in two datasets (SCR < 3), 30.97 fps and a parameter quantity of 1.498 M. In 2026, develop a Spatio-Temporal Cooperative Expanded U-shape Network (STCEUNet). First, a progressive spatio-temporal hybrid enhancement architecture is designed in the feature extraction backbone. It establishes cross-frame information transmission channels at different levels and scales for deep interactive fusion of complementary spatio-temporal information. Second, a Central Difference Attention Froup (CDAG) and Multi-Frame Feature Fusion Module (MFFM) are employed for intra-frame feature aggregation and inter-frame feature fusion, respectively. CDAG performs adaptive gradient enhancement based on local saliency to provide effective spatial features while MFFM encodes target motion patterns by computing the correlation and difference in spatio-temporal context between adjacent frames. It distinguishes targets from background based on motion consistency. Experiments show that STCEUNet provides better performance that DTUM, Tridos, STMENet and ADSUNet.
blocks.zh: 2025年,在多帧探测中,张某等人(41人)设计了基于Accupation-Difference的暹罗U-Net(ADSUNet). 首先,跨帧图像中的多尺度空间突出特征由暹罗网络提取. 第二,一个累积-偏差注意模块可适应性地将框架间特征图引信。 第三,一个概率概率图被一个恢复特征地图比例的解码网络使用. 实验表明,ADSUNet在基于模型的方法(MPCM、HBMLCM、WSLCM、RLCM、TLLCM、NIPPS(283)、RIPT、WLDM、FKRW、MGRG、STLCF)和基于数据的方法(ISTDU-Net(159),RISTTD-Net,DNA-Net(53),DTUM-Net)在目标可探测性,假警报可抑制性,实时性能方面都超过了绩效,两个数据集的AUC值分别为0.993和0.998(SCR < 3),30.97英尺,参数数量为1.498 M. 2026年,开发了一个Spatio-Temporal合作扩展U-shape网络(STCEUNet). 首先,在特征提取骨干中设计了进步的spatio-时态混合增强架构. 它建立了不同级别和规模的跨框架信息传输渠道,以深入互动地融合互补的时空信息。 第二,在框架内特征聚合和框架间特征聚合方面,分别采用了中差异注意分解法(CDAG)和多窗体特征聚合模块(MFFM)。 CDAG根据局部的显著性进行适应梯度增强,以提供有效的空间特征,而MFFM则通过计算相邻框架间spatio-时空背景的相关性和差异来编码目标运动模式. 它根据运动一致性区分目标与背景. 实验显示STCEUNet提供了更好的性能,即DTUM,Tridos,STMEnet和ADSUNet.

blocks.en: In 2026, Li et al. ( 156 ) develop a U-shaped segmentation network architecture (CN-UNet). First, CN-UNet uses a ConvNeXt module as the encoder, which implements a self-attention mechanism via convolutional operations as in Swin Transformer’s functionality while expanding the receptive field interactions of target features. Second, a Multiscale Local Contrast Learning Module (MSLCLM) selectively filters features aligned with human visual priors. Third, a slicing-aided hyper-segmentation module dynamically rescales output images via adaptive slicing operations. Experiments show that CN-UNet outperforms previous SOTA methods with better visual quality and index evaluation metrics. Li et al. ( 158 ) propose a Dynamic High-Frequency convolution (DHiF 8 8 8 https://github.com/TinaLRJ/DHiF ) to translate the discriminative modeling process into the generation of a dynamic local filter bank. More specifically, DHiF is sensitive to high-frequency components (HFCs) owing to the dynamic parameters of its filters symmetrically adjusted within a zero-centered range according to Fourier transformation properties. DHiF can adaptively and dynamically processes different HFC regions and captures their distinctive grayscale variation characteristics for discriminative representation learning. Experiments on the IRSDT-1k and NUAA-SIRST datasets show that DHiF outperforms most of the time conventional deep neural networks (FC3-Net ( 211 ) , DNA-Net ( 53 ) , ISNet ( 73 ) , MSHNet), and CNN-Transformer hybrid (CNN-T) methods (MTU-Net ( 284 ) , SCTransNet ( 285 ) , APTNet ( 286 ) ).
blocks.zh: 2026年,李等人(156人)开发了U形区段网络架构(CN-UNet). 首先,CN-UNet使用一个ConvNEXt模块作为编码器,通过Swin Transformer的功能那样的转动操作来实施一种自觉机制,同时扩展目标特性的可接受性场互动. 其次,一个多尺度局部对比性学习模块(MSLCLM)有选择地过滤与人类视觉前科一致的特性. 第三,一个切片辅助的超分离模块通过适应性切片操作,动态地重塑输出图像. 实验表明,氯化萘-UNet在视觉质量和指数评价度量度方面比以往的SOTA方法要好。 李等人(158人)提出"动态高压进化"(DHiF 8 8 8s https://github.com/TinaLRJ/DHiF),将歧视性的建模过程转化为生成动态本地滤波库. 更具体地说,DHIF对高频组件(HFCs)很敏感,因为其滤波器的动态参数根据傅里叶变换属性在零中心范围内对称调整. DHIF可以适应和动态地处理不同的氢氟碳化合物区域,并捕捉其独特的灰度变化特征,以便进行歧视性的表示学习。 有关IRSDT-1k和NUAA-SIRST数据集的实验显示,DHIF在大多数时候都超越了常规深层神经网络(FC3-Net(211),DNA-Net(53),ISNet(73),MSHNet)和CNN-Transformer混合(CNN-T)方法(MTU-Net(284),SCTransNet(285),APTNet(286)).

blocks.en: 4.4 Learning Mechanims
blocks.zh: 4.4 学习方法

blocks.en: Learning mechanisms can be categorized into point supervised learning ( 188 ; 110 ; 189 ; 109 ) , weakly supervised learning ( 190 ; 191 ; 192 ) and source-free domain adaptation learning ( 193 ; 194 ; 195 ) . Data Augmentation is also a strategy to improve the learning issue ( 62 ; 198 ; 63 ; 68 ) . Table 3 shows an overview of the learning mechanisms.
blocks.zh: 学习机制可分为点监督学习(188;110;189;109),弱监督学习(190;191;192)和无源域适应学习(193;194;195). 数据增强也是改善学习问题的战略(62;198;63;68)。 表3概述了学习机制。

blocks.en: Table 3 : Learning Mechanisms: An Overview (43 papers).
blocks.zh: 表3:学习机制:概述(43篇论文)。

blocks.en:
1. Point Supervised Learning: Point-supervised learning methods in infrared small target detection have been employed in clustering-based approaches ( 308 ; 309 ; 310 ) , deep learning based approaches ( 188 ; 110 ; 190 ; 191 ; 109 ) and hybrid approaches (LELCM 9 9 9 https://github.com/haopzhang/LELCM ( 189 ) ). More specifically, the deep neural networks based methods require dense pixel-level annotations, which are costly and often unreliable for tiny and weak targets. In this context, point supervision provides a more practical alternative but the current point-supervised methods usually construct pseudo-labels based on the distance between pixels and annotated points or cluster centers, which generates spatial bias and miss genuine target pixels away from these reference points. In 2023, Ying et al. ( 110 ) propose the first work with point-level supervision. Based on the observation that CNNs first learn to segment a cluster of pixels near the targets, and then gradually converge to predict ground truth point label during the training phase supervised by point labels, Ying et al. ( 110 ) employ a label evolution framework named Label Evolution with Single Point Supervision (LESPS 10 10 10 https://github.com/XinyiYing/LESPS ) to progressively expand the point label by exploiting the intermediate predictions of CNNs. Thus, the network predictions finally estimate the updated pseudo labels. The pixel-level target mask is obtained to train CNNs in an end-to-end manner. Experiments show that CNNs with LESPS can offer a gain over 70 % 70\% and 95 % 95\% compared to their fully supervised performance in terms of pixel-level intersection over union and object-level probability of detection. In 2024, Shao et al. ( 78 ) propose also a Label Evolution with Single Point Supervision (LESPS) framework giving the same acronym than the previous method ( 110 ) . To improve the detection accuracy, a combination of Test-Time Augmentation (TTA) and Conditional Random Field (CRF) for post-processing. An Adjustable Sensitivity (AS) strategy for post-processing employs the advantages of multiple detection results and adds some areas with low confidence to the fine detection image in the form of centroid points. Finally, a multi-stage loss is employed for fine-grained detection. Experiments show that LESPS achieves SOTA performance. Note that LESPS was ranked at the third place in the “ICPR 2024 Resource-Limited Infrared Small Target Detection Challenge Track 1: Weakly Supervised Infrared Small Target Detection”. In 2025, Yu et al. ( 109 ) design
a Progressive Active Learning (PAL 11 11 11 https://github.com/YuChuang1205/PAL ) method. More specifically, a model pre-start concept allows to focus on automatically selecting a portion of easy samples and helping the model to have basic task-specific learning abilities. A refined dual-update strategy allows to promote learning of harder samples and continuous refinement of pseudo-labels. Finally, a decay factor is employed to achieve a dynamic balance between the expansion and contraction of target annotations. In 2026, Shi et al. ( 188 ) design a point-supervised method which employs Gradient-Guided Minimum Variance Growth (GMVG) with Deep Iterative Refinement (DIR). First, GMVG allows to obtain target likelihood from gradient-guided aggregation of contour closure and edge responses. Then, GMVG converts it into structurally coherent pseudo-labels via a Minimum Variance Growth filter. Second, DIR improves the pseudo-labels by employing reliable semantic guidance into an iterative refinement process, thereby reducing error propagation. Thus, irregular target shapes are better preserved. Experiments on NUDT-SIRST, IRSTD-1k, and NUAA-SIRST datasets show that GMVG-DIR improves pseudo-label fidelity and offers competitive point-supervised performance. In 2026, Zhou and Zhang ( 291 ) propose to generate a point-to-mask supervision online via an in-batch, point-anchored feature-affinity propagation. This framework named GSACP is an end-to-end testbed that supervises the detector using hard-margin feature affinity gated by local image priors avoiding external label-evolution loops. Zhou and Zhang ( 291 ) theoretically formalize this as Self-Referential Propagation Drift which is a representation-supervision entanglement that can sharpen true boundaries or distort the feature space to satisfy its own targets. A protocolized single-variable ablation procedure is employed for spanning local EMA teacher decoupling, hard-background contrastive separation, and adaptive support geometry. Experiments on the SIRST3 dataset show that GSACP outperforms PAL ( 109 ) . Ni et al. ( 311 ) propose a Single-Point Supervision guided Infrared Probabilistic Response Encoding method (SPIRE 12 12 12 https://github.com/NIRIXIANG/SPIRE-IRSTD ). First, a Point-Response Prior Supervision (PRPS) transforms single-point annotations into probabilistic response map consistent with infrared point-target response characteristics. Second, a High-Resolution Probabilistic Encoder (HRPE) enables encoder-only, end-to-end regression without decoder reconstruction. SPIRE alleviates optimization instability under sparse target distributions. Extensive experiments on the SIRST-UAVB and SIRST4 datasets show that SPIRE provides competitive detection performance with consistently low false alarm rate (Fa) and significantly reduced computational cost compared to ACM ( 37 ) , ALCNet ( 312 ) , RDIAN ( 202 ) , DNA-Net ( 53 ) , MSHNet ( 40 ) and SCTransNet ( 285 ) . Li and Zhang ( 113 ) design a Teacher-Guided Progressive Learning (TGPL) method for point supervision. TGPL employs the dynamic evolution of point labels with the feature learning capability of existing models. First, initial pseudo-masks are obtained using a Pseudo-Label Generation (PLG) method and high-confidence samples are selected for model initialization. Second, a progressive sample mining strategy gradually employs samples according to the model capacity. Third, a teacher–student collaborative mechanism iteratively refines pseudo-labels. Experiments on the NUDT-SIRST, IRSTD-1-k, and SIRST3 datasets show that TGPL achieves superior training performance under point supervision than PAL ( 109 ) and LESPS ( 78 ) . TGPL reaches 99 % 99\% of the performance in terms of detection probability (Pd). 2. Weakly Supervised Learning: In 2025, He et al. ( 191 ) design a weakly-supervised paradigm to obtain high-quality pseudo masks from the point-level annotation by using a learning-free technique with an hybrid of the learning-based method. The learning-free method is based on a sequential process, progressing from a point annotation to the bounding box that encompasses the target, and subsequently to detailed pseudo masks, while the hybrid is obtained via filtering out false alarms and retrieving missed detections in the network’s prediction to obtain a supplement for learning-free masks. Experiments show that this learning-free method provides pseudo masks with an average Intersection over Union (IoU) that is 4.3 % 4.3\% higher than the second-best learning-free competitor while the hybrid learning-based method further enhances the quality of pseudo masks, achieving an additional average IoU increase of 3.4 % 3.4\% . In an other work, Cui et al. ( 190 ) propose a Weakly Semi-Supervised Infrared Small Target Detection (WSSISTD) method. This method consists of a teacher network that provides coarse pseudo-masks and a student network that focuses on the final detection task. Cui et al. ( 190 ) employ a minimal proportion of pixel-level annotated data to train the teacher network, which subsequently provides coarse pseudo-masks for a volume of cost-effective point annotation data. Then, an adaptive Random Walker (RW) strategy allows to exploit point labels for obtaining RW pseudo-masks. To deal with the limitations of the teacher network trained on a limited amount of pixel-level labels, a RefineNet integrate and refine multiple coarse pseudo-masks. Finally, a combination of partially real masks and refined pseudo-masks is used to train the student network reducing the labeling cost. Experiments show that WSSISTD provides similar performance than fully supervised methods. 3. Source-Free Domain Adaptation Learning: Most the deep neural networks based methods assume that the training and testing data come from the same distribution, an assumption that does not hold in many real-world scenarios. In addition, the impossibility to access source domain data complicates the domain adaptation process. To address these problems, Jin et al. ( 194 ) propose a Source-Free Domain Adaptation (SFDA) method which consists of two modules. First, the Multi-expert Domain Adaptation (MDA) module allows the source model to provide pseudo masks for the target domain, facilitating the transfer of knowledge from the source to the target domain. MDA refines these pseudo masks through a series of operations, including target localization, shape adaptation, and multi-expert decision. Second, the Multi-scale Focused Learning (MFL) module is based on a global-local fusion strategy to focus on critical regions increasing the model’s ability to detect small infrared targets. In 2026, Wang et al. ( 221 ) design a Prior-Driven Self-Evolving Curriculum Learning (PDSECL) method which consist of three strategies.
First, the Explicit Prior-driven Initial Sample Pool Construction (EPISPC) strategy employs consistency and local contrast priors to denoise initial pseudo-labels obtained from the source model in the target domain, and selects easy samples to obtain an initial sample pool, laying a reliable foundation for early-stage adaptation. Second, the Implicit Prior-driven Pseudo-label Refinement (IPPR) strategy allows implicit dynamic information during model training to obtain continuous optimization and updating of pseudo-labels. Third, the Consolidated Prior-driven Curriculum Augmentation (CPCA) strategy treats samples as a consolidated prior and synthesizes harder samples by fusing them with extracted background regions using a curriculum learning mechanism to progressively improve the model’s generalization ability. Experiments on the SIRST, NUDT-SIRST, and IRSTD-1k datasets show that PDSECL improves the adaptive performance of source domain methods to new domains. 4. Active Domain Adaptation Learning: Even if unsupervised domain adaptation allows to mitigate limited sample sizes and limited scene diversity a notable difference with fully supervised methods remains, limiting practical
applicability. To address this problem, Li et al. ( 300 ) design an Active Domain Adaptation framework for IRSTD (ADA-IRSTD) which consists of three modules. strategies. First, a Target-Proximity
Preserving Masking (TPPM) allows to mask background regions while preserving target and neighboring features, thereby enhancing cross-domain robustness. Second, a False Alarm Prediction Module (FAPM) allows to quantify target indistinguishability and assess the risk of ambiguous detections. Third, a Global Distribution Uncertainty Sampling (GDUS) guides active sample selection based on global prediction uncertainty. Experiments on the NUDT-SIRST, IRSTD-1k, SIRST, and SIRST-v2 datasets show that DA-IRSTD outperforms previews active domain adaptation (EADA ( 313 ) , RIPU ( 314 ) , DUC ( 315 ) ) and MMIDNet . ( 316 ) . 5. Dual-Stream Edge-Target Learning: In 2024, Yao et al. ( 197 ) propose a Dual-stream Edge-Target Learning Network (DETL-Net 13 13 13 https://github.com/rayyao/DETL-Net ) which enhances feature cross-fusion by learning edge details and target regions via a dual-stream framework. First, multilevel features of the image based on the encoder-decoder structure of U-Net are extracted and the feature map is obtained Second, a Dual-GUided C-Fusion Module (DGCFM) capture edge details of small targets and global contextual features of the target region. Third, a Multiscale Context Fusion Module (MCFM) within DGCFM employs central difference convolution to enhance local contrast and extract rich contextual details, thereby retaining edge information and enhancing overall target representation. A Cross-dimension Interactive Aggregation Attention Module (CIAAM) dynamically adjusts feature fusion weights across layers to deal with noise and improve the discrimination of small targets. These diverse modules are sequentially interconnected to progressively refine edge details. The target features are subsequently employed for predicting the final target mask through the segmentation head. Experiments on the NUAA-SIRST and IRSTD-1k datasets show that DETL-Net outperforms several previous SOTA methods. 6. Contrastive Learning: In 2026, Luo et al. ( 89 ) design a Frequency and Gradient Feature Refinement Network (FGFRNet 14 14 14 https://github.com/wangqian-w/FGFRNet ). FGFRNet comprises three. First, a Temperature-Aware Contrastive Learning (TACL) module exploits pixel-wise thermal priors to obtain discriminative positive and negative pairs in feature space. Second,a Frequency Attention Aware Fusion (FAAF) module employs global frequency domain context with spatial-domain details to enhance semantic localization. Third, a Texture Feature Enhancement (TFE) module uses gradient-based supervision to strengthen fine-grained texture cues. Experiments on the NUAA-SIRST, NUDT-SIRST, and IRSTD-1k datasets that FGFRNet outperforms MDvsFA ( 243 ) , ACMNet, ALCNet ( 312 ) , ISNet ( 73 ) , FC3-Net ( 211 ) , Dim2Clear ( 317 ) , MSHNet ( 40 ) , CSRNet, IRPruneDet ( 318 ) , SAGCPDet ( 225 ) , and MMLNet ( 114 ) in cluttered and low-contrast conditions. Duan et al. ( 302 ) propose a Weakly-supervised Contrastive Learning (WeCoL 15 15 15 https://github.com/UESTC-nnLab/WeCoL ) framework which requires simple target quantity prompts during model. Based on the pretrained Segment Anything Model (SAM), a target mining strategy integrates target activation maps. Second, a multi-frame energy contrastive learning enhances the reliability of pseudo-labels based on the similarity between positive and negative samples in feature. Third, a long-short term motion-aware learning framework simultaneously model the local motion patterns and global motion trajectory of small targets. Experiments on the DAUB and ITSDT-15K datasets show that WeCoL outperform several times early fully-supervised methods. 7. Data Augmentation: IRSTD faces a massive and diverse demand for samples using diverse augmentation strategies namely Random-Cloning models ( 62 ) , Random-Erasing models ( 63 ) , prior-guided models ( 64 ) , thermodynamics-Inspired models ( 65 ) , GANs ( 66 ; 66 ; 67 ) , diffusion models ( 68 ; 69 ) and hybrid models ( 70 ) . However, several research generate infrared data for various scenes from visible images with Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs). In 2023, Chen et al. ( 63 ) propose a data augmentation method named AugTarget 16 16 16 https://github.com/UESTC-nnLab/AugTarget which consists of two steps: target augmentation and batch augmentation. First, the target augmentation allows to generate sufficient targets using random target representation. Second, the batch augmentation allows to diversify training samples. The initially-generated image samples of small targets are also enriched by randomly aggregating the feature representation of different images. Experiments show that AugTarget improves the mean intersection over union (mIoU). But, AugTarget is specifically
designed for single-frame images and fails to keep temporal correlations inherent in image sequences. In 2024, Shi et al. ( 68 ) design Diff-Mosaic 17 17 17 https://github.com/YupeiLin2388/Diff-Mosaic , a data augmentation method based on the diffusion model. This model attempt to alleviate the challenge of diversity and realism of data augmentation methods via diffusion prior. First an enhancement network called Pixel-Prior generates highly coordinated and realistic Mosaic images by harmonizing pixels. Second an image enhancement strategy named Diff-Prior uses diffusion priors to model images in the real-world scene, further enhancing the diversity and realism of the images. In 2025, Peng et al. ( 62 ) design an augmentation method specifically for sequence-based infrared images. The input image sequences have the
number of targets of diverse sizes and locations increased while maintaining temporal coherence with the use of a target augmentation method and enriching the scene information within a single image through a batch augmentation algorithm. Thus, the augmented video clip is employed as input for a temporal modeling model in order to learn the semantic information. However, these two methods neglect the differences between different modal images, thus losing realism and usability. To address these issues, Chen et al. ( 198 ) develop in 2026 a High-Quality Data Augmentation (HQDA) technique. This technique offers better performance by using the intrinsic properties of infrared images. More specifically, a consistency-constrained background generation method allows to obtain high-quality infrared backgrounds from visible images. It uses the nonlocal self-correlation property of infrared images into GAN to improve the realism of generated data. To better preserve the real distribution during target enhancement, a target extraction method based on a robust random walker (RW) is employed.
