blocks.en:
Contextual Attention Mechanisms: In 2020, Qin et al. ( 38 ) propose a U-Net based methods; The architecture is a two-level nested U-structure which captures more contextual information from different scales and increases the depth of the whole architecture. This architecture can train a deep network from scratch without using backbones.
In 2021, Dai et al. ( 37 ) design an Asymmetric Contextual Modulation (ACM 18 18 18 https://github.com/YimianDai/open-acm ) module based on an U-Net architecture. In addition of a top-down global contextual feedback, a bottom-up modulation pathway based on point-wise channel attention for exchanging high-level semantics and subtle low-level details is employed. Experiments show that ACM outperforms local contrast measurement methods (Tophat, LCM ( 381 ) , ILCM, LSM, FKRW, MPCM), LRSD methods (IPI ( 382 ) , NIPPS ( 283 ) , RIPT, PSTNN ( 383 ) , NRAM ( 384 ) ) and deep neural networks methods (FPN ( 345 ) ,UIU-Net ( 155 ) ). In 2024, Chen et al. ( 362 ) design a Dynamic Context-Aware Pyramid Network (DCAPNet) which consists of a Dynamic Context Modulation (DCM), a Dynamic Pyramid Context (DPC), and a Shuffle Attention Fusion (SAF). First, the DCM module adaptively captures diverse-scale information adapting to various target dimensions, and enhancing the feature representation abilities. Second, the DPC module allows to adaptively captures multiscale features and employs contextual information by aggregating multiple DCM modules. Third, the SAF module allows to exchange of information within the same layer and establish correlations between different layers. Experiments on the IRSTD-1 k, SIRST-Aug, and NUDT-SIRST datasets show that DCAPNet outperforms several previous algorithms.
blocks.zh:
背景关注机制: 2020年,秦 al等人(38人)提出以U-Net为基础的方法; 架构是双层嵌套的U结构,从不同尺度获取更多的背景信息,提高整个架构的深度. 这种架构可以在不使用骨干的情况下从零开始训练深层网络.
2021年,戴等人(37人)设计了一个基于U-Net架构的不对称背景模块(ACM 18 18 18 https://github.com/YimianDai/open-acm). 除了自上而下的全球背景反馈外,还采用了基于点心频道注意力的自下而上调制路径,用于交流高级语义和微妙的低层次细节。 实验表明,ACM比本地对比度测量方法(Tophat、LCM(381),ILCM、LSM、FKRW、MPCM),LRSD方法(IPI(382),NIPPS(283),RIPT,PSTNN(383),NRAM(384))和深神经网络方法(FPN(345),UIU-Net(155))都超标. 2024年,Chen等人(362人)设计了动态上下文-Aware Pyramid Network(DCAPNet),由动态上下文调制(DCM),动态上下文(DPC)和Shuffle Content Fusion(SAF)组成. 首先,DCM模块适应性地捕捉适应不同目标层面的不同尺度信息,增强特征表现能力. 其次,DPC模块通过汇总多个DCM模块,可以适应性地捕捉多尺度特征并使用背景信息. 第三,苏丹武装部队模块允许在同一层内交流信息,并在不同层之间建立联系。 在IRSTD-1 k,SIRST-Aug,和NUDT-SIRST数据集上的实验显示,DCAPNet的性能超过了之前的几种算法.

blocks.en: Energy Field Attention Mechanisms: In 2026, Fang et al. ( 376 ) propose a Cross-layer Energy Field Aggregation Network (CEFANet). It addresses target energy discontinuities embedded in cluttered backgrounds to achieve dynamic discrimination and feature enhancement of small targets with varying states. First, an Energy Field Attention (EFA) module selectively amplifies target energy mutations while suppressing background noise. Second, a Cross-layer State Fusion (CSF) module based on channel-wise state awareness and adaptive weighting mechanisms allow precise modulation of low-level features under the guidance of high-level semantic states. Experiments show that CEFANet improves the detection performance of infrared small targets.
blocks.zh: 能源领域关注机制:2026年,Fang等人(376人)提出跨层能源领域聚合网络(CEFANet). 它处理嵌入于杂乱背景中的目标能量不连续问题,以实现动态歧视,并突出增强不同状态的小型目标。 首先,一个能量领域注意(EFA)模块在压制背景噪声的同时选择性地放大目标能量突变. 第二,一个基于频道状态意识和适应性加权机制的跨层状态融合(CSF)模块可以在高级语义状态的指导下精确调制低级特征. 实验显示CEFANet改进了红外小目标的探测性能.

blocks.en: Hypergraph Attention Mechanisms: In 2026, Zhang et al. ( 94 ) design a network that couples a Multiscale Convolutional Decoder (MSCD) with a Hypergraph Attention (HA) mechanism. A Distribution-aware Pixel-wise Wasserstein Loss (DPWL) jointly enforces scale, positional, and distributional consistency. First, MSCD aggregates cross-layer representations via a multi-receptive-field convolutional structures to keep fine-graind target details and amplifies saliency. Second, HA exploits learnable soft hyperedges to capture high-order dependencies across channel and spatial dimensions. Third, DPWL injects a distribution-consistency constraint into the optimization process to improve convergence robustness and localization accuracy. Experiments on the IRSTD-1k, NUDT-SIRST, DenseSIRST, and NUAA-SIRST dataset show that MSC-HA provides an average performance of 75.89 % 75.89\% in IoU, 96.70 % 96.70\% in Pd, and 8.67 × 10 − 6 8.67\times 10^{-6} in Fa.
blocks.zh: 超绘图注意机制 : 2026年,张等. (94) 设计一个网络,将多尺度的革命解码器(MSCD)与超图注意(HA)机制结合。 具有分布意识的像素-明智的瓦瑟斯坦损失(DPWL)共同执行规模,位置,分布一致性. 首先,MSCD通过多受体-场的演化结构来聚合跨层的表示,以保持精细的标的细节,并放大显著性. 其次,医管局利用可学习的软超缘,捕捉跨信道和空间维度的高度依赖性。 第三,DPWL在优化过程中注入了分布一致性的制约,以提高趋同稳健性和本地化精度. 对IRSTD-1k,NUDT-SIRST,DenseSIRST,NUA-SIRST数据集的实验显示,MSC-HA在IoU中的平均性能为75.89% 75.89%,Pd中的平均性能为96.70% 96.70%,Fa中的平均性能为8.67×10−6.67\times 10^{-6}.

blocks.en: 4.6 Adaptive and Multi-Cue Mechanisms
blocks.zh: 4.6 适应性和多要素机制

blocks.en: This section reviews adaptive mechanisms as well as multi-scales mechanisms.
blocks.zh: 本节审查适应机制和多规模机制。

blocks.en: Table 5 : Adaptive and Multi-Cues Mechanisms: An Overview (77 papers).
blocks.zh: 表5:适应性和多特征 机制:概述(77份文件)。

blocks.en:
1. Adaptive Mechanisms: In 2024, Li et al. ( 385 ) design Moderately Dense Adaptive Feature Fusion Network (MDAFNet) which consists of three feature layers as the backbone. This module allows to connect all the internal features with each other and employs a weighted sum of different layers as the output allowing feature reuse and keeping infrared small target features in the deep layers. A Coarse-to-Fine detection Head (CFHead) is employed and an auxiliary loss allows the network to estimate target contour. Experiments show that MDAFNet provides similar performance than previous SOTA algorithms with requirements for real-time detection on RTX3080 GPU. In an other work, Zhang et al. ( 45 ) propose an Adaptive feature Enhancement and hierarchical Refinement network (AER-Net 19 19 19 https://github.com/fuqingzhang/AER-Net ) which extracts discriminative features of small targets while exploiting the semantics of different layers. A U-shaped architecture with a Feature Representation Enhancement Module (FREM) combines the local correlation of (CNNs) and the global correlation of Transformers to improve features while preventing the loss of tiny targets. A Daisy-shaped Correlation-aware Module (DCM) capture global contexts for mitigating clutter interference in deeper layers. A Gated Refinement Module (GRM) refine low-level features from the encoder using high-level features as guidance for capturing local details and removing noise in shallower layers. Experiments on three public datasets show that AER-Net offers significant improvements in the mean intersection over union (IoU) metric. In 2026, Wang et al. ( 206 ) design a Triple Adaptive Multiplexing Network (TAMNet 20 20 20 https://github.com/RuWang-prog/TAMNet ) which used a dedicated adaptive multiplexing strategies for feature extraction, contextual understanding, and prediction generation, respectively. First, a Parallel Attention Residual Block (PARB) mitigates feature distortion via an attention decoupling and keeps feature diversity by adaptively integrating feature streams. Second, a Local Saliency Module (LSM) implicitly infer stable target-background relationships from multi-scale contextual dependencies. Third, the prediction mask is generated via a multi-level feature fusion. Experiments show that TAMNet offers SOTA performance in addition of generalization capability on public IRSTD datasets. 2. Recurrent Mechanisms: In 2025, Liu et al. ( 82 ) design a Recurrent Reusable-Convolution Attention Network (RRCA-Net) which incorporates Reusable-Convolution Block (RuCB) in a recurrent manner without introducing extra parameters. Thus, the high-level information of small targets in the deep layers is maintained and further refined. A Dual Interactive Attention Aggregation Module (DIAAM) allows to promote the mutual enhancement and fusion of refined information. Thus, RRCA-Net achieves high-level feature refinement and improves the correlation of contextual information between adjacent layers. A target characteristic inspired loss function (DpT-k loss) integrates physical and mathematical constraints. Experiments on NUAA-SIRST, IRSTD-1k and DenseSIRST) datasets show that RRCA-Net outperforms previous SOTA algorithms while keeping a small number of parameters. In addition RRCA-Net can be employ as a plug and play module to introduce consistent performance improvement in existing IRSTD methods. 3. Diffusion Mechanisms: In 2024, Fan et al. ( 209 ) propose a Diffusion-based Continuous Feature Representation Network (DCFR-Net) which consists of two branches: Diffusion-based Continuous HR Feature Representation (DCHFR) and ISDTD. First, DCHFR employs Implicit Neural Representation (INR) into a conditional denoising diffusion model to capture extremely small target contours. Second, ISDTD exploits the shared encoder from DCHFR to obtain the HR feature representation, which is fed into Multiscale Implicit Feature Alignment (MIFA) and Spatial-Frequency Feature Interaction (SFFI). MIFA aggregates different-layer features in a resolution-free manner. SFFI provides profound SFFI and global-local receptive field mixture to increase the contrast between infrared targets and intricate backgrounds. Experiment with NUAA-SIRST, IRSTD-1k, and NUDT-SIRST datasets show that DCFR-Net outperforms previous algorithms. In 2026, Tong et al. ( 207 ) propose an Energy Diffusion Prior (EDPrior) method. A feature recovery network retains the attention of small targets in deep networks by employing a simple encoding space and a multi-stage decoding space. This scheme reduces redundant skip connections. The curvature separation module exploits the thermal radiation diffusion properties of small targets as prior knowledge and extracts the target features via a learnable discrete Fourier transform. By reducing redundancy and incorporating prior knowledge, our network can learn effective target features for the detection task more efficiently and purposefully, rather than relying on complex networks to learn the variable backgrounds in different scenes. In an other approach, Rong et al. ( 208 ) design an end-to-end infrared background prediction method based on a Conditional Diffusion model with an Adaptive blocking (APCD) strategy. The adaptive blocking strategy uses both local and global information and accelerates the inference speed of the diffusion model. The multi-scale attention segmentation module allows to suppress background clutter and enhance the target. Experiments show that APCD outperforms PSTNN ( 383 ) , RIPT ( 430 ) , ALCNet ( 312 ) and AGPCNet. 4. Multi-Branch Mechanisms: In 2024, in the context of dense target detection , Xu et al. ( 389 ) design a Dual-Branch Dense Collaborative Network (DB-DCNet) which employs two dedicated detection branches. The first branch minimizes missed detections via target-sensitive feature learning. The second branch reduces false alarms through clutter-aware optimization techniques. Both branches adopt the same densely connected network structure but employ different feature extraction modules. The first branch exploits small-sized kernels and hybrid attention mechanisms to segment target edges. The second branch employs convolutions with multiple receptive fields and residual connections to filter out background clutter. The detection results of the two branches are processed by a lightweight feature selection network for feature selection and fusion. Experiments on the NUDT-SIRST, IRSTD-Air, IRSTD-1k, and WideIRSTD-Full datasets show that DB-DCNet provide better results than previous SOTA algorithms. In 2025, Xiao et al. ( 39 ) design a Dual-Branch Contrast-Enhanced U-Net (DBCE U-Net) which employs a Contrast Conv Module. The Contrast Conv Module improves contrast and feature representation through adaptive feature segmentation and convolution operations. The dual-branch combines ResNeSt modules for deep feature extraction and feature enhancement modules for visual perception augmentation. DBCE U-Net exploits gradient information to improve small target features and increase the robustness via a dual-branch structure. Experiments on the NUDT-SIRST dataset show that DBCE U-Net offers superior detection performance with an IoU and Pd of 94.60 % 94.60\% and 99.05 % 99.05\% , respectively. In an other work, Li et al. ( 114 ) design a Multi-branch Mutual-guiding Learning Network (MMLNet 21 21 21 https://github.com/qianngli/MMLNet ) which consists of three branches: edge, positioning, and detection. Each of branch consists of a module from a unique perspective. In the detection branch, a multidimensional lossless encoder optimized via a downsampling strategy and multilevel feature fusion allow to mitigate feature loss. In the positioning branch, a target positioning strategy identifies candidate targets from the image by means of a learnable multi-kernel pattern. In the edge branch, a conventional architecture help the model to capture the target shape. A mutual-guiding fusion module adjust information within and between branches. Experiments show that MMLNet offers similar performance than previous SOTA algorithms. Xiao et al. ( 121 ) develop a Dual-Domain Feature Enhanced Network (D2FENet) which synergistically integrates wavelet transform with CNN operations. It allows to extract feature in both frequency and spatial domains via parallel processing pathways. The frequency-domain branch exploits wavelet transform to capture high-frequency details. The spatial branch uses pixel reorganization for feature fidelity downsampling. Experiments on the NUDT-SIRST dataset show that D2FENet preserves target integrity, suppresses false alarms, and offers superior performance compared to previous SOTA methods. 5. Multi-Scales/Multi-Levels Mechanisms: In 2023, Ma et al. ( 400 ) present a Multiscale Super-Resolution Enhancement and Multilevel Attention Fusion Network (MSMA-Net). First, MSMA-Net determines the rough location of targets through a coarse preliminary screening. Second, the network employs multiscale super-resolution to transform low-resolution feature maps into high-resolution representations. Third, the network uses a multilevel feature fusion attention mechanism to facilitate effective information transmission and fusion in multiscale and multilevel feature representations. Experiments show that MSMA-Net suppresses false alarms and provides better performance when the target present a small size and obscure feature information. In the context of MIRST, Yan et al. ( 81 ) develop a Spatio-Temporal Differential Multiscale Attention Network (STDMANet). First, STDMANet employs a temporal multiscale feature extractor to obtain spatiotemporal features from multiple time scales and then resorted them to the spatial multiscale feature refiner to improve the semantics of the features. Second, a mask-weighted heatmap loss allows to train the network with only center point annotations and balances missing detection and false alarm. Experiments show that STDMANet improve the metric F1 score up to 0.9744, surpassing SOTA algorithms by 0.1682. In 2024, Liu et al. Liu et al. ( 40 ) design a Multi-Scale Head with an UNet architecture (MSHNet 22 22 22 https://github.com/ying-fu/MSHNet ) using a Scale and Location Sensitive (SLS) loss to each scale of the predictions. The SLS loss tackle the limitations of previous losses. First, a weight for the IoU loss based on target scales help the detector to separate targets with different scales. Second, a penalty term based on the center points of targets help the detector to localize targets more precisely. MSHNet outperforms model-based methods (IPI ( 382 ) ( 382 ) , NRAM ( 384 ) , RIPT, PSTNN ( 383 ) , MSLSTIPT ( 431 ) ) and data-based methods (MDvsFA ( 243 ) , ALCNet ( 312 ) , ISNet ( 73 ) , DNA-Net ( 53 ) ). In 2025, Li et al. ( 72 ) propose a Dual Branch Multiscale Spatio-Temporal Network (DBMSTN). First, DBMSTN employs a multiscale spatial feature extraction module that exploits inter-frame difference and saliency feature to highlight small targets at different scales and suppress complex backgrounds. Second, a dual-branch spatio-temporal feature extraction module with improved gating unit in convolutional LSTM (ConvLSTM) improve the extraction of motion features to deal with their uncertainty. Third, a fusing module combines multilevel spatio-temporal features. A weighted mean squared error (MSE) loss function is employed with adjustable weights of positive and negative samples to address the data imbalance problem. Experiments show that DBMSTN achieves a F1 score.
In an other work, Xu et al. ( 273 ) develop an Hybrid-Domain Network (HDNet 23 23 23 https://github.com/xumingzhu989/HDNet-TGRS ) with multiscale high-frequency information enhancement. More specifically, HDNet combines frequency-domain features with spatial-domain CNN features to increase the target-background contrast and suppress background interference. HDNet consists of two branches: the spatial-domain branch and the frequency-domain branch. In the spatial domain, a Multiscale Atrous Contrast (MAC) convolution module improves the perception of small. In the frequency domain, a Dynamic High-Pass Filter (DHPF) module computes low-frequency signal energy and dynamically removes specific low-frequency information to capture high-frequency image details. Experiments on the IRSTD-1K, NUAA-SIRST, and NUDT-SIRST datasets show that HDNet outperforms SOTA methods. Zhang et al. ( 395 ) provide a Multi-level Multi-patch Multi-receptive Multi-dimensional attention Network (M4Net) to capture information interaction among high-level and low-level features. First, a Multi-level feature extraction module (MFEM) with multilayer vision transformer (ViT) allows to fuse multi-scale features. Second, a Multi-Patch Attention Module (MPAM) and a Multi-Receptive Field Module (MRFM) capture and improve the feature information. Third, a Multi-Dimension Interactive Module (MDIM) connect the attention mechanism on multiscale features to improve the learning ability. Experiments show that M4Net provides better results than RDIAN ( 202 ) , DNA-Net ( 53 ) and UIU-Net ( 155 ) . Wang et al. ( 83 ) ) design a Wide-scale Gated Fully Fusion Network (WGFFNet) which employs a classic encoder–decoder structure. First, a Stepped Fusion Block (SFB) embedded in the feature extraction stage allows to capture finer local context across multiple scales during encoding. Along the decoding path, the multi-level features are progressively integrated by a Fully Gated Interaction (FGI) Module. A boundary difference loss optimizes the edge details of targets. Experiments on the SIRST-V2 ( 126 ) and IRSTD-1k show that WGFFNet outperforms NRAM ( 384 ) , PSTNN ( 383 ) , ALCNet ( 312 ) , DNA-Net ( 53 ) , ISNet ( 73 ) , UIU-Net ( 155 ) and PBT ( 432 ) . In 2025, Yang et al. ( 7 ) design a Pinwheel-shaped Convolution (PConv) and scale-based dynamic loss. PConv is employed instead of standard convolutions in the lower layers of the backbone network because it better aligns with the Gaussian-like spatial distribution of infrared small target, enhances feature extraction, expands the receptive field, and employs only a minimal increase in parameters. Even if several loss functions combine scale and location losses, they do not adequately account for the varying sensitivity of these losses across different target scales. To address this problem, a scale-based dynamic (SD) Loss dynamically adjusts the influence of scale and location losses based on target size. Employing PConv and SD Loss into previous SOTA algorithms, experiments on the IRSTD-1K and SIRST-UAVB dataset, show significant performance improvements. Yue et al. ( 115 ) propose a Shallow-Deep Synergistic detection Network (SDS-Net 24 24 24 https://github.com/PhysiLearn/SDS-Net ) which models multilevel feature representations to enhance both the detection accuracy and computational time. First, a dual-branch architecture separately models the structural characteristics and semantic properties of features keeping shallow spatial details while capturing deep semantic representations. Second, SDSNet employs an adaptive feature fusion module to dynamically model cross-layer feature correlations. Experiments on the NUAA-SIRST, NUDT-SIRST, and IRSTD-1K dataset show that SDS-Net outperforms Top-Hat, WSLCM, IPI ( 382 ) , ACM ( 37 ) , ALCNet ( 312 ) , RDIAN ( 202 ) , ISTDU-Net ( 159 ) , IAANet ( 378 ) , DNA-Net ( 53 ) , UIU-Net ( 155 ) , and SCTransNet ( 285 ) . In 2025, Zhu et al. ( 46 ) design a lightweight Hierarchical nested U-shaped Network (HNU-Net) which improve the traditional dense nested structure, using multiple independent U-shaped sub-networks to reduce the semantic gap between the encoder and the decoder, and avoid the fine-grained information of small targets from being submerged in complex and densely nested structures. More specifically, HNU-Net consists of three modules: 1) an Hierarchical Nested Interaction Module (HNIM) which transmits information between the encoder and the decoder, 2) a Multi-scale Residual Block (MSRB) which extracts the features of the input feature map at multiple scales, and 3) a Channel-wise Spatial Attention (CSA) which combines the information of the encoder and the decoder across features and captures fine-grained information through the multi-head mechanism. Experiments on the NUAA-SIRST, NUDT-SIRST, and WideIRSTD datasets show that HNU-Net reduces the parameter quantity by more than 20 % 20\% while increasing the average intersection over union (IoU). In an other work, Lu et al. ( 100 ) develop a Multi-Scale Context Aggregation Network (MSCA-Net 25 25 25 https://github.com/YonghengSun1997/MSCA-Net ) which improves feature preservation and global-local fusion. MSCA-Net consists of three modules: the Multi-Scale Enhanced Dilated Attention Module (MSEDA), the Positional Convolutional Block Attention Module (PCBAM), and the Channel Aggregation Module (CAB).
MSEDA captures contextual information across different receptive fields keeping fine-grained features. PCBAM enhances spatial understanding by modeling position-aware dependencies. CAB adaptively aggregates multi-level features across channels to highlight key information. Experiments show that MSCA-Net performs well for strong small target detection performance in complex backgrounds. In 2025, Chen et al. ( 401 ) design a Dynamic Content-Guided Attention Multiscale Feature Aggregation Network (DCGANet). First, a Selective Variable Convolution (SVC) module integrates the advantages of standard convolution, irregular deformable convolution, and multi-rate dilated convolution. SVC expands the receptive field and improves non-local features. Second, a two-stage content-guided attention module focuses to salient regions within the feature maps and determines whether these regions correspond to targets or background interference. Third, an Adaptive Dynamic Feature Fusion (ADFF) module allows DCGANet to adaptively integrate contextual features. Experiments demonstrate that DCGANet outperforms ALCNet ( 312 ) , AGPCNet ( 245 ) , SCTransNet ( 285 ) , SeRankDet ( 433 ) and DCGADet. In 2026, in the category of detection based methods , Liu et al. ( 101 ) propose SEF-DETR which refines query initialization and comprises three components: Frequency-guided Patch Screening (FPS), Dynamic Embedding Enhancement (DEE), and Reliability-Consistency-aware Fusion (RCF). FPS exploits the Fourier spectrum of local patches to obtain a target-relevant density map. DEE enhances multi-scale representations in a target-aware manner. RCF refines object queries by enforcing spatial-frequency consistency and reliability. Experiments demonstrate that SEF-DETR outperforms detection based method (PConv ( 7 ) , NS-FPN ( 346 ) ) and segmentation based methods (ACM ( 37 ) , ISNet ( 73 ) , ACLNet, DNA-Net). Chen et al. ( 144 ) design a method named IRST-RTDETR 26 26 26 https://github.com/amumu77-lang/IRST-RTDETR . First, a global Contrast Perception-Guided Edge-Adaptive Sharpening preprocessing technique (GCP-TEAS) integrates global contrast and local edge information to improve the boundaries of low-significance targets. Second, a Cross-Stage Edge Feature Enhancement Module (CSEFEM), a Multi-Scale Multi-Head Self-Attention Fusion module (MSMH-AIFI), and a Gated Edge Feature Fusion module (GEFC3) improve small target detail retention, edge representation, and robustness through edge enhancement, cross-scale modeling, and gated modulation, respectively. Experiments show that IRST-RTDETR achieves F1 score improvements over previous SOTA methods. In an other work, Li et al. ( 405 ) design a Multi-Scale Feature Enhancement Network (MSFE-Net). First, a Cascading Feature Fusion Module (CFFM) and a Weighted Dilated Convolutional Pyramid (WDCP) improve shallow texture and deep semantic features, respectively. Second, a Weighted Feature Fusion Enhancement Module (WFFEM) learns differential and combined features across multiple branches. Finally, a Multi-scale Feature Stairstep-upsampling Fusion Module (MFSFM) refines high-resolution texture and semantic features. Experiments on the NWPU VHR-10 dataset show that MSFE-Net provides 92.8 % 92.8\% in mAP50 and 62.6 % 62.6\% in mAP75 outperforming methods based on YOLOv6 and YOLOv7. In 2026, in the category of segmentation based methods , He et al. ( 102 ) design an Attention-Guided Multi-scale Feature fusion Network (AGMFNet). First, a Multi-Scale Receptive Field Expansion module (MRFE) structure allows to integrate non-local context information and broaden the acceptance domain. Second, a dual-branch weighting mechanism increases the performance of the model and reduces the complexity of the model through a dynamic modification of the channel weights. Third, a three-Level Asymmetric Cross layer Fusion (TACF) mechanism allows to achieve the effective integration of the low-level, middle-level and high-level features, and ensure that the model can not only capture the details but also the semantics. The loss function mitigate the imbalance between the background and the target of an infrared image. Experiments show that AGMFNet outperforms ISTDU-Net ( 159 ) , MTU-Net ( 284 ) , AGPCNet, DNA-Net ( 53 ) , UIU-Net ( 155 ) , DMFNet ( 434 ) , and TODENet ( 435 ) . Zhang et al. ( 116 ) develop a Hierarchical Perception Fusion Network (HPFNet). First, a Patch-Wise Context Feature Extraction module (PCFE) employs a Patch Nonlocal Block, convolutional blocks and attention mechanism to capture global–local feature extraction and enhancement Second, a Multi-Level Sparse Cross-Fusion module (MSCF) performs cross-level feature interaction between encoder and decoder representations allowing fusion between low-level spatial details and high-level semantic cues. A dual Top-K sparsification mechanism filters irrelevant background features allowing the attention mechanism to focus more on the target region. Third, an Efficient Upsampling Module (EUM) combines upsampling with multi-branch dilated convolutions improve feature reconstruction and improve localization accuracy. Experiments show that HPFNet provides similar performance than ISNet and UIU-Net suppresing occasional false alarms and missed detections under challenging conditions. Zhang et al. ( 127 ) design a scale-adaptive framework named SAFARI-Net which consists of a scale-adaptive processing pipeline dynamically adjusting strategies based on estimated target characteristics, a frequency-aware feature extraction module with learnable parameters improving target saliency across spectral components, and a progressive memory refinement mechanism keeping representations. A triple-path encoder processes spatial, frequency, and contextual information vie dedicated pathways with bidirectional refinement for comprehensive enhancement. An adaptive clutter suppression mechanism modulates response based on scale predictions. Experiments show that SAFARI-Net achieves 95.77 % 95.77\% IoU on the NUDT-SIRST dataset and 70.17 % 70.17\% on the IRSTD-1 dataset with improvements for micro-scale targets. Zhao et al. ( 398 ) propose a Morphology-Edge Enhanced Triple-cascaded Network (MEETNet) which uses a triple-cascaded architecture that keeps high resolution and improves information interaction between different stages. MEETNet employs an Edge-Detail Enhanced Module (EDEM) and a Detail-Aware Multi-Scale Fusion Module (DMSFM). These modules provide edge-detail enhanced features related to contrast and edge information enhancing target saliency and edge representation. DMSFM employs a multireceptive field mechanism to merge target details with deep semantic insights. Experiments on the NUAA-SIRST and NUDT-SIRST datasets show that MEETNet outperforms previous SOTA methods. In 2026, in the category of real-time algorithm , Jin et al. ( 117 ) design an Efficient Convolution and Multiscale Feature Fusion Network (ECMSFNet 27 27 27 https://github.com/liubiaohua/ECMSFNet ) based on convolution and attention-guided Multiscale Feature Weighting and Fusion (MSFWF). First, a Dual-Branch Hybrid Convolution (DBHConv) module extracts infrared small target features. Second a Three-Branch Attention-Guided (TBAG) module improves the input features from both spatial and channel dimensions. Third, a MSFWF module is employed at the added detection head to adaptively weight the features and optimize the feature propagation path. Experimental show that ECMSFNet outperforms previous approaches with a real-time detection speed of 74.63 frames/s. In an other work, Kong et al. ( 399 ) propose a Context-Aware and Semantic-Guided Adaptive Filtering Network (CSAFNet 28 28 28 https://github.com/LingchuanK/CSAFNet ). First, a Parallel Self-Awareness Attention (PSAA) exploits physical priors to capture global context and incorporates wavelet transforms to strengthen local detail. Second, a Cross-Semantic Adaptive Filtering Module (CAFM) in feature fusion deeply explores information from shallow features and improves the relative saliency of target representations. Third, a Dynamic Multiscale Spatial Pyramid (DMSSP) module enhances edge precision and segmentation accuracy. Experiments on the NUAA-SIRST and IRSTD-1K datasets show that CSAFNet outperforms previous SOTA methods. In other work, Guo et al. ( 118 ) develop a Multiscale Sparse Large-Kernel Network (MSSLNet 29 29 29 https://github.com/xiaodacheng01/msslnet-main ). A Sparse Large-Kernel Convolution block (SLCB) employs a sparse-dense dual-branch design to boost target detection while keeping critical information flow. A Multiscale Sparse Large-kernel Block (MSSLB) model contextual information for target-background separation improved by a cross-gated module (CGM). A Bidirectional Guided Fusion (BGF) module optimizes cross-layer detail-semantic fusion within skip connections. MSSLNet is deployable with only 0.293 M parameters and 2.99 GFLOPs. Experiments on the NUAA-SIRST and IRSTD-1K datasets show that MSSLNet provides similar performance than SOTA algorithms in both accuracy and efficiency. In 2026, Zhao et al. ( 402 ) design a Multiscale Local Intensity and Gradient Network (MLIGNet) which embeds model-driven priors into a unified convolutional architecture. MLIGNet is based on the Intensity and Gradient Encoding Block which exploits morphological cues by encoding local intensity and gradient responses. A Crossing Fusion Module realizes semantic alignment between heterogeneous features. A Multiscale Fusion Module aggregates cross-scale information to increase robustness against variations in target size and signal-to-noise ratio. A lightweight dilated convolutional enlarge the receptive field without compromising spatial resolution. Experiments on the SIRST and NUDT-SIRST datasets show that MLIGNet offers a suitable balance between detection accuracy and computational efficiency. In an other work, He et al. ( 403 ) develop a Multi-scale Fusion and Attention Mechanism Guidance Network (MFAGNet). First, an Hybrid Dual Encoder (HDE) achieves feature-level denoising while extracting features. Second, a Multi-Scale Expansion Attention Module (MEAM) improves feature extraction ability by combining separable convolutions with channel attention mechanisms. Third, a Pixel-level Attention Module (PAM) allows optimization of features encoded by the encoder. Experiments on the ISDD dataset show that MFAGNet achieves an mIoU of 74.12 % 74.12\% , a Precision of 99.33 % 99.33\% , and a reduced Fa of 0.0002477 0.0002477 . In an other work, Zhang et al. ( 103 ) propose a Multi-aspect Feature Extraction and Fusion Network (MFEFNet) which consist of three modules: a Multi-Shape Receptive Field Extraction Module (MSRFEM), a Spatial-Channel-Global-Local Joint Re-extraction Module (SCGLJRM), and a Multi-Scale Cross-Attention Mechanism (MSCAM). MSRFEM exploits dilated deformable convolutions and the Res2Net architecture to capture multi-scale and multi-shape target characteristics as well as locally correlated features. SCGLJRM improves global context modeling across spatial and channel dimensions by aggregating complementary local-global information with a cascade of Local spatial-Local channel (LL), local spatial-Global Channel (GC), and global spatial-Local Channel (LC) sub-modules. MSCAM mitigates the feature fusion imbalance in Transformer-based cross-attention by employing correlation matrix transposition and fusion before integrating with feature maps. Experiments on the SIRST, IRSTD-1K, and NUDT-SIRST datasets show that MFEFNet provides superior detection accuracy compared to several SOTA methods. In 2026, in the context of ship detection , Wang et al. ( 99 ) design a Far-shore-Guided Object-focusing Multiscale network with real-time detection Transformer (FGOM-RTDETR) which use multiscale local and global features. A Feature Grouping Module (FGOM) improves multiscale representation and comprises three components: a Feature Reparameterization (FRep) module, a Coordinate Attention Golden Feature Pyramid Network (CAGoldFPN), and a Multiscale Stacked Network (MuSSNet). FRep addresses the loss of channel information due to the small size of thermal infrared ship targets and the complexity of background features. CAGoldFPN enhances multiscale feature fusion. MuSSNet mitigates issues of high target similarity and the susceptibility of small targets to being overlooked. Experiments show that FGOM-RTDETR provides performance gains: precision increases from 0.921 to 0.942, mAP50 increases from 0.938 to 0.958, and recall increases from 0.923 to 0.934. Li and Gui ( 404 ) propose
a Multi-Scale Direction-Aware Network (MSDA-Net 30 30 30 https://github.com/YuChuang1205/MSDA-Net ) which integrates the high-frequency directional features as domain prior knowledge into neural networks. First, a High-Frequency Direction Injection (HFDI) module without trainable parameters injects the high-frequency directional information of the original image into the network. Second, a Multi-Scale Direction-Aware (MSDA) module promotes the full extraction of local relations at different scales and the full perception of key features in different directions. Third, a Feature Aggregation (FA) structure handle target disappearance in high-level feature maps. Finally, Feature Calibration Fusion (FCF) module avoids feature bias during cross-layer feature fusion. Experiments show that MSDA-Net outperforms RPCA-Net, ALCNet ( 312 ) , DNA-Net ( 53 ) , UIU-Net ( 155 ) , ISNet ( 73 ) , ILNet, MSHNet ( 40 ) , MMLNet and SDSNet. In 2026, Li et al. ( 6 ) design a Multi-scale Attention Residual network (MAR-UNet 31 31 31 https://github.com/DearAida/MARUnet ) which is based on a Hierarchical Contextual Enhancement Aggregation (HCEA). It adaptively enhances target features. First, a Multi-Granularity Feature Extraction (MGFE) module integrates standard convolutions, Centered Differential Convolutions (CDC), and Dilated Convolutions (DC) to capture both local high-frequency gradients and long-range contextual information. Second, a Linear Cross-Channel Attention (LCCA) module models global channel dependencies with linear complexity and dynamically adjust attention weights. Third, a convolutional FeedForward Network (FFN) with 3 × 3 3\times 3 convolutions refines feature boundaries. Experiments on the NUAA-SIRST, NUDT-SIRST, and IRSTD-1K show that MAR-UNet outperforms
ACM ( 37 ) , ALCNet ( 312 ) , RDIAN ( 202 ) , FC3-Net ( 211 ) , DNA-Net ( 53 ) , UIU-Net ( 155 ) , IRSAM ( 168 ) , L2SKNet ( 214 ) and SCTransNet ( 285 ) .
