blocks.en: 4.7 Guidance Mechanisms
blocks.zh: 4.7 指导机制

blocks.en: The existing guidance mechanisms concern features guidance, motion guidance, saliency guidance, memory guidance, feedback guidance, geometry guidance, ODE guidance and fuzzy-logic guidaentrnce. Table 6 shows an overview of these diverse guidance mechanisms.
blocks.zh: 现有的指导机制涉及指导、运动指导、显著指导、内存指导、反馈指导、几何指导、ODE指导和模糊逻辑保障。 表6概述了这些不同的指导机制。

blocks.en: Table 6 : Guidance Mechanisms: An Overview (116 papers).
blocks.zh: 表6:指导机制:概述(116份文件)。

blocks.en:
1. Causal Guidance: Most of the existing methods are target-centered by directly learning the target features from backgrounds. They are facing difficulties in effectively capturing stable features due to weak target signals. To address this problem, Duan et al. ( 436 ) design a Causal-guided Hierarchical Anomaly-aware Learning (CHAL) framework. CHAL focuses on background learning and the targets are considered as the anomalies in backgrounds. First, a spatio-temporal neural field models the background evolution patterns from generative perspective. Second, a hierarchical anomaly-aware learning decomposes anomaly discovery. Third, a causal-guiding mechanism allows to block the spurious correlations often caused by background confounders, and enhance true target causality. Experiments show that CHAL outperforms single-frame data-based models and multi-frame data-based models. 2. Prior Guidance: Small target is prone to feature attenuation during downsampling and false-alarm amplification during multilevel feature fusion. To address these issue, Zhang et al. ( 210 ) design in 2026 a dual-prior guided network with cross-scale calibration and Pixel-Selective Gated Dusion (PSGF). First, a depth-aware prior module integrates a Radial Flux Consistency Prior (RFCP) to suppress structural clutter. Second, a Local Directional Saliency Prior (LDSP) information enhance the isotropic small targets. Third, a multiscale feature interaction module aligns cross-scale representations through channel calibration and contextual aggregation to avoid cross-scale bias. The PSGF module adaptively balances shallow spatial details and deep semantic features to avoid background interference while keeping target integrity. Experiments on the SIRST, NUDT-SIRST, and IRSTD-1K datasets show that PSGF outperforms several previous methods. 3. Features Guidance: To address the low-contrast between small targets and noisy background in infrared images, Zhang et al. ( 211 ) design a FC3-Net 32 32 32 https://github.com/IPIC-Lab/SIRST-Detection-FC3-Net by exploring feature compensation and cross-level correlation. More specifically, FC3-Net consists of a Fine-detail guided Multi-level Feature Compensation (F-MFC) module, and a Cross-level Feature Correlation (CFC) module. First, the F-MFC module compensates the information loss of details due to the downsampling layers in CNN by aggregating features from multiple adjacent levels. To address the background noise, the CFC module employs an energy filtering kernel based on the higher-level features with less background noise to filter out the noise in the middle-level features. Finally, it fuses them with the low-level ones to learn a strong target representation. Using them into the encoder-decoder structure, the FC3-Net produces a more accurate target mask with a better shape and details. In 2024, Lee and Park ( 278 ) design a Hybrid Network based on Hierarchical Multipatch Feature Encoder (HMAMFU-Net 33 33 33 https://github.com/skylih87/HMAMFU-net ). The encoder divides the image into multiple small pieces and stacks them hierarchically to extract features. HMAMFU-Net offers a hybrid encoder structure that combines a convolution-based multiscale encoder to extract local information and a hierarchical-based multipatch encoder to extract global information by running in parallel. Thee loss function fuses the hierarchical information obtained from each layer. Experiments on the NUDT-SIRST and NUAA-SIRST datasets show that HMAMFU-net outperforms several SOTA algorithms. Guo et al. ( 57 ) develop a Location-Guided Dense nested attention Network (LGDNet). LGDNet comprises a Pixel Attention Guided Feature Extraction Module (PAG-FEM), a Channel Attention Guided Feature Fusion Module (CAG-FFM), and a detection module. PAG-FEM employs the DNIM dense nested blocks from the DNA-Net as the backbone, integrating both channel and pixel attention mechanisms. Second, CAG-FFM uses upsampling and convolution operations to align the feature sizes, while using the channel attention mechanism to obtain channel information. Third, these features are fused via stacking, addition, and averaging operations to obtain discriminative features. The detection module empoys eight-connected neighborhood clustering method to obtain the centroid coordinates of the targets for subsequent detection evaluation. Experiments show that LGDNet provides better results than previous SOTA methods. In 2025, Chen et al. ( 74 ) develop a hybrid deep-learning framework that combines dense spatial heatmap supervision with geometry-aware regression (PSHNet). It generates position–scale heatmaps to guide coarse localization, which are refined through sub-pixel offset and size regression. A Complete IoU (CIoU) loss is employed as a geometric regularization term to enhance alignment between predicted and ground-truth bounding boxes. An Enhanced Low-level Feature Module (ELFM) is incorporated using multi-scale dilated convolutions and channel attention to preserve fine spatial details. Experiments on the NUDT-SIRST and IRSTD-1k datasets show that PSHNet outperforms DNA-Net ( 53 ) and ALCNet ( 312 ) in IoU, detection probability, and false alarm rate. In an other work, Xu et al. ( 461 ) design an infrared small target detection method based on Weak Feature Enhancement and Target Adaptive Proliferation (IRSTD-WFETAP). First, a sparse sampling mechanism and hybrid filtering method capture the complex shapes and edge information of small targets while reducing the loss and shift of scarce features. Second, a multiscale feature enhancement module employs a vertical-horizontal bidirectional attention and a multiscale feature encoding to obtain stable feature interaction channels between the encoder and decoder. Third, a Target Data Self-Adaptive proliferation Strategy (DSAS) allows to address the imbalance of positive and negative samples for generalization and expression capability. A target-background joint loss alleviate the imbalance issue and help the network converge smoothly. Experiments on the NUAA-SIRST and IRSTD-1k datasets show that IRSTD-WFETAP provides better performance in nIoU, Pd, Fa, and F1-measure compared to previous methods. In 2025, Liu et al. ( 55 ) propose a Prior Guided Network (PGDN-Net) which combines traditional manual features with a deep learning network model. First, three prior features are extracted namely the high-order Riesz transform feature, the compactness and heterogeneity feature (CH), and the corner feature of the structure tensor (ST). Second, these features are input into a dense nested network for guidance with a two-orientation attention aggregation module and a channel and spatial attention module. Each feature offers their respective guiding roles in different depths. Experiments show that PGDN-Net provides better performance in background suppression, target enhancement, probability of detection, and false alarm rate than previous algorithms. Liu et al. ( 449 ) develop a lightweight detection network named MDS-DWGANet which comprises a Multi-Directional Sparse Convolution module (MDSC) and a Dynamic Weight Guided Attention module (DWGA). First, MDSC constructs sparse convolution branches in four directions (horizontal, vertical, and two diagonals) to simulate directional gradient responses, and uses a sparse gating mechanism to focus on high-response edge regions, maintaining structural awareness while reducing parameter overhead. Second, a Dynamic Weight Guided Attention module (DWGA) mitigates feature dilution and attention drift by integrating four attention pathways with a dynamic channel allocation mechanism. Practically, DWGA can be considered as a deep generalization of regional contrast enhancement. Experiments on the NUDT-SIRST and IRSTD-1 K datasets show that MDS-DWGANet provides 98.30 % 98.30\% in detection probability (Pd) and 93.04 % 93.04\% in mean Intersection over Union (mIoU) with 1.4 1.4 M parameters. In 2025, Ma et al. ( 450 ) design an Orthogonal Inputs Perception Fusion (OIPF) network to capture the learnable target features in deeper layers without increasing network depth. The orthogonal data pairs through intensity inversion and enhancement are then fed into a dual-input framework to provide incremental information flow. Second, a Relationally Aware Module (RAM) generates spatial weight maps by exploiting the relationships between data pairs across layers. Extensive experiments show that OIPF significantly improves ISTD performance. Yang et al. ( 453 ) develop an Attention-Guided Dual Feature Extraction (AGDFE 34 34 34 https://github.com/wwwyangxiaoyucom/new-network ) network which comprises two levels of feature extraction: a multi-scale feature extraction mechanism and a contextual feature extraction mechanism. First, the multi-scale feature extraction mechanism implements the feature extraction operation of the first layer. Thus, the information interaction between neighboring layers is done by fusing and splicing the features of different layers. Second, the target attention mechanism enhances the model’s attention to small targets and offers effective attention allocation for the detection of small infrared targets. Third, the multi-resolution feature interaction mechanism preserves the detail information and improves the ability to perceive small targets. The contextual feature extraction mechanism implements the second-level feature extraction operation background environments. Experiments show that the AGDFE provides 99.81 % 99.81\% vs. 87.58 % 87.58\% Precision, 98.96 % 98.96\% vs. 88.12 % 88.12\% Recall, 99.38 % 99.38\% vs. 87.85 % 87.85\% F-measure and 98.77 % 98.77\% vs. 78.33 % 78.33\% mIoU on NUDT-SIRST and SIRST Aug datasets, respectively. In 2025, in the context of generalization in the presence of unseen scenes , Chi et al. ( 452 ) develop a contrast-invariant feature extraction framework for Single-domain Generalization (SGIRNet). First, a Contrast Modulation module (CM) addresses the feature domain gap by interleaving enhancement and suppression operations. Second, a Position and Channel Invariant Feature extraction Module (PCIFM) extracts target features that are not affected by contrast changes. SGIRNet is integrated into several existing models to evaluate the performance. Experiments show that SGIRNet improves the detection performance of existing models in the unseen domain providing superior generalization ability. In 2025, in the context of MIRST , Peng et al. ( 451 ) develop a Spatio-Temporal feature fusion networks (STME 35 35 35 https://github.com/UESTC-nnLab/STME ) which comprises two parallel feature extraction branches. The fist one extracts temporal features across entire video clip. The second one isolates spatial features from a selected key frame. A self-refining module allows to adaptively adjust the extracted temporal features and fusing spatio-temporal features at different scales Extensive experiments show that STME reduces floating point operations per second (FLOPs). In 2025, in the context fo plug and play component , Lu et al. ( 108 ) design a Dual Geometry-Guided Experts Network (DGGENet) based on the Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) paradigm with a Target-Background Decoupling Module (TBDM). Specifically, TBDM uses a geometry-guided dynamic routing mechanism functioning as an adaptive gating network. Thus, it continuously analyzes input features to dynamically establish two specialized expert groups. The first one is dedicated to target channels and the seoond one is dedicated to background channels. Each group functions as a sub-network specialized for its assigned feature subspace. Using the RPCA principles, the inter-group expert iteration promotes low-rank background and sparse target representations during collaborative feature refinement. Second; a cross fusion module acts as state feedback allowing semantically consistent interaction between the optimized representations. This closed-loop interaction explicitly models target-background correlations. Experiments show that DGGENet) provides superior performance on the NUDT-SIRST dataset and the IRSTD-1K dataset. TBDM is thus a versatile plug-and-play component which improved diverse ISTD frameworks. In 2026, Liu et al. ( 47 ) design a Perceptual Query Guided Network PQGNet. First, a Perceptual Query Supervision Mechanism (PQGNet 36 36 36 https://github.com/PepperCS/PQGNet ) employs a perceptual loss to constrain spatial feature learning of each encoder layer. Second, a Perceptual Feature Construction Module (PFCM) captures perceptual features to preserve target localization information. Third, a Perceptual Query Quidance Module (PQGM) employs a cross-attention to guide global and regional feature queries through skip connections, optimizing target feature extraction. A max pooling-wavelet hybrid layer (MWHL) and high-frequency enhanced wavelet layer (HEWL) exploit discrete wavelet transform properties to improve deep semantic representations using shallow high-frequency details. Experiments on the NUDT-SIRST, NUAA-SIRST, and IRSTD-1K datasets demonstrate that PQGNet outperforms SOTA methods with a competitive balance between computational complexity and accuracy. In 2025, Li et al. ( 86 ) propose a Hybrid Mamba–CNN UNet (HMCNet). Its hybrid architecture allows to extract the local features and model the global context. Experiments on IRSTD-1k and MISTD ( 86 ) dataset show that HMCNet outperforms RLCM, MPCM, PSTNN and RDIAN ( 202 ) with high-speed inference capabilities. Lu and Zhang ( 10 ) integrate a visual Mamba module into a lightweight CNN-based network which combines the ability of CNNs to model local features and a visual Mamba module captures long-distance global features. Therefore, this model extract both local and long-distance global feature information. Experiments on the NUAA-SIRST and NUAA-SIRSTv2 datasets show that this model provides better accuracy and lower computational complexity. In 2025, Li et al. ( 86 ) propose a Hybrid Mamba–CNN UNet (HMCNet). Its hybrid architecture allows to extract the local features and model the global context. Experiments on IRSTD-1k and MISTD ( 86 ) dataset show that HMCNet outperforms RLCM, MPCM, PSTNN and RDIAN ( 202 ) with high-speed inference capabilities. Lu and Zhang ( 10 ) integrate a visual Mamba module into a lightweight CNN-based network which combines the ability of CNNs to model local features and a visual Mamba module captures long-distance global features. Therefore, this model extract both local and long-distance global feature information. Experiments on the NUAA-SIRST and NUAA-SIRSTv2 datasets show that this model provides better accuracy and lower computational complexity. In 2026, in the context of gradient features , Wang et al. ( 455 ) propose a Gradient-Compensation-based Feature Learning Network (GCFLNet) based on a multi-module collaborative design to improve feature representation and fusion. First, an Edge Enhancement Module (EEM) captures fine-grained edge information while suppressing background noise via smoothing operations. Thus, the extracted edge features are embedded into a Global–Local Feature Interaction (GLFI) module. A Multi-Scale Information Compensation (MSIC) module exploits the complementary characteristics of multi-scale features across spatial and channel dimensions, guiding efficient fusion of high-level and low-level information. Experiments on the NUDT and IRSTD-1K datasets show that GCFLNet outperforms outperforms filter-based approaches (Top-Hat, Max–Median), local contrast-based methods (TLLCM, WSLCM), model-based methods (RIPT, IPI), and data-based approaches (UIU-Net ( 155 ) , DNA-Net ( 53 ) , RDIAN ( 202 ) ) in heterogeneous backgrounds. Du et al. ( 456 ) design a Dual-Path Edge-Guided Frequency-Aware Network (DEFANet) which allow edge-target collaborative modeling for enhanced feature representation. DEFANet features comprises a main branch for holistic target modeling and an edge branch for boundary transition perception. A two core modules: Frequency-Aware Dual Enhancement Module (FADE) and Edge-Guided Integration Module (EGI) allow interaction and representation in both branches. First, FADE uses a Frequency-Decoupled Attention Enhancement Mechanism to enhance both branches in the frequency domain, strengthening holistic modeling in the main branch and boundary representation in the edge branch. Second, EGI exploits a Dual-Path Group-Wise Guidance Mechanism to integrate edge features into the main branch. Experiments show that DEFANet provides similar performance than MDvsFA ( 243 ) , LAFT, SIRST, and SIATD. Yang and Cui ( 457 ) develop an Edge-Shape Enhanced Network (ESE-Net) which enhance edge feature representations to improve target discrimination. First, a Multiscale Spatial Edge Attention (MSEA) module enhances target edges by perceiving directional gradient changes. Second, an Edge Guidance Module (EGM) extracts edge features in the frequency domain through a wavelet transform and performs reversible down sampling, discarding low-frequency components before fusing with spatial features. Third, a Multiscale Group Convolution Module (MGCM) is integrated in deep layers to preserve target details and mitigate the risk of small target loss. Experiments on the NUAA-SIRST and IRSTD-1K datasets show that ESE-Net outperforms UIU-Net ( 155 ) , DNA-Net ( 53 ) , and RDIAN ( 202 ) . In 2026, Xu et al. ( 458 ) design a a Native-resolution feature extraction and fusion framework (Na-IRSTD) which employs native-resolution features to keep subtle target cues. An token reduction and selection strategy selects target patches with high accuracy and confidence, boosting the low-level details of the feature while effectively reducing native-resolution patch tokens compared to dense processing. Experiments show that Na-IRSTD outperforms models-based methods (NRAM ( 384 ) , PSTNN ( 383 ) ) and data based methods (ACM ( 37 ) , DNA-Net ( 53 ) , ISNet ( 73 ) , UIU-Net ( 155 ) , RPCANet ( 529 ) , IRMamba, SAIST ( 249 ) ). Li et al. ( 454 ) propose a Spatial-Frequency Feature Learning Network (SFLNet) which attempt to solve the challenges in small target detection through collaborative modeling of the spatial and frequency domains. First, SFLNet adopts an edge-guided decoder structure that preserves the structural integrity and shape information of small targets during reconstruction. Second, this module employs a spatial–frequency joint learning mechanism that allows complementary and enhanced information exchange between the spatial and frequency domains. Experiments show that SFLNet outperforms previous SOTA algorithms in precise localization of targets and preservation of target shapes. 4. Reconstruction Guidance: In 2026, Yan et al. ( 222 ) design a target-aware invertible encoder (InvDet 37 37 37 https://github.com/SchulerYan/InvDet/tree/main ) that combines information preservation and target-aware enhancement within a reconstruction-guided detection framework. First, an invertible pathway builds the input from feature latents considering information loss as an optimizable quantity. Second, a Target-Aware Reconstruction Modulation (TARM) module operates only in the inverse path. Third, a Geometry–Content Tolerance Metric (GCTM) focuses on truly informative regions and yields a pixel-wise weight map that regularizes the reconstruction branch. 5. Semantic Guidance: Most of deep neural networks methods suffers from semantic degradation when transferring high-level features from deep to shallow layers, limiting the precise localization of small targets. To address this problem, several researches propose to employ semantic guidance. In 2024, Ma et al. ( 484 ) develop a small target detection network based on High- and Low-Frequency Semantic Reconstruction (HLSR-net) to suppress background clutter interference and to extract sparse features of targets. First, high-frequency target and low-frequency background features are extracted separately via fast Fourier frequency transformation. Second, target enhancement and background suppression are carried out through the designed high- and low-frequency reconstruction networks, respectively. Third, a fusion output strategy provides the detection of small targets. Experiment show HLSR-net achieves better performance with an accuracy improvement of 6 % 6\% . Xiao et al. ( 486 ) ) design a Background-Aware Feature Exchange Network (BAFE-Net 38 38 38 https://github.com/GrokCV/BAFE-Net ) which is a multi-task architecture that jointly addresses target detection and background semantic segmentation. BAFE-Net employs a dynamic cross-task feature hard-exchange mechanism allowing effective exchange of target and background semantics between the two tasks. Experiments on the DenseSIRST dataset show that BAFE-Net outperforms ACM ( 37 ) , UIU-Net ( 155 ) , MTU-Net ( 284 ) , DNA-Net ( 53 ) , RDIAN ( 202 ) , URAnet ( 367 ) , ABCNet ( 530 ) and SeRankDet ( 433 ) . Hu et al. ( 531 ) design a scene semantic prior-assisted infrared ship detection using multitask perception network (SMPISD-MTPNet 39 39 39 https://github.com/greekinRoma/SMPISD-MTPNet ). This network is based on multitask perception: one task predict targets, and the other focuses on scene perception to suppress false alarms caused by background interference. A Scene Semantic Extractor (SSE) guide the network according to the features extracted based on expert knowledge and the gradient-based module. A data augmentation is employed and a training trick named soft fine-tuning enhance the network’s generalization and suppress the distortion due to the augmentation process. Experiments on the IRSDSS datasets show that SMPISD-MTPNet outperforms previous SOTA methods. In 2025, Zhuang et al. ( 77 ) develop a Temporal-Semantic Interaction Network (TSI-Net) for multi-frame infrared small target detection. TSI-Net employs a Temporal Feature Extraction Module (TFEM) which allows to capture the motion characteristics of targets in consecutive frames. To tackle insufficient feature interaction, a Feature Interaction-Aware Module (FIAM) based on a multi-scale semantic interaction Transformer allows robust cross-level feature fusion. Finally, a multi-task weighted hybrid loss function allows to balance classification accuracy, region alignment, and pixel-level boundary delineation. Experiments on the NUDT-MIRSTD and SIATD datasets show that TSI-Net outperforms ALCNet ( 312 ) , DNA-Net ( 53 ) , UIU-Net ( 155 ) , MSLSTIPT ( 431 ) , ASTTV-NTLA ( 532 ) , IMNN-LWEC ( 532 ) and STDMANet ( 81 ) . Shi et al. ( 485 ) propose an Auxiliary Metadata Driven Infrared Small Target Detector (AuxDet 40 40 40 https://github.com/GrokCV/AuxDet ) to incorporate metadata into the IRSTD paradigm for scene-aware optimization. Using a high-dimensional fusion module, AuxDet dynamically employs metadata semantics with visual features, guiding adaptive representation learning for each individual sample. A lightweight prior-initialized enhancement module using 1D convolutional blocks refine fused features and recover fine-grained target cues. Experiments on the WideIRSTD-Full dataset demonstrate that AuxDet outperforms ALCNet ( 312 ) . In 2026, Ji et al. ( 104 ) propose a Three-Stage Networks (TSNet) using an encoder-decoder architecture with an upsampling-free subnetwork to fuse spatial and semantic information. The first two stages extracts semantic features viz a Patch-based Multi-scale Feature Enhancement Module (PMFEM). The final stage uses a sub-network without upsampling to avoid spatial information loss that occurs in traditional downsampling processes. This sub-network consists of a Cross-feature Fusion Block (CFB) combined with 2D Selective Scan (SS2D) to capture spatial information while employing high-level semantic features. Experiments on the SIRST, NUDT-SIRST, and IRSTD-1k datasets show that the TSNet outperforms ACM ( 37 ) , ALCNet ( 312 ) , DNA-Net ( 53 ) , UIU-Net ( 155 ) , TMNet, RDIAN ( 202 ) and AGPCNet ( 245 ) . In an other work, Wu et al. ( 481 ) design a Semantic-Detail Collaborative Network (SemDetNet). First, a background-aware global semantic module allows to enhance the discriminative representation of non-target regions through reverse compensation in multi-level downsampling. Second, a detail compensation module exploits shallow multi-granularity details. This module further exploits coarse-grained prediction masks to guide deep features, enabling semantic reconstruction and edge refinement. Experiments show that SemDetNet provides better results than HCFNet, MSHNet ( 40 ) , MTU-Net ( 284 ) and DNA-Net ( 53 ) . In an other work, Zhang et al. ( 482 ) propose a lightweight detection framework incorporating Frequency-aware and Semantic Guidance networks (FSGNet 41 41 41 https://github.com/Wangtao-Bao/FSGNet ). First, a multi-directional interactive attention module captures fine-grained and directional features. Second, a multi-scale frequency-aware module exploits Fast Fourier transform to preserve salient target structures. Third, a global pooling module captures high-level semantic information.Then, it is upsampled and propagated to each decoder stage via a global semantic guidance flows allowing semantic consistency and precise localization across scales. Experiments on the NUAASIRST, IRSTD-1K, NUDT-SIRST, and SIRSTAUG datasets show that outperforms ACM ( 202 ) , RDIAN ( 202 ) , AGPCNet ( 245 ) , DNA-Net ( 53 ) , UIU-Net ( 155 ) , RPCA-Net ( 533 ) , MSHNet ( 40 ) and L2SKNet ( 214 ) . Liao an Yin ( 483 ) design Camouflage-aware Counter-Distraction Network (CCDNet). First, a backbone with Weighted Multi-branch Perceptrons (WMPs), aggregates self-conditioned multi-level features to represent the target and background. Second, a Aggregation-and-Refinement Fusion Neck (ARFN) to refine structures/semantics from shallow/deep features maps, and bidirectionally obtain the relations between the targets and the backgrounds. Third, a Contrastive-aided Distractor Discriminator (CaDD), enforces adaptive similarity computation both locally and globally between the real targets and the backgrounds to discriminate distractors, so as to reduce the false alarm rate. Sang et al. ( 487 ) propose an Edge-Target Deep Semantic Consistency (ET-DSC 42 42 42 https://github.com/Yuweiw-1024/ET-DSC ) semantic adaptive balancing framework. In encoder, shallow-layer modeling and gated fusion enhance target boundaries. In decoder, semantic consistency constraints keep real boundaries and suppress false edges. A semantic allocation mechanism between shallow and deep layers allows cooperative optimization between edge compensation and semantic preservation. Experiments on the NUDT-SIRST and NUAA-SIRST datasets show that ET-DSC outperforms ACM ( 37 ) , UNet++ ( 59 ) , HCFNet, DNA-Net ( 53 ) , MTU-Net ( 284 ) and MSHNet ( 40 ) . Zhang et al. ( 106 ) propose a Semantic Density-Guided ResNet (SDG-ResNet). It is a plug-in backbone that attaches a lightweight semantic density head to the deepest stage and injects the predicted density map into intermediate layers through Semantic Density-Guided Refine (SDGR) blocks with residual spatial
gating. 6. Motion Guidance: Multi-frame approaches learn motion implicitly through deep neural networks but often require additional motion supervision or explicit alignment modules In 2026, Liu et al. ( 146 ) propose Motion Integration DETR (MI-DETR 43 43 43 https://github.com/nliu-25/MI-DETR ) bio-inspired with a dual-pathway detector which processes one infrared frame per time step while modeling motion. First, a Retina-inspired Cellular Automaton (RCA) converts raw frame sequences into a motion map defined on the same pixel grid as the appearance image. RPCA allows parvocellular-like appearance and magnocellular-like motion pathways to be supervised by a single set of bounding boxes without extra motion labels or alignment operations. Second, a Parvocellular-Magnocellular Interconnection (PMI) Block allows a bidirectional feature interaction between the two pathways giving a biologically motivated intermediate interconnection mechanism. Third, a RT-DETR decoder employs features from the two pathways to provide detection results. Experiments on the ITSDT-15K, IRDST-H, and DAUB-R datasets show that MI-DETR outperforms single frame detection methods (SANet ( 200 ) , AGPCNet ( 245 ) , RDIAN ( 202 ) , DNA-Net ( 53 ) , RPCA-Net ( 533 ) , L2SKNet ( 214 ) ) and multi-frame detection methods (SSTNet ( 152 ) ). Zhang et al. ( 274 ) design a Motion-guided Spatial–Temporal integrated Network (MIST-Net). First, the input strategy encodes the dominant motion characteristics across multiple consecutive frames using series expansion and temporal motion intensity analysis. This strategy allows to build a motion frame that enforces motion information from several frames into one. The motion frame and target frame are then fed into the integrated network to extract motion and spatial features, respectively. Second, a Mutual Calibration Module (MCM) refine the motion maps using spatial cues and improves the spatial maps with motion information. Third, a semantic gap between motion and spatial features is obtained by using a Motion-Spatial-Coupled selective state space Module (MSCM). MSCM dynamically adjusts the fusion of motion and spatial information. Experiments on SIRST and ITSDT-15K datasets show that MIST-Net outperforms previous SOTA algorithms. Zhang et al. ( 275 ) propose MOCID 44 44 44 https://github.com/TanzanOY/MOCID which is a spatio-temporal backbone with Fourier-inspired Spatio-temporal Attention (FISTA) layers. Each FISTA layer sequentially processes the features from spatial and temporal views to capture clip-level temporal motion context. This context is then embedded into dynamic convolutional kernels for subsequent spatial feature extraction allowing motion difference guidance and generating features. For frame-level feature fusion, a Displacement-aware Mamba Module (DAM) capture detailed frame-to-frame displacement information. DAM employs a Temporal Interpolation and Displacement-aware Scan method to perform spatio-temporal difference-aware displacement modeling. Thus, MOCID capture motion and displacement contexts, Experiments on the IRDST and DAUB datasets how that MOCID provides a superior balance between throughput and performance compared to other methods. 7. Saliency Guidance: Most of the conventional deep neural networks struggle to perceive the sensitivity of small targets and adopt heavy constructions to preserve potential target features ignoring domain-specific insights and suffering from poor explainability. In 2025, Wu et al. ( 214 ) attempt to address this problem by revisiting the saliency principles and develop a Learnable Local Saliency Kernel Network (L2SKNet 45 45 45 https://github.com/fengyiwu98/L2SKNet ). A learnable Local Saliency Kernel Module (LLSKM) employs the concept of “Center subtracts Neighbors,” guiding the network to capture the saliency features. In addition LLSKM uses a strategic dilation and is refined into a more compact form by factorizing it into two orthogonal 1-D kernels making it lightweight. Experiments show that L2SKNet outperforms previous methods. 8. Physics-Informed Guidance: Conventional SAM-based detectors are based on external prompts and encoders pretrained with natural images. This training limits their practicality when prior knowledge is scarce and targets are extremely small ( 534 ) . To address this problem, Li et al. ( 85 ) design in 2026 a Physic-Informed SAM (PI-SAM) method which embeds infrared physical priors into the encoder. PI-SAM consists of three components. First, a Physics-aware Encoder Adapter (PEA) estimates local luminance contrast and a SNR via center–surround mechanism modulates multilevel features across spatial and channel dimensions. Second, a heatmap-prompt mechanism converts physical cues into non interactive prompt heatmaps and refines predictions through conditionally parameterized convolutions. Third, a Physics-Constrained Loss (PCL) imposes both contrast- and SNR-aware regularization with sparsity and total-variation constraints. Experiments show that PI-SAM substantially improves the SAM baseline, confirming that incorporating physical principles into foundation models improves it suitability in terms of robustness and accuracy of IRSTD. 9. Memory Guidance: In 2024, Duan et al. ( 217 ) design a
Triple-domain Strategy (Tridos 46 46 46 https://github.com/UESTC-nnLab/Tridos ) with the frequency-aware memory enhancement on spatio-temporal domain. Tridos extracts and enhances frequency features by a local-global frequency-aware module with Fourier transform. The memory enhancement captures the spatial relations of infrared targets among video frames and encodes temporal dynamics motion features via differential learning and residual enhancing. A residual compensation reconcile possible cross-domain feature mismatches. Experiments on DAUB, ITSDT-15K and IRDST datasets show that Tridos outperforms ISNet ( 73 ) , UIU-Net ( 155 ) , RPCA-Net ( 533 ) , ST-Trans and SSTNet ( 152 ) . In 2026, Zhang et al. ( 518 ) design a unified memory-enhanced spatio-temporal fusion framework DCPNet for MISTD. First, a Deformable Spatio-Temporal Module (DSTM) captures inter-frame consistency. Second, a Content-Guided Adaptive Upsampling (CGAU) module preserves weak target structures. Third, a Prototype-aware Memory Reconstruction (PMR) module improves target-background separability. Experiments demonstrate that DCPNet outperforms 23 previous SOTA algorithms methods on pixel- and target-level metrics offering a 5 % 5\% IoU gain in complex scenes. 10. Feedback Guidance: While multi-frame detection methods exploits temporal cues, most of the methods fails in long-range dependency modeling and robustness. To address these challenges, feedback guidance has been proposed by several researchers. In 2026, Wu et al. ( 218 ) design a Dynamic Feedback Iterative Network (DFINet) which guides the model training and prediction based on the History Prediction Mask (HPMK) of previous rounds. In the training phase, DFINet extract the key features of real targets by training in multiple iterations with limited data. In the prediction phase, DFINet correct the wrong results via feedback iterative to increase the robustness. First, a Dynamic Feedback Feature Fusion Module (DFFFM) dynamically interacts HPMK with feature maps via an attention mechanism to guide feature mining and error correction. Second, a Cascaded Hybrid Pyramid Pooling Module (CHPP) allows to capture both global and local information. Third, a Dynamic Semantic Fusion Module (DSFM) employs feedback information to guide the fusion of high-level and low-level features for better feature representation in diverse scenarios. Experiments on the NUDT-SIRST, IRSTD-1k, and SIRST datasets show that DFINet outperforms several SOTA methods. In an other work, Huang et al. ( 219 ) propose a sparse frames-based spatio-temporal semantic feedback network called FeedbackSTS-Det 47 47 47 https://github.com/IDIP-Lab/FeedbackSTS-Det . This feedback strategy with a closed-loop semantic association mechanism comprises paired forward and backward refinement modules that work cooperatively across the encoder and decoder. Both modules incorporate an embedded Sparse Semantic Module (SSM). SSM performs structured sparse temporal modeling to capture long-range dependencies with low computational cost. The overall procedure keeps a consistent training-inference pipeline allowing reliable performance transfer and increasing robustness. Experiments show that FeedbackSTS-Det outperforms model-based methods (TopHat, NRAM ( 384 ) , PSTNN ( 383 ) ) and data-based methods (LCNet, DNA-Net ( 53 ) , RDIAN ( 202 ) , ISTDU-Net ( 159 ) , RPCANet ( 529 ) , L2SKNet ( 214 ) ) 11. Noise-Suppression Guidance: In 2025, Xu et al. ( 534 ) propose a Noise-Suppression-Driven approach that adapts SAM (NSDSAM) at both internal and external levels. First, a hybrid adapter for suppressing the noise of feature maps consists of an Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) adapter and a self-attention adapter. The self-attention adapter allows entropy-aware reconstruction of features from noisy inputs and employs a gating mechanism for soft-attention fusion mitigates SAM’s sensitivity to noise. Second, a Spatial–Frequency Hybrid Module (SFHM) jointly processes spatial and frequency domains to address the self-attention model’s bias toward low-frequency components. Experiments show that that NSDSAM achieves SOTA performance. 12. Geometry Guidance: In 2025, Cai et al. ( 220 ) develop a Geometry-Aware Feature Ranking Network (GeoRankNet) which consists of three novel modules. First, a Geometry-Aware Deformable Difference Convolution (GAD2C) learns adaptive sampling offsets to align convolutional kernels with irregular target contours. Second, a Dynamic Feedback-Driven Top-K Attention which is a training-aware feature ranking mechanism adjusts the pooling cardinality in real time based on IoU and loss feedback. Third, a Gated Multi-Attention Fusion (GMAF) jointly exploits channel, spatial, and global context attention and uses a lightweight gating network on globally pooled features to adaptively fuse multi-scale encoder and decoder representations. Experiments on diverse SIRST based datasets show that GeoRankNet outperforms previous methods in both detection accuracy and robustness under complex backgrounds. In 2026,
Gao et al. ( 522 ) design a method named RPR-Net 48 48 48 https://github.com/GaoScience/point-to-mask that bridges low-cost point supervision and mask-level detection via two components. First, a Physics-driven Adaptive Mask Generation (PAMG) module converts point annotations into compact target masks and geometric cues. Second, a lightweight Radius-aware Point Regression Network (RPR-Net) formulates IRSTD as target center localization and effective radius regression using spatiotemporal motion cues. PAMG provides pseudo masks and geometric supervision during training, while the geometric predictions of RPR-Net are fed back to PAMG for pixel-level mask recovery during inference. Experiments show that RPR-Net+PAMG outperforms ACM ( 37 ) , AGPCNet ( 245 ) , DNA-Net ( 53 ) , ISNet ( 73 ) , RDIAN ( 202 ) , SCTransNet ( 285 ) , DTUM ( 358 ) and SSTNet ( 152 ) . 13. Ordinary Differential Equation Guidance: Most of the fusion methods do nor effectively use global information to enforce the local features of the target. To address this problem, Xue et al. ( 279 ) design the OFSPNet 49 49 49 https://github.com/1yanchen3/12.git model in order to improve detection accuracy and detail-capturing ability via diversified feature representation and adaptive fusion. First, OFSPNet uses a parallel architecture integrating CNN, transformer, and Mamba—CNN. Mamba relies on its sole selection mechanism to filter out irrelevant data and keep the important features of key visual cues. Second, an ODE-inspired adaptive feature fusion module is developed as an information bottleneck to tackle high-frequency noise, while simultaneously strengthening target features via back-propagated gradients. Third, a modular design is carried out for the transformer and Mamba structures. With optimization strategies, the inference speed has been increased by 15.28 % 15.28\% providing the dual advantages of efficient inference and high detection accuracy. In 2024,
Chen and Ye ( 221 ) propose a self-attention operation to interact with frequency information and design Frequency Interaction Attention (FIA). To tackle irrelevant disturbances, a family of neural Ordinary Differential Equation (ODE) modules are stacked behind FIA based on high-accuracy ODE solvers. A coefficient learning is employed to block design to lower the risk of gradient vanishing that most neural ODE networks have. A family of frequency neural ODE networks named FreqODEs is then obtained. Experiments on the NUAA-SIRST and IRSTD-1k datasets show the superiority of FreqODEs. 14. Fuzzy-Logic Guidance: In 2026, Zhang et al. ( 119 ) design a Fuzzy-Logic-guided Network (FLINet) which employs fuzzy sets for uncertainty-aware feature fusion. FLINet is based on a U-shaped encoder-decoder architecture and consists of two modules. First, the Global-Local Fuzzy computation module (GLF) module consists of a dual-branch fuzzy reasoning at both local-window and global-image levels to model feature uncertainty during cross-level fusion. More specifically, the local branch increases the contrast-sensitive target cues employing an adaptive membership-based amplification. Thee global branch tackles clutter-dominant responses through global statistical normalization, jointly improving target-background separation and morphology preservation. Second, the Difference-Aware Feature fusion module DAF module increased the cross-level integration by using inter-level discrepancy maps to guide a self-attention-based fusion. The DAF module prioritizes complementary fine-grained details from shallow layers and semantic cues from deep layers to reduce small-target information loss. Experiments on the NUDT-SIRST, NUAA-SIRST, and IRSTD-1K datasets show that FLINet offers superior performance across multiple evaluation metrics. 15. High Resolution Guidance: In 2025, Zhang et al. ( 528 ) propose a High-resolution Guided Hierarchical Discriminative Network (H2D-Net) which consists of a High Resolution Guidance (HRG) module and a Holistic Distractor Filter (HDF). More specifically,
an extra hierarchical network with fixed scale is allows to rectify the representation bias of the U-shape network through a group of the HRG modules. Thus, it facilitate bidirectional interaction between the fine-grained spatial details and multi-scale representations. Secod, the refining HDF module is embedded into the bottleneck between the encoder and decoder for the purpose of interrupting feedforward propagation of the false feature response.

一、导 言 因果关系指导: 大多数现有方法都是通过直接从背景中学习目标特征,以目标为中心. 由于目标信号薄弱,它们难以有效捕捉稳定特征。 为解决这一问题,Duan等人. (436)设计一个Causal-guided Hierarchical 异常意识学习(CHAL)框架. CHAL注重背景学习,目标被认为是背景中的异常. 首先,一个spatio-temporal神经场从基因学角度模拟背景演化模式. 二,分级异常-认知学习分解异常发现. 第三,一种因果导引机制可以阻止往往由背景混淆者造成的虚假关联,增强真正的目标因果关系. 实验显示CHAL优于单帧数据模型和多帧数据模型. 2. 前导:小目标在下采样过程中容易发生特征衰减,在多层次特征聚变过程中容易发生假警报放大. 为解决这些问题,张等. (210 ) 2026年设计双先导导网络,具有跨尺度校准和像素-选择性Ged Dusion(PSGF). 首先,深意识前模块集成一个辐射流一致性先(RFCP)来抑制结构杂乱. 第二,地方方向显著性先导(LDSP)信息可增强同位素小目标。 第三,一个多尺度特性互动模块通过信道校准和背景汇总来协调跨尺度表示,以避免跨尺度偏差. PSGF模块在适应性上平衡了浅空间细节和深语义特征,以避免背景干扰,同时保持目标完整性. 在SIRST,NUDT-SIRST,以及IRSTD-1K数据集上的实验显示,PSGF超越了之前的几种方法. 3. 特征指导: 为了解决红外线图像中小目标与吵闹背景之间的低冲突,张等人(211人)设计了FC3-Net 32 32 32 https://github.com/IPIC-Lab/SIRST-Detection-FC3-Net,通过探索特征补偿和跨层关联. 更具体地说,FC3-Net包括一个精细指导的多层次地物补偿模块和一个跨层次地物关联模块。 首先,F-MFC模块通过汇总多个相邻层次的特性来补偿CNN中下采样层导致的信息损失. 为了解决背景噪声,氟氯化碳模块采用了基于较高水平且背景噪声较少的能量过滤内核来过滤中层噪声. 最后,它使它们与低层的连接起来,以了解强烈的目标代表性。 FC3-Net利用它们进入编码器-解码器结构,生成更精确的目标面具,其形状和细节都更好. 2024年,李和朴(278人)设计了基于分级多patch feature Encoder(HMAMFU-Net 33 33 33 33 https://github.com/skylih87/HMAMFU-net)的混合网络. 编码器将图像分为多个小块,并按等级堆叠,以提取特征. HMAMFU-Net提供了一个混合编码器结构,将一个以革命为基础的多尺度编码器用于提取本地信息,以及一个以等级为基础的多patch编码器用于通过平行运行来提取全球信息. 你的损失功能使从每一层获得的等级信息相互连接。 在NUDT-SIRST和NUA-SIRST数据集上的实验显示,HMAMFU-net的性能超过了几个SOTA算法. 郭等编. (57) 开发一个定位指导的Dense嵌入式关注网络(LGDNet)。 LGDNet包括一个像素注意力引导特性提取模块(PAG-FEM),一个通道注意力引导特性聚合模块(CAG-FFM)和一个检测模块. PAG-FEM将DNA-Net的DNIM密集嵌入区块作为骨干,结合了通道和像素的注意机制. 其二,CAG-FFM使用提升和演化操作来对齐特征大小,同时使用频道关注机制来获取频道信息. 第三,这些特征通过堆叠、加成和平均操作来融合,以获得歧视性特征。 检测模块empoys八连通邻里群集方法,以获取目标百分点坐标,用于后续检测评价. 实验表明,LGDNet比以往的SOTA方法提供了更好的结果. 2025年,Chen等人(74人)开发了混合深度学习框架,将密集的空间热映射监督与几何感知回归(PSHNet)相结合. 它生成位置- 尺度热映射来引导粗细的本地化,这些热映射通过子像素抵消和大小回归来精炼. 将完整的IoU(CIoU)损失作为几何正规化术语,以加强预测框和地面真象框之间的匹配。 采用了一个增强型低层地物模块(ELFM),利用多尺度的拓宽演化并引导注意力来保存细微的空间细节. 在NUDT-SIRST和IRSTD-1k数据集上的实验显示,PSHNet在IoU的DNA-Net(53)和ALCNet(312),检测概率,以及假警报率上都超过了表现. 在另一部作品中,徐等人(461)根据弱特性增强和目标适应扩散(IRSTD-WFETAP)设计了红外小目标探测方法. 首先,一种零星的采样机制和混合滤波法捕捉小目标的复杂形状和边缘信息,同时减少稀缺特征的丢失和转移. 第二,一个多尺度特性增强模块采用垂直-横向双向关注和多尺度特性编码,以在编码器和解码器之间获得稳定的特性交互通道. 第三,一项目标数据自适应性扩散战略(DSAS)能够解决用于概括和表达能力的正反样本不平衡问题。 目标背景联合损失缓解失衡问题,帮助网络顺利汇合. 在NUA-SIRST和IRSTD-1k数据集上的实验显示,IRSTD-WFETAP在nIoU,Pd,Fa,和F1度量衡中比以前的方法提供更好的性能. 2025年,刘等. (55)提出先行制导网络(PGDN-Net),将传统人工功能与深层学习网络模式相结合. 首先,提取出三个前期特征,即高序Riesz变形特征,紧凑性和异质性特征(CH),以及结构变声器(ST)的角特征. 其次,这些特征是输入一个密集的嵌入式网络来指导,并配有双向的注意力聚合模块和通道与空间注意力模块. 每种特征都提供了各自不同深度的指导作用。 实验显示,PGDN-Net在背景压制,目标增强,探测概率,以及假警报率方面比之前的算法提供更好的性能. 刘等. (449)开发一个名为MDS-DWGANet的轻量级检测网络,该网络包括一个多直径Sparse Convolution模块(MDSC)和一个动态重心导引模块(DWGA). 首先,MDSC在四个方向(横向,垂直,和两个对角)构造了稀疏的旋动分支,以模拟方向梯度响应,并使用稀疏的支点机制聚焦于高响应边缘区域,保持结构意识,同时减少参数俯仰. 第二,动态重心引导注意力模块(DWGA)通过将四个注意力路径与动态通道分配机制相结合,减轻特征稀释和注意力漂移. 实际上,DWGA可被视为对区域对比性增强的深刻概括。 在NUDT-SIRST和IRSTD-1 K数据集上的实验显示,MDS-DWGANet提供了98.30%的98.30%的探测概率(Pd),以及93.04%的93.04%的中间截面在Union(mIoU)上提供了1.4M参数. 2025年,Ma等人(450人)设计了一个Othogonal Investments Perception Fusion(OIPF)网络,在不增加网络深度的情况下在更深层中捕捉可学习的目标特征. 然后通过强度反演和增强将正对数据输入双输入框架,以提供增量信息流动。 其次,一个关系意识模块(RAM)通过利用跨层的数据对之间的关系生成空间权重图. 广泛的实验表明,OIPF大大提高了ISTD的性能. Yang等人(453人)开发了一个“注意”的双重特征提取(AGDFE 34 34 34 34 https://github.com/wwwyangxiaoyucom/new-network )网络,该网络包括两个层次的特征提取:多尺度特征提取机制和背景特征提取机制。 首先,多尺度特征提取机制执行第一层的特征提取操作. 因此,邻层之间的信息交互是通过对不同层的特征进行引信和分解来实现的. 第二,目标关注机制加强了模型对小目标的关注,并为探测小红外目标提供了有效的关注分配. 第三,多分辨率特征交互机制保存了细节信息,提高了感知小目标的能力. 背景特征提取机制执行二级特征提取操作背景环境. 实验显示,AGDFE提供了99.81%的99.81%=87.58%=87.58%=87.56%=87.96%=88.12%=88.12%=召回,99.38%=87.85%=87.85%=87.85%=F计量,98.77%=78.33%=78.33%=MIoU在NUDT-SIRST和SIRST上 分别是Aug数据集. 在2025年,在隐形场景面前的泛化背景下,Chi et al. (452)为单域通用(SGIRNet)开发一个对比-不变量特征提取框架. 首先,Contrast Modulation模块(CM)通过互离增强和压制操作来解决特征域间隙. 第二,一个位置和通道不变量特性提取模块(PCIFM)提取了不受对比变化影响的目标特征. SGIRNet被整合到几个现有模型中,以评价业绩. 实验显示,SGIRNet改进了隐形域内现有模型的检测性能,提供了超强的泛化能力. 2025年,在MIRST的背景下,彭等人(451人)开发了一个Spatio-Temporal特性聚变网络(STME 35 35 35 https://github.com/UTEC-nnLab/STME),由两个平行特性提取分支组成. 拳头抽取了整个视频片段的时间特征. 第二个将空间特征与选定的密钥框架分离。 自精模块可以适应性地调整提取的时间特征和不同尺度的引信时空特征 广泛实验显示,STME每秒减少浮点操作(FLOPs). 2025年,在上下文fo插件和播放组件中,Lu et al. (108) 设计一个双几何定向专家网络(DGGENet),其基础是具有目标-背景脱钩模块(TBDM)的“专家混合”模式。 具体来说,TBDM使用一个几何制导的动态导线机制作为适应性的引线网发挥作用. 因此,它不断分析投入特征,以便动态地设立两个专门专家组。 第一个专用于目标频道,另一个专用于背景频道。 每个组作为专用于指定特征子空间的子网络发挥作用. 利用《区域行动纲领》的原则,小组间专家迭代在改进协作特征时促进低级别背景和很少的目标表述。 第二;一个交叉聚变模块起到状态反馈的作用,可以使优化的表达方式之间形成一致的互动. 这种闭路互动明确模拟目标-背景关联. 实验显示DGGENet)在NUDT-SIRST数据集和IRSTD-1K数据集上提供了优异的性能. 因此,TBDM是一个多功能的插件和游戏部分,它改进了各种ISTD框架。 2026年,刘等人(47人)设计了感知查询指南网络PQGNet. First,感知查询监督机制(PQGNet 36 36 36 36 https://github.com/PepperCS/PQGNet)使用感知损失来限制每个编码层的空间特征学习. 其次,一个感知特性构建模块(PFCM)捕捉感知特性,以保存目标本地化信息. 第三,一个PQGM概念查询模块(PQGM)通过跳过连接来指导全球和区域特性查询,优化目标特性提取. 最大集合波束混合层(MWHL)和高频增强波束层(HEWL)利用离散波束变换特性,利用浅高频细节改进深高语义表达. 在NUDT-SIRST,NUAA-SIRST,以及IRSTD-1K数据集上的实验表明,PQGNet在计算复杂度和准确度之间的竞争平衡下,超越了SOTA方法. 2025年,李等人(86人)提出混合曼巴-CNN UNet(HMCNet). 它的混合结构允许提取局部特征,并模拟全球背景. 在IRSTD-1k和MIST(86)数据集上的实验显示,HMCNet比RLCM,MPCM,PSTNN和RDIAN(202)都具有高速推论能力. 吕和章(10 )将一个视觉的曼巴模块整合到一个基于CNN的轻量级网络中,将CNN模拟本地特色的能力和视觉的曼巴模块结合在一起,捕捉长途全球特色. 因此,这个模型同时提取本地和长途全球地物信息. NUA-SIRST和NUA-SIRSTv2数据集上的实验显示,这个模型提供了更好的准确性和较低的计算复杂性. 2025年,李等人(86人)提出混合曼巴-CNN UNet(HMCNet). 它的混合结构允许提取局部特征,并模拟全球背景. 在IRSTD-1k和MIST(86)数据集上的实验显示,HMCNet比RLCM,MPCM,PSTNN和RDIAN(202)都具有高速推论能力. 吕和章(10 )将一个视觉的曼巴模块整合到一个基于CNN的轻量级网络中,将CNN模拟本地特色的能力和视觉的曼巴模块结合在一起,捕捉长途全球特色. 因此,这个模型同时提取本地和长途全球地物信息. NUA-SIRST和NUA-SIRSTv2数据集上的实验显示,这个模型提供了更好的准确性和较低的计算复杂性. 2026年,在梯度特征方面,王等人(455人)提出了基于多模块合作设计的渐变补偿特色学习网络(GCFLNet),以改善特色表现和聚变. 首先,一个边缘增强模块(EEM)在通过平滑操作压制背景噪声的同时捕获精细的边缘信息. 因此,提取的边缘特征被嵌入一个Global-Local Feature Interactive(GLFI)模块. 多尺度信息补偿模块利用跨空间和通道层面的多尺度特征的互补特点,指导高层次和低层次信息的高效融合。 关于NUDT和IRSTD-1K数据集的实验表明,GFLNet的绩效超过了基于过滤的方法(Top-Hat, Max-Median),基于本地对比的方法(TLLCM, WSLCM),基于模型的方法(RIPT, IPI)和基于数据的方法(UIU-Net(155),DNA-Net(53),RDIAN(202)),背景各异. 杜等编. (456) 设计一个双帕边向导频率-智能网络(DEFANet),允许边缘-目标合作模型用于增强特性代表. (454)提出空间-频率地物学习网络(SFLNet),试图通过空间和频率域的合作模型,解决小目标探测方面的挑战. 第一,SFLNet采用边缘制导的解码器结构,在重建期间保存小目标的结构完整性并塑造信息. 第二,本单元采用空间-频率联合学习机制,使空间域和频率域之间的信息交流能够相互补充和加强。 实验显示,SFLNet在精确定位目标和保存目标形状方面,比之前的SOTA算法表现得更好. 4.重建指导:2026年,颜某等人(222人)设计了目标意识不可逆编码器(InvDet 37 37 37 https://github.com/SchulerYan/InvDet/tree/main),在重建导导检测框架内将信息保存与目标意识增强结合起来. 首先,一个不可逆的路径将信息损失视为可选择的数量,从而形成来自特征潜在因素的投入。 第二,一个目标-软件重建模块只在反向路径中运行。 第三,一个几何-连续容忍度量衡(GCTM)侧重于真正信息丰富的区域,并产生一个像素偏重的地图,使重建分支规范化。 5. 语义指导: 大多数深层神经网络方法在将高层次特征从深层转移到浅层时都存在语义退化,限制了小目标精确的局部化. 为了解决这一问题,一些研究建议采用语义指导。 2024年,马等人(484人)在高频和低频语义重建(HLSR-net)的基础上开发了小型目标检测网络,以压制背景杂乱干扰,并提取目标稀疏特征. 第一,高频目标与低频背景特征通过快速傅里叶频率转换分别提取. 第二,分别通过设计的高频和低频重建网络进行目标增强和背景压制。 第三,聚变输出策略提供小目标的探测. 实验显示HLSR-net在精度提升6% 6 +% 的情况下能实现更好的性能. (531)利用多任务感知网络(SMPISD-MTPNet 39 39s://github.com/greekin Roma/SMPISD-MTPNet)设计一个场景语义前辅助红外线船探测. 这个网络基于多任务感知:一个任务预测目标,另一个侧重于场景感知,以压制背景干扰造成的假警报. 一个场景语义解析器(SSE)根据根据专家知识和梯度模块提取的特性来指导网络. 采用了数据扩增法,并采用名为软微调的培训技巧,加强网络的普及,抑制因扩增过程造成的扭曲。 在IRSDSS数据集上的实验显示,SMPISD-MTPNet比以往的SOTA方法要好. 2025年, Zhu等人(77人)开发了用于多帧红外小目标探测的Timoral-Semantic交互网络(TSI-Net). (481)设计一个语义-细节合作网络(SemDetNet). 首先,一个具有背景意识的全球语义模块能够通过在多层次下取样中的反向补偿,提高非目标区域的歧视性代表性。 第二,一个细节补偿模块利用浅的多角性细节. 这个模块进一步利用粗糙的预测口罩来引导深层特征,使语义重建和边缘精细化. 实验显示,SemDetNet比HCFNet,MSHNet(40),MTU-Net(284)和DNA-Net(53)提供更好的成果. 在另一部作品中,张等. (482)提出一个轻量级检测框架,其中包含频率感知和语义指导网络(FSGNet 41 41 41 https://github.com/Wangtao-Bao/FSGNet ). 第一,一个多方向的交互式关注模块捕捉精细和方向特征. 第二,多尺度的频率感知模块利用Fast Fourier变换来保留突出的目标结构. 第三,一个全球集合模块可以捕捉高级语义信息. 然后,通过全球语义指导流对它进行取样并传播到每个解码阶段,以便语义上的一致性和不同尺度的精确本地化。 在NUASIRST,IRSTD-1K,NUDT-SIRST和SIRSTAUG数据集上的实验显示,优于ACM(202),RDIAN(202),AGPCNet(245),DNA-Net(53),UIU-Net(155),RPCA-Net(533),MSHNet(40)和L2SKNet(214). 廖一燕(483人)设计 Camouflage-aware 反分裂网(CCDNet). 首先,具有Weighted多分支感知器(WMP)的骨干,集合自备的多层次特性来代表目标和背景. 第二,从浅/深特征图中精炼结构/语义,双向获取目标与背景之间的关系。 第三, " 矛盾辅助干扰者歧视者 " (CaDD)在本地和全球范围执行实际目标与背景之间的适应性相似性计算,以区别干扰者,从而降低假警报率。 Sang等人(487)提出了一个边缘-目标深度语义一致性(ET-DSC 42 42 42 https://github.com/Yuweiw-1024/ET-DSC)语义适应性平衡框架。 在编码器中,浅层模型和门式聚变增强目标边界. 在解码器中,语义一致性限制保持了真实的边界,压制了假边缘. 浅层和深层之间的语义分配机制允许在边缘补偿和语义保护之间进行合作优化。 对NUDT-SIRST和NUAA-SIRST数据集的实验显示,ET-DSC的成绩超过了ACM(37),UNet++(59),HCFNet,DNA-Net(53),MTU-Net(284)和MSHNet(40). 张等.
