blocks.en: 4.9 Lightweight Algorithms
blocks.zh: 4.9 轻量级算法

blocks.en:
Different strategies have been developed to obtain lightweight networks. In 2019, Zhao et al. ( 232 ) propose a lightweight CNN named TBC-Net. TBCNet comprises a Target Extraction Module (TEM) and a Semantic Constraint Module (SCM). A joint loss function and a training method are also developed. The SCM module provides a semantic constraint on TEM by combining the high-level classification task and addresses the difficulty to learn features due to the class imbalance problem. During the training phase, the targets are extracted and are further classified by the SCM module. During the inference phase, the TEM module is solely employed to detect the small targets. Experiments show that TBC-Net reduces the false alarm due to complex backgrounds. BC-Net can reach real-time detection on the NVIDIA Jetson AGX development board making it suitable for deployment in real conditions. In 2024, Yu et al. ( 541 ) design a Lightweight and Robust network (LR-Net) without complex structure. LR-Net offers an effective balance between detection accuracy and resource requirements. More specifically, a Lightweight Feature Extraction Attention (LFEA) module extracts target features and strengthens information interaction across channels. A Refined Feature Transfer (RFT) module improves the network’s feature refinement extraction ability with little resource requirements. A Low-level Feature Distribution (LFD) strategy allows to address the problem of small target loss in high-level feature maps.
An Simplified Bilinear interpolation Attention Module (SBAM) promotes the guidance constraints of low-level features on high-level features and the fusion of the two. The traditional resizing method is replaced by a training and inference cropping strategy. Experimental results show that LR-Net achieves SOTA performance and is ranked at the 3rd place in the "ICPR 2024 Resource-Limited Infrared Small Target Detection Challenge Track 2: Lightweight Infrared Small Target Detection".
blocks.zh:
为获得轻量级网络制定了不同的战略。 2019年,赵等人(232人)提出一个名为TBC-Net的轻量级CNN. TBCNet包含一个目标提取模块(TEM)和一个语义约束模块(SCM). 还开发了联合损失功能和培训方法。 SCM模块通过结合高层次的分类任务,解决由于阶级不平衡问题导致的学习特征的困难,为TEM提供了语义上的制约. 在培训阶段,目标被提取出来,并被SCM模块进一步分类. 在推断阶段,TEM模块完全用于探测小目标. 实验显示,TBC-Net由于背景复杂,减少了假警报. BC-Net可以在NVIDIA Jetson AGX开发板上达到实时检测,使其适合在真实条件下部署. 2024年,Yu等人(541人)设计了一个没有复杂结构的轻量级和强力网络(LR-Net). LR-Net在检测准确性和所需资源之间提供了有效的平衡。 更具体地说,一个轻量级特征提取注意(LFEA)模块提取了目标特征,并加强了跨渠道的信息互动. 一个精炼的特性转移模块(RFT)提高了网络的特性精炼提取能力,几乎没有资源要求。 低层地物分布(LFD)策略可以解决高层地物图中小目标丢失的问题.
一个简化的双线插座注意模块(SBAM)促进低层特征对高层次特征的指导约束和两者的融合. 传统的再分配方法被培训和推断的耕作战略所取代。 实验结果显示,LR-Net实现了SOTA性能,并在"ICPR 2024资源限量红外小目标探测挑战赛道2:轻量级红外小目标探测"中排名第3位.

blocks.en: In 2023, Chen et al. ( 548 ) develop a lightweight network with high-speed inference and a knowledge distillation method for learning higher-order semantic information from the transformer network. First, Chen et al. ( 548 ) design each stage in the detection network, named Multi-scale Dilated Pyramid Network (MDPNet). This design enlarges the receptive field and improves the ability to extract contextual features. Second, a knowledge distillation allows to bridge the detection performance gap with the transformer. Based on the self-attention mechanism, a semantic distillation sub-network is constructed between the teacher transformer and student convolution network. Experiments on the SIRST and NUDT-SIRST datasets show that MDPNet outperforms previous networks requiring a number of parameters of only 0.23 M. MDPNet achieves an inference speed of 137 FPS for 320 × 320 320\times 320 infrared images.
blocks.zh: 2023年,陈等. (548)开发具有高速推论的轻量级网络和从变压器网络学习更高顺序语义信息的知识分馏方法. 首先,我们... 陈等. (548) 探测网络中每个阶段的设计,命名为多级稀释金字塔网络(MDPNet). 这种设计拓宽了可接受领域,提高了提取背景特征的能力. 其次,知识蒸馏可以与变压器弥补检测性能差距. 基于自觉机制,在教师变压器和学生演化网络之间构建语义蒸馏子网络. 在SIRST和NUDT-SIRST数据集上的实验显示,MDPNet超越了以前的网络,只需要0.23 M. MDPNet的多个参数就可以实现320×320 320\时的320红外图像的推断速度137 FPS.

blocks.en: In 2025, Li et al. ( 233 ) develop an Infrared Low-level Network (ILNet 52 52 52 https://github.com/Li-Haoqing/ILNet ) that considers infrared small targets as salient regions characterized by semantic information. More specifically, ILNet employs low-level information instead of treating it uniformly with high-level information. A lightweight feature fusion module, named the Interactive Polarized Orthogonal Fusion module (IPOF), allows to integrate important low-level features from the shallow layers into the deep layers. A dynamic 1-D aggregation layers are inserted into the IPOF allowing to dynamically adjust the aggregation of low-dimensional information according to the number of input channels. In an other work, Jin et al. ( 140 ) design a lightweight network based on an improved YOLOv10 (IR-WSANet) increasing the detection performance via a frequency-spatial joint optimization strategy. First, a discrete wavelet transform convolution (DWaveletConv) is employed into the backbone network. The fusion of high-frequency details and low-frequency semantics is improved by multi-band feature decomposition to suppress noise interference. Second, a cooperative module (POS-SHSA) improves the positioning accuracy of small targets. Experiments on the SIDD and HIT-UAV datasets show that IR-WSANet improves the detection performance in complex scenes through the combination of frequency domain filtering enhancement and space-channel dual attention mechanism. Duan et al. ( 143 ) design a lightweight architecture based on RT-DETR named RT-DETR-CST. First, a Cross-Channel Feature Attention Network (CFAN) allows to achieve channel-weighted feature fusion via residual connections to suppress invalid background channels. Second, a Scale-Wise Feature Network (SWN) employs depthwise separable convolutions and stochastic depth for multi-scale feature extraction. Third, a Texture/Detail Capture Network (TCN) achieves edge/detail capture via linear decomposition. Experiments on the ISDD datasets show that RT-DETR-CST offers real-time performance in infrared ship remote sensing small-target detection. In an other work, Li et al. ( 545 ) investigate the most essential information from a more crucial domain. A theoretical analysis demonstrate that the global temporal saliency and correlation information in the temporal profile offer significant superiority in separating target signals from other signals. First, Li et al. ( 545 ) construct the first prediction attribution tool and verify the importance of the temporal profile information. S, the IRST detection task is formulated as a one-dimensional signal anomaly detection task. Thus, Li et al. ( 545 ) propose an efficient Deep temporal Probe network (DeepPro 53 53 53 https://github.com/TinaLRJ/DeepPro ) that executes only calculations in the time dimension. Experiments show that DeepPro outperforms existing state-of-the-art IRST detection methods with reasonable computation time. Zang et al. ( 84 ) propose a lightweight model—one named LMDNet with few parameters. LMDNet reduces computational load—while surpassing the average detection accuracy and IoU values of previous SOTA models. First, a spatial-channel difference convolution module allows to extract spatial and channel features while maintaining low computational requirement. Second, a global feature enhancement Mamba layer accelerates target localization and offers precise detection in complex backgrounds. Third, a self-learning joint loss function dynamically adjusts weights during training to optimize the contributions of different loss components. Practically, the FPS is several times higher than that of larger model-based methods, with Params and FLOPs of only 0.024M and 0.168G, respectively. Its overall performance outperforms previous lightweight methods.
blocks.zh: 2025年,李等人(233人)开发了红外低级网络(ILNet 52 52 52 https://github.com/Li-Haoqing/ILNet),将红外小目标视为以语义信息为特征的突出区域. 更具体地说,ILNet使用低层次信息,而不是用高层次信息统一处理。 一个轻量级特征聚变模块,命名为交互式极化正交融合模块(IPOF),可以将浅层的重要低层特征整合到深层. 在 IPOF 中插入动态的 1- D 聚合层,以便根据输入通道的数量动态调整低维信息的聚合. 在另一部作品中,Jin et al. (140)在经过改进的YOLOv10(IR-WSANet)的基础上,通过频率-空间联合优化策略来提高检测性能,设计一个轻量级网络. 首先,采用离散的波浪变形(DWaveletConv)进入骨干网络. 通过多波段特性分解来抑制噪声干扰,对高频细节和低频语义学进行聚变. 其次,一个合作模块(POS-SHSA)提高了小目标的定位精度. 在SIDD和HIT-UAV数据集上的实验显示,IR-WSANet通过频率域过滤增强和空间通道双关注机制相结合,提高了复杂场景中的检测性能. 杜安等编. (143)基于名为RT-DETR-CST的RT-DETR设计轻量级架构. 首先,一个跨频道的功能关注网络(CFAN)允许通过剩余连接实现通道加权特征聚变,以压制无效的背景通道. 第二,一个缩放-Wise地物网络(SWN)采用深度可分化的演化和分层深度来进行多尺度地物提取. 第三,一个纹理/细节捕捉网通过线性分解实现边缘/细节捕捉. 对ISDD数据集的实验表明,RT-DETR-CST在红外线船舶遥感小目标探测中提供了实时性能. 在另一部作品中,Li等人(545人)调查了更为关键领域最基本的信息。 一项理论分析表明,时间特征中的全球时间特征和相关性信息在将目标信号与其他信号区分开来方面提供了显著优势。 首先,我们... Li等人(545)构建了第一个预测归属工具,并验证了时间剖面信息的重要性. S,IRST检测任务被制定为一维信号异常检测任务. 因此,Li等人(545人)提议采用高效率方法。 深时探测网(DeepPro 53 53 53s://github.com/TinaLRJ/DeepPro),只执行时间维度的计算. 实验显示,DeepPro以合理的计算时间超越了现有的最先进的IRST检测方法. 赞等. (84)提出一个轻量级模型——一个命名为LMDNet,几乎没有参数. LMDNet减少了计算负荷——同时超过了以往SOTA模型的平均检测精度和IoU值. 首先,空间-通道差分演化模块允许在保持低计算要求的同时提取空间和通道特征. 第二,一个全球特性增强的曼巴层加速目标本地化,并提供复杂背景的精确检测. 三,自学联合损失功能 在培训期间动态调整权重,优化不同损失部分的贡献. 实际上,FPS比更大的模型方法高好几倍,帕拉姆斯和FLOP分别只有0.024M和0.168G. 其总体性能超过了以往的轻量级方法.

blocks.en: In 2026, Wang et al. ( 107 ) provide a Lightweight Local Contrast and Edge Fusion Approach (LLCEFA). LLCEFA consists of a dual-branch architecture with a main branch and an edge branch designed to take into account the synergistic advantages of prior knowledge guidance and data-driven learning. About the main branch, a Local Contrast Attention Fusion (LCAF) module employs the local contrast prior to obtain the input image into more discriminative feature representations. An edge branch employs an Adaptive Edge Weight Extraction (AEWE) module to independently derive edge weights for enhancing intermediate-layer features. This design decouples prior knowledge processing from the backbone’s architecture making LLCEFA suitable to be a plug-and-play enhancer compatible with various backbone methods, achieving a performance boost with generating a minimal additional burden. In an other work, Zhang et al. ( 542 ) propose a Tropical-Fish-Swarm Pruning for IR (TFSP-IR). It is a compact architecture that employs feature restoration, adaptive filtering, and bio-inspired pruning. First, a Fine-detail-guided Multilevel Feature Compensation (F-MFC) mechanism aggregates information from adjacent layers. Thus, small-target details persist into the network’s deeper stages. Second, a Cross-level Feature Correlation (CFC) module employs an energy-based filter from high-level, noise-reduced representations. It allows to suppress clutter and enhancing target signal. Third, an Efficient Fast Channel Pruning (EFCP) strategy adjusts pruning depth and breadth according to the evolving spatial relationships within feature maps. Experiments on three datasets show that TFSP-IR offers state-of-the-art performance in both accuracy and efficiency. Zhao et al. ( 543 ) propose a lightweight Shape-Texture Mutual-Guided Predictor-Corrector Network (STMG-PCNet). STMG-PCNet offers a balance between accuracy and efficiency by providing a collaborative design of a detection branch and a shape-aware branch. First, a progressive lightweight dilated dense module in the detection branch employs dense connections and cascaded multiscale dilated convolutions to improve local texture retention and precise localization. Second, a shape-aware vision Transformer module in the shape-aware branch allows to model target edges and shape features via global context interaction. Third, a numerical predictor-corrector fusion module achieves lightweight multistage feature fusion. Experiments show that STMG-PCNet outperforms previous algorithms in detection accuracy and computational efficiency. In an other work, Zhang et al. ( 542 ) propose a Tropical-Fish-Swarm Pruning for IR (TFSP-IR). It is a compact architecture that employs feature restoration, adaptive filtering, and bioinspired pruning. First, a Fine-detail-guided Multilevel Feature Compensation (F-MFC) mechanism aggregates information from adjacent layers. Thus, small-target details persist into the network’s deeper stages. Second, a Cross-level Feature Correlation (CFC) module employs an energy-based filter from high-level, noise-reduced representations. It allows to suppress clutter and enhancing target signal. Third, an Efficient Fast Channel Pruning (EFCP) strategy adjusts pruning depth and breadth according to the evolving spatial relationships within feature maps. Experiments on three datasets show that TFSP-IR offers state-of-the-art performance in both accuracy and efficiency. Zhao et al. ( 543 ) propose a lightweight Shape-Texture Mutual-Guided Predictor-Corrector Network (STMG-PCNet). STMG-PCNet offers a balance between accuracy and efficiency by providing a collaborative design of a detection branch and a shape-aware branch. First, a progressive lightweight dilated dense module in the detection branch employs dense connections and cascaded multiscale dilated convolutions to improve local texture retention and precise localization. Second, a shape-aware vision Transformer module in the shape-aware branch allows to model target edges and shape features via global context interaction. Third, a numerical predictor-corrector fusion module achieves lightweight multistage feature fusion. Experiments show that STMG-PCNet outperforms previous algorithms in detection accuracy and, computational efficiency. In an other work, Cui et al. ( 544 ) build upon the traditional U-Net architecture a lightweight Adaptive Memory Fusion (AMF) module at the deepest layer of the network. This module allows to take into account the strength of attention mechanisms in capturing long-range contextual information and adaptively fuses multi-frame inputs to improve feature representations. Experiments show that UAMF 54 54 54 https://github.com/keacifer/UAMF allows to reduce computational complexity by two orders of magnitude compared with previous SOTA models. In 2026, Lu et al. ( 546 ) develop an architecture named WSNet which contains only 0.054 M parameters and requires 1.050 G FLOPs. WSNet was the most lightweight model in the field achieving the fastest inference speed to date.
blocks.zh: 2026年,Wang等人(107人)提供了轻量级局部对比和边缘融合方法(LLCEFA). LLCEFA由一个双分支架构组成,主要分支和一个边缘分支,旨在考虑前知识指导和数据驱动学习的协同优势. 关于主要分支,一个局部对比性注意融合(LCAF)模块在获取输入图像之前使用本地对比性,以进行更具有歧视性的特征表达. 边缘分支使用一个可适应的边缘重量提取(AEWE)模块,独立得出边缘重量,以加强中间层特性。 这种设计将先前的知识处理与骨干架构脱钩,使LLCEFA适合成为兼容各种骨干方法的插座和游戏增强器,通过产生最小的额外负担来实现性能提升. 在另一部作品中,张等人(542人)提议为IR(TFSP-IR)进行热带-鱼群普鲁宁. 它是一种紧凑的建筑,它采用特征修复、适应性过滤和生物启发的冲刺。 首先,一个精细指导的多层次特性补偿(F-MFC)机制汇总了相邻层的信息. 因此,小目标的细节仍然存在于网络的更深入阶段。 第二,一个跨层地物关联性(CFC)模块使用来自高水平、低噪声表达的能量过滤器。 它可以抑制杂乱无章,增强目标信号. 第三,高效快速通道普林宁(EFCP)战略根据地物图内不断变化的空间关系调整普林深度和宽度. 对三个数据集的实验显示,TFSP-IR在准确性和效率上都提供了最新的性能. 赵等. (543)提出轻量级的形状-Texture 互导先导-校对网络(STMG-PCNet). STMG-PCNet通过提供检测分支和形状感知分支的合作设计,提供了精度和效率之间的平衡. 首先,检测分支中一个进步的轻量级膨胀稠密模块采用了密集连接和级联的多尺度膨胀蒸发,以改善局部纹理保留和精确本地化. 其次,在形状感知分支中,一个形状感知视觉变形器模块允许通过全球背景互动来建模目标边缘和形状特征. 第三,数字预测器-校正器聚变模块实现轻量级多阶段特征聚变. 实验显示,STMG-PCNet在检测精度和计算效率方面超越了以前的算法. 在另一部作品中,张等人(542人)提议为IR(TFSP-IR)进行热带-鱼群普鲁宁. 它是一个紧凑的建筑,采用特征修复、适应性过滤和生物启发的螺旋。 首先,一个精细指导的多层次特性补偿(F-MFC)机制汇总了相邻层的信息. 因此,小目标的细节仍然存在于网络的更深入阶段。 第二,一个跨层地物关联性(CFC)模块使用来自高水平、低噪声表达的能量过滤器。 它可以抑制杂乱无章,增强目标信号. 第三,高效快速通道普林宁(EFCP)战略根据地物图内不断变化的空间关系调整普林深度和宽度. 对三个数据集的实验显示,TFSP-IR在准确性和效率上都提供了最新的性能. 赵等. (543)提出轻量级的形状-Texture 互导先导-校对网络(STMG-PCNet). STMG-PCNet通过提供检测分支和形状感知分支的合作设计,提供了精度和效率之间的平衡. 首先,检测分支中一个进步的轻量级膨胀稠密模块采用了密集连接和级联的多尺度膨胀蒸发,以改善局部纹理保留和精确本地化. 其次,在形状感知分支中,一个形状感知视觉变形器模块允许通过全球背景互动来建模目标边缘和形状特征. 第三,数字预测器-校正器聚变模块实现轻量级多阶段特征聚变. 实验显示,STMG-PCNet在检测精度和计算效率方面超越了以前的算法. 在另一部作品中,Cui et al. (544)以传统的U-Net架构为基础,在网络最深层搭建一个轻量级的适应性记忆融合(AMF)模块. 这一模块能够考虑到注意机制在获取长距离背景信息方面的优势,并适应性地将多框架投入结合起来,以改进特征表述。 实验显示,UAMF 54 54 54 https://github.com/keacifer/UAMF 与以前的SOTA模型相比,可以将计算复杂度减少两个数量级。 2026年,Lu et al. (546年)开发了一个名为WSNet的建筑,其中仅包含0.054. M参数和需要1.050 G FLOPs. WSNet是该领域最轻量级的模型,实现了迄今为止最快的推论速度.

blocks.en: Binarized Neural Networks (BNNs) offers efficiency in model compression. Thus, Xin et al. ( 547 ) design a Binarized Infrared Small-Target Detection Network (BiisNet 55 55 55 https://github.com/joeyxin-del/BiisNet ). It keeps the core operations of binarized convolutions while integrating full-precision features into the network’s information flow. More specifically, a Dot Binary Convolution retains fine-grained semantic information in feature maps while still exploiting the binarized convolution operations. A smooth and adaptive Dynamic Softsign function offers a more comprehensive and progressively finer gradient during backpropagation improving model stability and promoting an optimal weight distribution. Experiments show that BiisNet outperforms other binary architectures and has strong competitiveness among state-of-the-art full-precision models.
blocks.zh: 二进制神经网络(BNNs)为模型压缩提供了效率. 因此,Xin等人(547人)设计了一个双红外小目标探测网络(BiisNet 55 55 55s://github.com/joeyxin-del/BiisNet)。 它保持二进制演化的核心操作,同时将全精度的特征融入网络的信息流. 更具体地说,一个Dot二进制(Dot Binary Convolution)在特征图中保留了精细的语义信息,同时仍在利用二进制的Convolution操作. 平滑和适应性的动态软信号功能在反射过程中提供了更加全面和逐渐细化的梯度,改善了模型稳定性,并促进了最佳的重量分布. 实验显示,BiisNet超越了其他二进制建筑,在最先进的全精度模型中具有强大的竞争力.

blocks.en: In summary, model compression is the main way for obtaining lightweight networks and structured pruning is a representative lightweight method ( 552 ) . Due to the extreme characteristics of infrared small targets (e.g., weak texture, shape, and color distribution), directly applying existing pruning methods to infrared small target detection appears challenging because they have been designed for other tasks ( 552 ) reaching to the following weaknesses as developed in Li et al. ( 553 ) : 1. Error Pruning of Essentialrr Modules: Existing pruning methods consider the specially designed modules (e.g., CBAM in DNA-Net ( 53 ) , BLAM in ALCNet ( 312 ) ) and conventional components as equally important. Several essential modules are thus removed generating decrease in performance . 2. Structural Coupled Dependencies: Advanced infrared small target detection networks use multi-scale feature fusion or residual cross-layer connections to obtain strong inter-channel dependencies. But, existing pruning methods are insensitive to these coupled relationships and rely on expert-driven grouping strategies, which struggle to adapt to parameter-sharing mechanisms in cross-layer connections and generate performance degradation. 3. Weight Correlation Constraint: Existing pruning methods focus on the identification redundant structures while ignoring the substructures correlation. This fact generates feature distribution perturbation and weaken the recovery and generalization ability To address these three challenges, Li et al. ( 553 ) design a Structure Grouping collaborative Decorrelated L2-norm Pruning (SGDP 56 56 56 https://github.com/lyh-nudt/SGDP ) which is a task-aware structured pruning method specifically designed to infrared small target detection. SGDP method is not intended to reduce Params and FLOPs, but to achieve a balance between model compression and small target detection performance. First, a Shield Layer (SL) strategy protects important layers from pruning. Second, a Hierarchical Coupling Structure Grouping (HCSG) strategy exploits hierarchical coupling relationships and input–output dependencies to partition non-shielded structures into grouped substructures. HCSG avoids the disruption of critical information flow paths of small targets and ensures networks regularity. Third, a Decorrelated L2-norm Regularization (DL2R) strategy enforces substructure regularization and transform correlation matrices into non-diagonally dominant forms. The redundant weights are suppressed and these features are redistributed to the retained filters. Thus, the layer-wise optimization with regularized weight-bias updating improves pruned model performance.
blocks.zh: 简而言之,模型压缩是获得轻量级网络的主要途径,结构化的普鲁因是一种具有代表性的轻量级方法(552). 由于红外小目标(例如纹理、形状和颜色分布薄弱)的极端特征,直接将现有的穿透方法应用于红外小目标探测似乎具有挑战性,因为这些方法是为其他任务(552)设计的,达到李等人(553)中发展出来的以下弱点: 1. 基本模块运行错误: 现有的推算方法认为特别设计的模块(例如DNA-Net中的CBAM(53),ALCNet中的BLAM(312))和常规组件同样重要。 因此,取消了几个基本单元,导致业绩下降。 2. 结构组合依赖: 先进的红外小目标探测网络使用多尺度的特征聚变或残余的跨层连接,以获得强大的通道间依赖性. 但是,现有的打压方法对这些交织的关系不敏感,依赖专家驱动的分组策略,这些策略难以适应跨层连接中的参数共享机制,并导致性能退化. 3. 重量关联约束(Wight Correlation Controlint):现有的推算方法侧重于识别冗余结构,而忽略了子结构的相关性. 这一事实会产生特征分布扰动,削弱恢复和概括能力 为了应对这三项挑战,Li等人(553人)设计了一个结构组合合作装饰相关的L2-Norm Pruning(SGDP 56 56 56 https://github.com/lyh-nudt/SGDP),这是一种任务意识结构化的推跑方法,专门设计用于红外小目标探测. SGDP方法并不是为了降低Params和FLOP,而是为了在模型压缩和小目标检测性能之间实现平衡. 首先,一个盾牌层(SL)策略保护了重要的层层不受挤压. 第二,分级结构组合(HCSG)战略利用分级连接关系和投入-产出的依赖性,将非屏蔽结构分为分组子结构。 协调会避免干扰小目标的关键信息流动路径,并确保网络的正常性。 第三,装饰相关的L2-规范化(DL2R)策略执行子结构规范化,并将关联矩阵转化为非对角主导形式. 冗余重量被压制,这些特性被重新分配到保留过滤器中. 因此,通过规范化的重量比值更新进行层位优化,可以改善被压缩的模型性能.

blocks.en: Error Pruning of Essentialrr Modules: Existing pruning methods consider the specially designed modules (e.g., CBAM in DNA-Net ( 53 ) , BLAM in ALCNet ( 312 ) ) and conventional components as equally important. Several essential modules are thus removed generating decrease in performance .
blocks.zh: 运行基本文件出错 模块 : 现有的推算方法认为特别设计的模块(例如DNA-Net中的CBAM(53),ALCNet中的BLAM(312))和常规组件同样重要。 因此,取消了几个基本单元,导致业绩下降。

blocks.en: Structural Coupled Dependencies: Advanced infrared small target detection networks use multi-scale feature fusion or residual cross-layer connections to obtain strong inter-channel dependencies. But, existing pruning methods are insensitive to these coupled relationships and rely on expert-driven grouping strategies, which struggle to adapt to parameter-sharing mechanisms in cross-layer connections and generate performance degradation.

blocks.en: In 2021, Song et al. ( 281 ) propose a semi-supervised network based on Haar Wavelet (HaarConv) using YOLOv5-s. The HaarConv module based on the high-frequency features is obtained by Haar wavelet decomposition. A HaarUp-HaarDown module is obtained by using Haar forward and inverse transform,replacing the up-sampling layer of the feature pyramid network and the down-sampling layer of backbone network to preserve smaller target features. A pseudo-label-based module conducts semi-supervised learning and reduces the labeling cost. Experiments show that HaarConv improve the detection accuracy of dim and small infrared ship targets by more than 2 % 2\% , and the number of parameters increases by only about 0.02M.
blocks.zh: 2021年,宋等编著. (281)提出基于Haar Wavelet(HaarConv)使用YOLOv5s的半监督网络. 基于高频特性的HaarConv模块由Haar波列分解获得. 一个HaarUp-HaarDown模块是通过使用Haar前向和反向变换而获得的,取代了特征金字塔网络的向上取样层和向下取样的骨干网络层,以保留较小的目标特征. 基于伪标签的模块进行半监督学习,降低标签成本. 实验显示,HaarConv将暗影和小型红外线飞船目标的探测精度提高了2%以上,参数数只增加了约0.02M.

blocks.en: In 2024, He et al. ( 559 ) design a Wavelet Transform-based Augmented Perception Network (WTAPNet 57 57 57 https://github.com/MinjieWan/WTAPNet ). First, an Enhancement and Enlarge (EE) module enhances the perceptual capability by magnifying image resolution and augmenting target features at the same time. Second, a Discrete Wavelet Transform-based Downsampling (DWTD) module and an inverse Wavelet Transform-based Fusion (IWTF) module collaboratively work to extract and combine multiscale features. Third, a bottom-up path fusion strategy highlight and preserve small-target features. Experiments on the NUDT-SIRST and the SIRST datasets show that WTAPNet obtains similar performance than previous SOTA algorithms. Zhang et al. ( 318 ) propose a Wavelet Structure-Regularized Soft Channel Pruning Network (IRPruneDet 58 58 58 https://github.com/hd0013/IRPruneDet ). IRPruneDet represents the weight matrix in the wavelet domain and formulate a wavelet channel pruning strategy. A wavelet regularization induces structural sparsity without incurring extra memory usage. A soft channel reconstruction method keeps key target information against premature pruning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that IRPruneDet provides a 64.13 % 64.13\% reduction in parameters and a 51.19 % 51.19\% decrease in FLOPS with an improvement of IoU from 73.31 % 73.31\% to 75.12 % 75.12\% and nIoU from 70.92 % 70.92\% to 74.30 % 74.30\% .
blocks.zh: 2024年,He等人(559人)设计了一个基于Wavelet变形的增强感官网络(WTAPNet 57 57 57 https://github.com/MinjieWan/WTAPNet),首先,一个增强和扩展(EE)模块通过放大图像分辨率和同时增强目标特性来增强知觉能力. 第二,一个Discrete Wavelet Transform基于Downsampling(DWTD)的模块和一个反Vowlet Transform基于Fusion(IWTF)的模块协同工作,以提取和结合多尺度特性. 第三,自下而上的路径聚变战略突出并保持小目标特征。 在NUDT-SIRST和SIRST数据集上的实验显示,WTAPNet获得的性能与之前的SOTA算法相似. 张等人(318年)提出"波浪结构-规范化软通道普润网络"(IRPruneDet 58 58s://github.com/hd0013/IRPruneDet). IRPruneDet代表波浪域中的重量矩阵,并制定了波浪通道普润策略. 波浪正规化会诱导结构的痉挛,而不会引起额外的内存使用. 软通道重建方法保存关键目标信息,防止过早的挤压. 广泛的实验表明,IRPruneDet提供64.13%的参数减少,51.19%的FLOPS减少,IoU改进了73.31%的73.31%的75.12%和NIoU,70.92%的70.92%的74.30%的74.30%的74.30%的74.30%。

blocks.en:
In 2025, Zhang et al. ( 554 ) propose a Wavelet Mamba with Reversible Structure Network (WMRNet) which comprises a Discrete Wavelet Mamba (DW-Mamba) module and a Third-order Difference Equation guided Reversible (TDE-Rev) structure. First, DW-Mamba uses the Discrete Wavelet Transform to decompose images into multiple subbands, integrating this information into the state equations of a state space model. DW- Mamba minimizes frequency interference keeping a global perspective avoiding background aliasing. Second, TDE-Rev suppresses edge aliasing effects by refining the target edges and promotes feature interactions via a reversible structure. Experiments on the IRSTD-1k and SIRST datasets show that WMRNet outperforms previous SOTA algorithms. Li et al. ( 555 ) propose a Feature Synthesis with wavelet Coefficients Networks (FSCNet) addressing the challenge of information loss prevalent deep learning models during the down-sampling process. First, FSCNet employs a wavelet coefficient-based feature extraction mechanism to separate small targets from the background. Based on a Feature Attention Gate Module (FAGM), the network enhances high-frequency details. Second, a Group Spatial-Channel Transformer Block (G-SCTB) allows the interaction and enhancement of multi-scale features. Experiments on the NUAA-SIRST, NUDT-SIRST and IRSTD-1K datasets show that FSCNet provides competitive results compared to ACM ( 37 ) , ALCNet ( 312 ) , ISNet ( 73 ) , ISTDU-Net, RDIAN ( 202 ) , DNA-Net ( 53 ) , UIU-Net ( 155 ) and SCTransNet ( 285 ) . Ma et al. ( 558 ) propose a Wavelet Steered network (WaveTD 59 59 59 https://github.com/Fortuneteller6/WaveTD ) by combining Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT) into CNN. First, Haar DWT and inverse DWT (IDWT) are embedded for lossless downsampling and upsampling for more effective feature extraction within the CNN. Second, a hybrid attention mechanism named Wavelet Steered Transformer (WST) enhances the DWT features both spatially and across channels. WST consists of two key components: 1) a Channel-wise Transformer which adapts a channel-wise Transformer to improve semantic information and suppress background clutter and noise, and 2) a Dilated-Gate Convolutional Module which enhances spatial location accuracy. It uses a combination of different kernel sizes and dilation rates to improve spatial accuracy. Experiments show that WaveTD outperforms
MSHNet ( 40 ) , WTAPNet ( 559 ) , ABCNet, AGPCNet ( 245 ) , DNA-Net ( 53 ) , LIG ( 572 ) , PSTNN ( 383 ) , TLLCM and TopHat.
blocks.zh:
2025年,张等. (554)提议采用带有可逆结构网络的波形马巴(WMRNet),其中包括一个Discrete Wavelet Mamba(DW-Mamba)模块和一个三阶差异方程式制导的可逆结构(TDE-Rev)。 首先,DW-Mamba使用Discrete Wavelet Transform将图像分解成多个子带,将这些信息整合到状态空间模型的状态方程式中. DW-Mamba将频率干扰最小化,保持全局视角,避免背景别名. 第二,TDE-Rev通过精炼目标边缘来抑制边缘别名效应,并通过可逆结构促进特征相互作用. 在IRSTD-1k和SIRST数据集上的实验显示,WMRNet超越了之前的SOTA算法. 李等编. (555)提出以波浪Coectors Networks(FSCNet)为单位的特色合成,以应对在下采样过程中普遍存在的信息流失的深度学习模型的挑战. 首先,我们... FSCNet采用波形系数特性提取机制,将小目标与背景区分开来. 基于一个特异功能注意门模块(FAGM),网络可以增强高频细节. 其次,一个Group Space-Channel Transformer Block(G-SCTB)允许多尺度特性的相互作用和增强. 在NUA-SIRST,NUDT-SIRST和IRSTD-1K数据集上的实验表明,FSCNet提供了与ACM(37),ALCNet(312),ISNet(73),ISDU-Net,RDIAN(202),DNA-Net(53),UIU-Net(155)和SCTransNet(285)相比的竞争结果. Ma等人(558年)提议通过将Discrete Wavelet Transform(DWT)合并到CNN,建立一个WaveTD引导网络(WaveTD 59 5959 https://github.com/Fortunteller6/WaveTD). 首先,Haar DWT和反向DWT(IDWT)被嵌入无损下采样和上采样,以便在CNN内更有效地提取特征. 第二,一种名为Wavelet引导变换器(WST)的混合关注机制,在空间和跨频道上都加强了DWT的特征. WST由两个主要部分组成: 1) 采用信道变换器,使信道变换器改进语义信息,抑制背景杂乱和噪音;2) 采用Dilate-Gate转录模块,提高空间位置精度。 它利用不同内核大小和放大率的结合来提高空间精度. 实验显示,WaveTD的成绩超过
MSHNet(40),WTAPNet(559),ABCNet,AGPCNet(245),DNA-Net(53),LIG(572),PSTNN(383),TLLCM和TopHat.

blocks.en: In 2025, Jing et al. ( 120 ) propose a Synergistic Wavelet-Attention Network (SWAN) to perceive targets from both spatial and frequency domains. First, SWAN exploits a Haar Wavelet Convolution (HWConv) for a deep, cross-domain fusion of the frequency energy and spatial details of small target. Second, a Shifted Spatial Attention (SSA) mechanism models long-range spatial dependencies with linear computational complexity for contextual awareness. Third, a Residual Dual-Channel Attention (RDCA) module adaptively calibrates channel-wise feature responses to avoird background interference while amplifying target-pertinent signals. Experiments show that SWAN outperforms ACM ( 37 ) ( 37 ) , ALCNet ( 312 ) , DNA-Net ( 53 ) , RDIAN ( 202 ) , UIU-Net ( 155 ) , SCTransNet ( 285 ) and DATransNet. Jiang et al. ( 560 ) propose a Wavelet-Recalibrated Semi-Supervised Network (WRSSNet) that employs synthetic data augmentation, feature reconstruction, and semi-supervised learning to exploit the potential of unlabeled infrared images under limited supervision. First, a dataset containing 843 visible-light small target images employs an improved CycleGAN model to convert them into high-quality pseudo-infrared images. Second, a lightweight Wavelet-Enhanced Channel Recalibration and Fusion (WECRF) module employs wavelet decomposition with both channel and spatial attention mechanisms. WECRF allows adaptive reweighting and fusion of multi-scale features, highlighting high-frequency details and weak target responses. Experiments on the NUAA-SIRST and IRSTD-1K datasets show that WRSSNet provides better performance than DNA-Net ( 53 ) and UIU-Net ( 155 ) . Li et al. ( 4 ) develop a doubly wavelet-guided Invariance learning framework (Ivan-ISTD 60 60 60 https://github.com/nanjin1/Ivan-ISTD ). First, training samples aligned with the target domain are generated using Wavelet-guided Cross-domain Synthesis. This wavelet-guided alignment module separates the target background via multi-frequency wavelet filtering. Second, a Real-domain Noise Invariance Learning (RNIL) module extracts real noise characteristics from the target domain to obtain a dynamic noise library. Thus, RNIL learns noise invariance via self-supervised loss. Experiments show that Ivan-ISTD outperforms most of the time ACM-Net, ALCNet ( 312 ) ,DNA-Net ( 53 ) , RDIAN ( 202 ) , ISTDU-Net,UIU-Net ( 155 ) , HCF-Net and SCTransNet ( 285 ) in presence of diverse noise distributions.
blocks.zh: 2025年, J静等. (120) 提议建立一个协同波浪-观测网络,从空间和频率两个领域来观测目标。 首先,SWAN利用Haar Wavelet Convolution(HWConv)对小目标的频率能量和空间细节进行深度,跨域融合. 第二,一个移动空间注意机制模型是具有线性计算复杂性的长距离空间依赖性,用于环境意识。 第三,一个残余双通道注意模块在适应性上校准了频道特性对模糊背景干扰的反应,同时扩展了目标相关信号。 实验显示,SWAN的性能超过了ACM(37)(37),ALCNet(312),DNA-Net(53),RDIAN(202),UIU-Net(155),SCTransNet(285)和DATransNet. 蒋等. (560)提议采用Wavelet-Recalified Semi-Supervisioned Net(WRSSNet),使用合成数据增强,特征重建,半监督学习,在有限的监督下挖掘无标签红外图像的潜力. 首先,包含843个可见光小目标图像的数据集采用了改进后的CycleGAN模型,将其转化为高质量的伪红外图像. 第二,一个轻量级的波莱-增强通道调整和融合模块(WECRF)采用波莱分解,同时采用信道和空间注意机制. WECRF允许适应性地重新加权和融合多尺度特征,突出高频细节和弱目标响应. NUA-SIRST和IRSTD-1K数据集上的实验显示,WRSSNet提供的性能优于DNA-Net(53)和UIU-Net(155). 李等编. (4)开发双波导变异性学习框架(Ivan-ISTD 60 60 60 https://github.com/nanjin1/Ivan-ISTD). 首先,与目标域一致的培训样本使用Wavelet导异域合成生成. 这个波束制导的对齐模块通过多频波束滤波将目标背景分离. 其次,一个Real-domain Noise Invariance Learning(RNIL)模块从目标域中提取出真实的噪声特性以获得动态噪声库. 因此,RNIL通过自我监督的损失来学习噪声无常. 实验表明,Ivan-ISTD在多数情况下表现优于ACM-Net,ALCNet(312),DNA-Net(53),RDIAN(202),ISTDU-Net,UIU-Net(155),HCF-Net和SCTransNet(285),存在各种各样的噪声分布.

blocks.en:
In 2025, Cui et al. ( 562 ) design an Adaptive Receptive Field Convolution and Wavelet-Attentive Hierarchical Network (ARFC-WAHNet 61 61 61 https://github.com/Leaf2001/ARFC-WAHNet ). It comprises a Multi-Receptive Field Feature Interaction Convolution (MRFFIConv) module to adaptively extract discriminative features by integrating multiple convolutional branches with a gated unit. Second, a Wavelet Frequency Enhancement Downsampling (WFED) module exploits Haar wavelet transform and frequency-domain reconstruction to improve target features and suppress background noise. Third, a High-Low Feature Fusion (HLFF) module integrates low-level details with high-level semantics. Finally, a Global Median Enhancement Attention (GMEA) enhances feature diversity and expressiveness via global attention. Experiments on the SIRST, NUDT-SIRST, and IRSTD-1k datasts show that ARFC-WAHNet outperforms most of the time
model-driven models (IPI, PSTNN) and data-driven models (ACM ( 37 ) , ALCNet ( 312 ) , DNA-Net ( 53 ) , RDIAN ( 202 ) , UIU-Net ( 155 ) , AGPCNet ( 245 ) , MSHNet ( 40 ) , MDIGCNet ( 573 ) ).
blocks.zh:
2025年,Cui 等人(562人)设计了一个适应性受体场演化和波莱特-台阶网络(ARFC-WAHNet 61 61 https://github.com/Leaf2001/ARFC-WAHNet),它包含一个多受体场特异性互动演化模块(MRFFIConv),通过将多个演化分支与闸门单元整合,以适应性地提取歧视性特征. 第二,利用波幅频率增强减少取样模块 Haar波列变换和频率域重建,以改善目标特征,抑制背景噪音. 第三,一个高Low Feature Fusion(HLFF)模块将低级细节与高级语义集成. 最后, " 全球中度增强关注 " (GMEA)通过全球关注增强多样性和表达性。 在SIRST,NUDT-SIRST和IRSTD-1k数据采集器上的实验显示,ARFC-WAHNet在大部分时间的表现都超过.
模型驱动模型(IPI,PSTNN)和数据驱动模型(ACM(37),ALCNet(312),DNA-Net(53),RDIAN(202),UIU-Net(155),AGPCNet(245),MSHNet(40),MDIGCNet(573)).

blocks.en: In 2025, Zhang et al. ( 561 ) propose a wavelet structure-regularized multidimensional musical scale Soft Channel Pruning (SCP) method named IRPruneDeXt 62 62 62 https://github.com/hd0013/IRPruneDet . It represents the weight matrix in the wavelet domain and formulates a Wavelet Channel Pruning (WCP) strategy. A wavelet regularization induces structural sparsity without incurring extra memory usage. A Multidimensional Musical scale Soft Channel Reconstruction (MMSCR) module adapts the strategy across temporal and spatial dimensions to keep key target information and prevent premature pruning. MMSCR balances pruning and reconstruction via a musical scale feedback effect. Extensive experiments demonstrate that IRPruneDeXt outperforms previous SOTA methods with a 65.68 % 65.68\% reduction in parameters, a 51.77 % 51.77\% decrease in floating-point operations (FLOPs), an augmentation of over union (IoU) from 73.31 % 73.31\% to 76.17 % 76.17\% and of normalized IoU (nIoU) from 70.92 % 70.92\% to 75.08 % 75.08\% . Li et al. ( 564 ) develop a Wavelet Transform Convolution and Hierarchical Multi-Scale Feature Fusion Network (WT-HMFF) which consists of a Wavelet Transform Convolution (WTConv) module and a Hierarchical Multi-Scale Feature Fusion (HMFF) module. First, WTConv expands the receptive field through wavelet convolution to capture global contextual information while keeping target shape characteristics. Second HMFF allows the fusion of shallow and deep features keeping the high resolution of deep feature maps and avoiding the disappearance of small target features. Experiments on the SIRST and IRSTD-1k datasets demonstrate that WT-HMFF provides most of the time better results than MDvsFA ( 243 ) , ACM ( 37 ) , DNA-Net ( 53 ) , Pconv ( 7 ) ( 7 ) , ALCNet ( 312 ) , IRPruneDet ( 318 ) , UIU-Net ( 155 ) , and SCTransNet ( 285 ) .
blocks.zh: 2025年,张等人(561人)提出波浪结构规范化多维音乐尺度软通道普鲁宁(SCP)方法命名. https://github.com/hd0013/IRPruneDet. 它代表了波浪域中的权重矩阵,并制定了波浪频道普鲁宁(WCP)策略. 波浪正规化会诱导结构的痉挛,而不会引起额外的内存使用. 一个多维音乐尺度的软通道重建(MMSCR)模块在时间和空间层面对战略进行调整,以保存关键的目标信息并防止过早的挤压. MMSCR通过音乐规模反馈效应来平衡运行和重建. 广泛的实验表明,IRPruneDeXt在以往的SOTA方法上表现优于65.68%65.68%的参数减少,浮动点操作(FLOPs)下降51.77%51.77%,过度结合(IoU)从73.31%73.31%增加到76.17 %,正规化的IoU(nIoU)从70.92%70.92%70.92%增加到75.08%75.08 %.
