blocks.en: In 2026, Fan et al. ( 282 ) propose a HaarTransNet 63 63 63 https://github.com/Big-Orange-Tiger/HaarTransNet method which exploits frequency-domain decoupling and target–background relative saliency modeling. A Haar Decoupled Downsampling Block (HDDB) allows to decouple input features along the channel dimension via the Haar Wavelet Transform (WT). HDDB avoids feature confusion and alleviates small-target attenuation during downsampling. A Haar Channel Cross Transformer (HCCT) provides a channel cross-attention mechanism to model cross-level global correlations. The low-frequency background cue guides attention to dynamically model the relative salience of targets in complex backgrounds. Experiments on the NUDT-SIRST and IRSTD-1k datasets show that HaarTransNet provides robustness in challenging scenes.
blocks.zh: 2026年,Fan等人(282人)提出了HaarTransNet 63 63 https://github.com/Big-Orange-Tiger/HaarTransNet方法,这种方法利用了频率-域域分解和目标-背景相对显赫的模型。 一个Haar Decoupled Downsampling Block(HDDB)允许通过Haar Wavelet Transform(WT)对频道维度的输入功能进行脱钩. HDDB避免了特征混淆,减轻了下采样过程中小目标的减弱. 一个Haar Channel Cross Transformer(HCCT)提供了一种频道跨关注机制,用于模拟跨级别全球关联. 低频背景提示引导人们注意动态地模拟复杂背景中目标相对突出的情况。 NUDT-SIRST和IRSTD-1k数据集上的实验显示,HaarTransNet在具有挑战性的场景中提供了坚固性.

blocks.en: In 2026, Li et al. ( 79 ) design a Wavelet-based Cross-Domain Multistage Feature Fusion Network (WCDMF-Net) that synergizes frequency-domain analysis with spatial-contextual learning. First, a parallel spatial–frequency dual-stream architecture employs Haar Wavelet Transform (HWT) and inverse Discrete Wavelet Transform (iDWT) for multiscale frequency feature extraction and reconstruction. Second, an adaptive spectral–spatial fusion block enhances features within the spatial and spectral domains and fuses these refined representations to exploit the complementary strengths of both domains. Third, a Multiscale Feature Aggregation Module (MFAM) aggregates multiscale output feature maps in the decoding phase. A multilevel cross-entropy loss function allows to achieve target localization and mask prediction. Experiments on the NUDT-SIRST, NUAA-SIRST, and IRSTD-1k datasets show that WCDMF-Net provides similar performances than SOTA methods. Cheng et al. ( 556 ) propose a state space model with Dynamic Frequency cue Aware Network (DFAwareNet 64 64 64 https://github.com/Fortuneteller6/DFAwareNet ) which exploits spatial and wavelet-domain representations. A Wavelet Guided Module (WGM) refines wavelet components to improve target-related features while suppressing background interference. A Vision State Space Model (VSSM) captures global context with linear complexity. An Hybrid Repair Gate Network (HRGN) preserves weak or subtle targets via a multi-dilated aggregation. A Mixed Feature Fusion Module (MFFM) enhances target localization through spatial–channel integration. Experiments on four benchmark datasets demonstrate that DFAwareNet achieves competitive or superior detection performance compared to TopHat, model-driven approaches (LIG ( 572 ) , PSTNN ( 383 ) , TLLCM ( 574 ) , HBMLCM) and data-driven approaches (WTAPNet ( 559 ) , MSHNet ( 40 ) , MTU-Net ( 284 ) , AGPCNet ( 245 ) , DNA-Net ( 53 ) ). Zhang et al. ( 557 ) develop a Stride-free Dual-domain Adaptive Network (SDANet) using a U-shaped architecture. First, a High-frequency Modulated Downsampling (HMD) performs stride-free downsampling by fusing the low-frequency band and the modulated high-frequency subbands generated from the discrete wavelet transform. HMD provides richer target details during downsampling while suppressing background clutter interference. Second, a Stride-free Wavelet Enhancement Module (SWEM) employs a Multi-scale Wavelet Convolution (MWC) to extract spatial and overlooked frequency-domain representations. In the decoder, an Attention-Routed Scale Adaptive (ARSA) module dynamically combies local and non-local features via input-dependent attention routing to enhance scale robustness. Experiments show that SDANet achieves superior detection accuracy and robustness compared with previous SOTA methods.
blocks.zh: 2026年,李等编著. (79)设计一个基于Wavelet的跨域功能多阶段功能融合网络(WCDMF-Net),将频率域分析与空间语境学习协同进行. 首先,一个平行的空间-频率双流架构采用Haar Wavelet Transform(HWT)和逆向Discrete Wavelet Transform(iDWT)来进行多级频率特性提取和重建. 第二,适应性光谱-空间聚变块可增强空间和光谱域内的特征,并将这些精细的表示法加以熔化,以利用这两个域的互补优势。 第三,一个多尺度的特性聚合模块(MFAM)在解码阶段将多尺度输出特征图聚合起来. 一个多层次的跨线性丢失函数可以实现目标本地化和遮罩预测. 在NUDT-SIRST,NUA-SIRST,以及IRSTD-1k数据集上的实验显示,WCDMF-Net提供的性能与SOTA方法相似. 程等编. (556)提出具有动态频率提示意识网络(DFAwareNet 64 64 64 https://github.com/Fortunteller6/DFAwareNet)的状态空间模型,该模型利用空间和波浪域表示. 一个波浪制导模块(WGM)精炼波浪组件,以改善目标相关特性,同时抑制背景干扰. A Vision State Space Model(VSSM)以线性的复杂性捕捉全球背景. 混合修理门网络通过多层聚合来保护弱或微妙的目标。 混合特性融合模块(MFFM)通过空间-通道集成增强目标本地化. 对四个基准数据集的实验表明,与TopHat、模型驱动方法(LIG(572),PSTNN(383),TLLCM(574),HBMLCM)和数据驱动方法(WTAPNet(559),MSHNet(40),MTU-Net(284),AGPCNet(245),DNA-Net(53))相比,DFAwareNet实现了竞争性或优越的检测性能. 张等. (557)利用U形架构,开发无弦无双域适应网络(SDANet). 首先,一个高频模块化的Downsampling(HMD)通过对低频波段和离散波段变换产生的调频高频子波段进行无步降样. HMD在下采样过程中提供更丰富的目标细节,同时抑制背景杂乱干扰. 第二,一个无弦波纹增强模块(SWEM)使用一个多比例波纹集合(MWC)来提取空间和被忽略的频率域表示. 在解码器中,一个注意-Routed Scale适应性(ARSA)模块通过依赖输入的注意路由,动态地组合局部和非局部特性,以提高规模稳健性. 实验显示,与以往的SOTA方法相比,SDANet实现了更高的检测精度和稳健性.

blocks.en: In 2026, Lian et al. ( 26 ) design a Parametric Manifold Network (PMNet 65 65 65 https://github.com/Lianruoqi/PMNet ) which comprises frequency-domain analysis with manifold learning. First, PMNet separates high-frequency features from the spatial domain to encode high-frequency target details across channels; accordingly. PMNet preserves the geometric structure of the target while suppressing noise. Second, a low-frequency feature block refines structural features improving discrimination between targets and backgrounds. Extensive experiments show the PMNet outperforms previous SOTA methods in both accuracy and robustness demonstrating the effectiveness of integrating wavelet decomposition with manifold learning. Ding et al. ( 563 ) develop a Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (IRKAN) with fixed, node-based activations with learnable functions on the network edges. IRKAN learns optimal, data-driven transformations for complex infrared signals. Wavelet basis functions are used to parameterize these activations. It introduces a signal-processing prior into the network exploiting the time-frequency localization properties of wavelets to function as a learnable matched filter. Experiments on the WideIRSTD-Full dataset show that IRKAN achieves a mean normalized Intersection over Union of 68.89 % 68.89\% and a low False Alarm Rate of 8.33 × 10 6 8.33\times 10^{6} , with computational efficiency requiring 3.96M parameters. Zero-shot evaluations on the unseen NUDT-SIRSTD and IRSTD-1K datasets demonstrate that IRKAN offers cross-resolution generalization capabilities.
blocks.zh: 2026年,Lian等人(26人)设计了一个参数元器件网络(PMNet 65 65 65 https://github.com/Lianruoqi/PMNet),其中包括频率域分析,并进行多方面学习. 首先,PMNet将高频特性从空间域中分离出来,以编码跨频道的高频目标细节;因此. PMNet在压制噪音的同时保留目标几何结构. 第二,低频特性块改进了结构特征,改善了目标与背景之间的区别。 广泛的实验表明,PMNet在准确性和稳健性方面都超过了以前的SOTA方法,这表明了将波浪分解与多重学习相结合的有效性。 丁等论. (563)开发一个Kolmogorov-Arnold网络(IRKAN),具有固定的,节点的激活功能,在网络边缘具有可学习的功能. IRKAN为复杂的红外信号学习优化,数据驱动的转换. 使用波浪基函数来参数化这些激活. 它将信号处理引入网络,利用波段的时间频率定位特性,发挥可学习的匹配过滤器的作用。 在WideIRSTD-Full数据集上的实验显示,IRKAN在Union上实现了68.89%的68.89%68.89%的中间正交和8.33×108.33\times 10^{6}的低假警报率,计算效率需要3.96M参数. 对看不见的NUDT-SIRSTD和IRSTD-1K数据集的零镜头评价表明,IRKAN提供了跨分辨率通用化能力.

blocks.en: 6 Mamba-based State Space Models
blocks.zh: 6. 以曼巴为基地的州空间模型

blocks.en: Mamba is a State Space Model (SSM)-based neural network architecture designed for linear-time sequence modeling. However, the direct application of Mamba alone is not effective, as it cannot fully exploit local features ( 10 ) . Thus, hybrid approaches have been developed. Table 9 shows an overview of the existing methods based on a Mamba architecture.
blocks.zh: Mamba是一个基于国家空间模型(SSM)的神经网络架构,用于线性时序建模. 然而,单靠Mamba的应用并不有效,因为它不能充分利用当地的特点(10)。 因此,制定了混合办法。 表9概述了基于Mamba架构的现有方法。

blocks.en: Table 9 : Mamba State Space Model (SSM)-based Neural Networks and Transformers-based Neural Networks: An Overview (67 papers).
blocks.zh: 表9:曼巴州空间模型基于神经网络和变形器基于神经网络:概览(67篇论文).

blocks.en: In 2024, Chen et al. ( 578 ) develop a nested structure Mamba-in-Mamba (MiM-ISTD) which comprises Outer and Inner Mamba blocks to capture both global and local features. Local patches are considered as “visual sentences” and the Outer Mamba explores the global information. Each visual sentence is then decomposed into sub-patches as “visual words”. The Inner Mamba explores the local information among words in the visual sentence with low computational costs. By using both the visual word and visual sentence features, MiM-ISTD explores both global and local information. Experiments on the NUAA-SIRST and IRSTD-1k datasets show that MiM-ISTD is 7 ​ t ​ i ​ m ​ e ​ s 7times faster than several SOTA methods and reduces GPU memory usage by 62.2 % 62.2\% on 2048 × 2048 2048\times 2048 images.
blocks.zh: 2024年,陈等. (578)开发一个由外和内曼巴区块组成的嵌入式结构Mamba-in-Mamba(MIM-ISTD),以捕捉全球和地方特征。 局部补丁被视为“视觉句子”,外曼巴则探索全球信息。 然后,每个视觉句子分解成子样,作为“视觉词”。 内曼巴以较低的计算成本在视觉句子中的单词中探索本地信息. 通过同时使用视觉单词和视觉句子功能,MiM-ISTD同时探索全球和地方信息. 在NUA-SIRST和IRSTD-1k数据集上的实验显示,MiM-ISTD比几种SOTA方法快7 t i e 7次,并在2048×2048 2048\time的图像上将GPU内存使用率减少62.2% 62.2\%.

blocks.en: In 2024, in the context of infrared dense small target detection , Xu et al. ( 76 ) develop a Fuzzy-Aware Nested Mamba (FANM) network. It leverages shallow, middle, and deep Mamba networks to fully exploit and integrate local and global multi-scale features. The extracted features are then passed to a Feature Pyramid Network (FPN) to balance the spatial resolution and semantic information of each feature map layer. After, the output features at each level are fed into the detection head. It comprises two branches: one for regressing the positions of arbitrarily distributed bounding boxes, and the other one for predicting the quality of the bounding boxes. The proposed fuzzy perceptual loss function allows to optimize these branches. Experiments on the DMIST dataset show that FANM outperforms several previous algorithms in the case of dense scenarios.
blocks.zh: 2024年,在红外密集小目标探测中,徐等人(76人)开发了Fuzzy-Aware Nested Mamba(FANM)网络. 它利用浅层、中层和深层的曼巴网络,充分利用和整合当地和全球的多尺度特征。 然后将提取的特征传递给一个地物金字塔网络(FPN),以平衡每个地物图层的空间分辨率和语义信息. 之后,将每个关卡的输出特性输入检测头. 它包括两个分支:一个用于倒置任意分布的边框的位置,另一个用于预测边框的质量。 拟议的模糊感知损失功能可以优化这些分支. 在DMIST数据集上的实验显示,FANM在稠密的情景中比之前的几种算法表现得更好.

blocks.en: In 2025, Li et al. ( 86 ) propose a Hybrid Mamba–CNN UNet (HMCNet). Its hybrid architecture extracts the local features and model the global context. Experiments on the IRSTD-1k and MISTD ( 86 ) datasets show that HMCNet outperforms RLCM, MPCM, PSTNN ( 383 ) and RDIAN ( 202 ) with high-speed inference capabilities. Lu and Zhang ( 10 ) integrate a visual Mamba module into a lightweight CNN-based network which combines the ability of CNNs to model local features and a visual Mamba module captures long-distance global features. Therefore, this model extracts both local and long-distance global feature information. Experiments on the NUAA-SIRST and NUAA-SIRSTv2 datasets show that this model provides better accuracy and lower computational complexity.
blocks.zh: 2025年,李等人(86人)提出混合曼巴-CNN UNet(HMCNet). 其混合结构提取了局部特征,模拟了全球背景. IRSTD-1k和MIST(86)数据集的实验显示,HMCNet的性能超过了RLCM,MPCM,PSTNN(383)和RDIAN(202),具有高速推论能力. 吕和章(10 )将一个视觉的曼巴模块整合到一个基于CNN的轻量级网络中,将CNN模拟本地特色的能力和视觉的曼巴模块结合在一起,捕捉长途全球特色. 因此,这个模型同时摘录了本地和长途全球地物信息. NUA-SIRST和NUA-SIRSTv2数据集上的实验显示,这个模型提供了更好的准确性和较低的计算复杂性.

blocks.en: In 2025, Yu et al. ( 583 ) propose a Spatial-BiDirectional Mamba Network (SBMambaNet) which exploits Spatial-BiDirectional Mamba Blocks (SBMBs) working in parallel with Skip Connections. SBMambaNe comprises two components. First, aSpatial-BiDirectional Cross Mamba (SCM) captures local spatial information in sequences and enhances the exchange between local spatial features and global channel data. It models bidirectional sequences for global context, and fuses features via gated mechanisms to strengthen long-range dependency and information flow. Second, a Mixed-Scale Spatial-Gate Feed-forward Network (MSGFN) improves feature discriminability via a multi-scale strategy and cross-space-channel information interaction. Second, a CNN-Mamba Channel-wise Fusion module (CMCFusion) guide the fusion of multi-scale channel information and pixel-level spatial relationships at the decoder stage. Experiments show that SBMambaNet outperforms most of the time model-based methods (PSTNN ( 383 ) , TLLCM ( 574 ) , NRAM ( 384 ) , MSLSTIPT ( 431 ) , IPI, MLCL-Net ( 407 ) , data-based methods (MDvsFA ( 243 ) , LSPM, ACM ( 37 ) , ISNet ( 73 ) , GGL-Net, DNA-Net ( 53 ) , AGPCNet ( 245 ) ), three hybrid algorithms combining CNN and ViT (IAANet ( 378 ) , Rkformer ( 610 ) , FATCNet) and MiM-ISTD.
blocks.zh: 2025年,Yu等人(583人)提议建立一个空间-BiDirectional Mamba网络(SBMambaNet),利用空间-BiDirectional Mamba区块(SBMBs)与Skip Connections平行工作。 斯巴马 Ne包含两个组成部分. 首先,aSpatial-BiDirectional Cross Mamba(SCM)按顺序捕捉本地空间信息,并加强本地空间特征与全球通道数据的交流. 它为全球背景模拟双向序列,并通过有门机制的引信特性,以加强长期依赖和信息流动。 第二,一个混合规模的空间-Gate饲料前进网络(MSGFN)通过多种规模的战略和跨空间渠道的信息互动,提高了特征的区别性。 第二,一个CNN-Mamba Channel-wise Fusion模块(CMCFusion)在解码器阶段指导多尺度通道信息和像素级空间关系的聚合. 实验显示,SBMambaNet在大多数基于时间模型的方法(PSTNN(383),TLLCM(574),NRAM(384),MSLSTIPT(431),IPI,MLCL-Net(407)),基于数据的方法(MDvsFA(243),LSPM,ACM(37),ISNet(73),GGL-Net,DNA-Net(53),AGPCNet(245)),三种混合算法结合了CNN和VIT(IAANet(378),Rkformer(610),FATCNet)和M-ISTD.

blocks.en: In 2025, Zhang et al. ( 5 ) propose IRMamba which is based on an encoder-decoder architecture featuring Pixel Difference Mamba (PDMamba) and a Layer Restoration Module (LRM). First, PDMamba employs the intensity and directional information of pixel differences between scanning positions and their central neighborhoods into the state equation of the state space model (SSM). PDMamba improves target detail representation and avoids background interference by capturing local 2D dependencies from a global perspective. Second, ILRM employs the double-depth image prior into the iterative convergence algorithm, and uses the inter-layer interrelationships to reverse the separation of the target layer. Experiments conducted on the NUAA-SIRST, NUDT-SIRST, and IRSTD-1K datasets show the advantages of IRMamba compared to data-driven models (DNANet ( 53 ) , Dim2Clear ( 317 ) , ALCNet ( 312 ) , ACMNet), hybrid methods (RKformer ( 610 ) , SCTransNet ( 285 ) , IAANet), and traditional methods (Top-Hat). Jiang et al. ( 575 ) design an Efficient Adaptive Mamba Network (EAMNet 66 66 66 https://github.com/jiangjin1246/EAMNet ). First, a Mamba-based UNet architecture processes separated features in parallel with a low parameter count and computational cost. An Adaptive Filter Module (AFM) applies adaptive filtering by estimating filter parameters via an additional designed sub-network. A Shared Adaptive Spatial Attention Module (SASAM) allows a compact feature representation in generating spatial attention maps. Extensive experiments show that EAMNet improves accuracy and efficiency compared to previous SOTA methods.
blocks.zh: 2025年,张等. (5)提议IRMamba,它基于一个编码器-解码器架构,其特点是Pixel Difference Mamba(PDMamba)和一个图层恢复模块(LRM). 首先,PDMamba将扫描位置与其中心邻里之间的像素差异的强度和方向信息应用到状态空间模型(SSM)的状态方程式中. PDMamba通过从全球角度捕捉本地2D依赖性来改进目标细节表现,避免背景干扰. 其次,ILRM在迭代汇合算法中先使用双深图像,并使用层间相互关系来逆转目标层的分离. 在NUA-SIRST,NUDT-SIRST,以及IRSTD-1K数据集上进行的实验显示,与数据驱动模型(DNANet(53),Dim2Clear(317),ALCNet(312),ACMNet),混合方法(RKformer(610),SCTransNet(285),IAANet)相比,IRMamba的优点和传统方法(Top-Hat). Jiang等人(575人)设计了一个高效适应的Mamba网络(EAMNet 66 66 66 https://github.com/jiangjin1246/EAMNet). 首先,一个基于Mamba的UNet架构处理功能分离,与参数计数和计算成本低平行. 一个适应性滤波器模块(AFM)通过额外设计的子网络对滤波器参数进行估计,应用适应性滤波器. 共享适应性空间注意力模块(SASAM)允许在生成空间注意力图时进行紧凑的特征表示. 广泛的实验表明,与以往的SOTA方法相比,EAMNet提高了精度和效率.

blocks.en: In 2025, Ye et al. ( 577 ) develop the Mamba Residual Network (MRNet). MRNet comprises two modules: the Mamba Residual Interaction Module (MRIM) and the Attention Enhanced Module (AEM). MRIM improves feature extraction progressively. AEM reduces missed detections and false alarms in complex scenes. A Center-Focused Strategy with an incentive and penalty mechanism allows to focus the network on the target’s center to improve detection accuracy. Experiments on the NUAA-SIRST, IRSTD-1 K, and NUDT-SIRST datasets show that MRNet outperforms existing IRSTD methods outperforms single-frame methods (ACM, RDIAN ( 202 ) , ISTDU-Net ( 159 ) , UIU-Net ( 155 ) , DNA-Net ( 53 ) , SCTransNet ( 285 ) , MSHNet ( 40 ) , MTU-Net ( 284 ) , MiM ( 578 ) ) and multi-frame methods (SSTNet, Tridos, TSI-Net ( 77 ) ). Liu et al. ( 11 ) design a Multi-Order U-shape Mamba (MOU-Mamba) to explore the suitability of 2D-Selective-Scan (SS2D) technique. First, a Multi-Order 2D-Selective-Scan (MO-SS2D) module gradually minimizes redundant information produced by SS2D operations via multi-order interactions. Second, a Local-Guided 2D-Selective-Scan (LG-SS2D) module improves target discernibility by constructing complementary local and global features at each interaction level. Experiments show that MOU-Mamba outperforms SOTA methods with an effective balance between accuracy and computational complexity.
blocks.zh: 2025年,Ye等人(577人)开发了曼巴残留网络(MRNet). MRNet包括两个模块:曼巴残余互动模块和注意力增强模块。 MRIM逐渐改进了特征提取. AEM在复杂场景中减少误测和假警报. 具有奖励和惩罚机制的中心式战略使网络能够把注意力集中在目标中心,以提高检测的准确性。 关于NUA-SIRST、IRSTD-1 K和NUDT-SIRST数据集的实验显示,MRNet的绩效超过了现有的IRSTD方法,超过了单帧方法(ACM、RDIAN(202),ISTDU-Net(159),UIU-Net(155),DNA-Net(53),SCTransNet(285),MSHNet(40),MTU-Net(284),MIM(578))和多帧方法(SSTNet,Tridos,TSI-Net(77))。 刘等. (11) 设计一种多序U形Mamba(MOU-Mamba),以探索2D-Selective-Scan(SS2D)技术的合适性. 首先,一个多命令2D-Selective-Scan(MO-SS2D)模块通过多顺序交互,逐渐将SS2D操作产生的冗余信息最小化. 第二,一个本地指导的2D-Selective-Scan(LG-SS2D)模块通过在每个互动层面构建互补的本地和全球特征,提高了目标的可辨性。 实验表明,MOU-Mamba在精确度和计算复杂性之间有效平衡的情况下,超过了SOTA方法。

blocks.en: In 2025, in the context of heterogeneous backgrounds , Li et al. ( 581 ) propose a Mamba-driven approach named Spatial–spectral Mamba Interactive Learning (SMILE) network to deal with heterogeneous backgrounds. The reconstructed data couples Mamba’s flattened multidirectional scanning mechanism. Spatial Mamba and spectral Mamba collaboratively enhance the semantic features of small targets. A dual-path aggregation (DPA) network integrates the saliency and high-frequency attributes of small targets on order to balance detailed and contextual features. A Hybrid Representation Learning Module (HRLM) refines the local features to preserve the edge structure. Experiments show that SMILE outperforms 14 previous algorithms. Li et al. ( 582 ) design a Multi-granularity representation learning with vision Mamba (MRL-Mamba) which is a nested structure with cross-fertilization of global and local information. Each layer of the top-level pyramid network embeds a tiny well-configured contextual pyramid block to extract fine-grained features of small targets. Then, a Mamba module restructures the feature maps to derive coarse-grained features of “visual sentences”. The fusion of contextual information and local feature provides the localization of small targets. An Asymmetric Convolution (AConv) is employed as a subtitute of the Depthwise Convolution (DWConv) in the Visual State Space (VSS) module. A regular convolution in each lateral connection of the nested pyramid network allows to alleviate the parameters and computation. Experiments show that MRL-Mamba outperforms 12 previous methods. Xu et al. ( 280 ) design a framework based on SAM2’s hierarchical feature learning and a Mamba’s selective sequence modeling. SAMamba 67 67 67 https://github.com/zhengshuchen/SAMamba comprises three components. First, a Feature Selection Adapter (FS-Adapter) is employed for natural-to-infrared domain adaptation via dual-stage selection (token-level with a learnable task embedding and channel-wise adaptive transformations). Second, a Cross-Channel State-Space Interaction (CSI) module is used for global context modeling with linear complexity using selective state space modeling. Third, a Detail-Preserving Contextual Fusion (DPCF) module adaptively combines multi-scale features with a gating mechanism to balance high-resolution and low-resolution feature contributions. Experiments on the NUAA-SIRST, IRSTD-1k, and NUDT-SIRST datasets show SAMamba outperforms ACM ( 37 ) , U-Net, ISNet ( 73 ) , FC3-Net ( 211 ) , UIU-Net ( 155 ) and HCFNet in the case of heterogeneous backgrounds and varying target scales. Li and Wang ( 584 ) propose a Mamba-driven approach dubbed Spectrum-Assisted Mamba Network (SAMNet). First, a reconstructed data couples Mamba’s flattened multidirectional scanning mechanism. Second, a spatial Mamba and a spectral Mamba collaboratively enrich the semantic features of small targets. Third, a Dual-Path Aggregation (DPA) network employs the saliency and high-frequency attributes of small targets. An Hybrid Representation Learning Module (HRLM) refines the local features to inscribe the intact edge structure. Experiments show that SAMNet outperforms 14 previous algorithms.
blocks.zh: 2025年,以不同背景为背景的李等人. (581) 提出由Mamba驱动的方法,命名为Space-光谱Mamba交互式学习网络,以处理不同背景。 重建的数据伴侣Mamba平整多方向扫描机制。 空间曼巴和光谱曼巴协同增强小目标的语义特征. 双路径聚合(DPA)网络整合了小目标的显著性和高频属性,以平衡详细和背景特征. 混合代表学习模块(HRLM)完善了局部特征,以保留边缘结构. 实验显示SMILE的性能超过了前14个算法. 李等编. (582) 设计一种具有视觉Mamba(MRL-Mamba)的多角性代表学习,这是一种具有全球和地方信息的交叉增益的巢状结构. 顶层金字塔网络的每层都嵌入一个小的,配置良好的背景金字塔块,以提取小目标精细的特征. 然后,一个Mamba模块重组了特征图,以得出“视觉句子”粗糙的特征。 结合了背景信息和局部特征,提供了小目标的地方化. 在视觉状态空间(VSS)模块中,使用非对称演化(AConv)作为深度演化(DWConv)的替代构件. 在嵌入式金字塔网络的每次横向连接中进行定期的演化,可以缓解参数和计算. 实验表明,MRL-曼巴的成绩超过了之前的12种方法. 徐等人(280人)根据SAM2的等级特征学习和曼巴的选择性序列模型设计了框架. Samamba 67 67 67 https://github.com/zhengshuchen/Samamba由三个部分组成。 首先,采用了一种特性选择适应器(FS-Adapter),通过双阶段选择进行自然至红外域适应(有可学习的任务嵌入和通道的适应性转换). 其次,一个跨频道的国与空间互动(CSI)模块被用于具有线性复杂性的全球背景模型,使用选择性的国与空间模型. 第三,一个详细保存背景聚变(DPCF)模块适应性地结合了多尺度的特性和一个平衡高分辨率和低分辨率的特性贡献的吉祥机制. 在NUA-SIRST、IRSTD-1k和NUDT-SIRST数据集上的实验显示,在背景不同和目标尺度不同的情况下,Samamba超过了ACM(37),U-Net,ISNet(73),FC3-Net(211),UIU-Net(155)和HCFNet。 李和旺(584人)提出以曼巴为驱动方式,被誉为Spectrum-Asssided Mamba Network(SAMNet). 首先,一个重建的数据伴侣Mamba的平整多方向扫描机制。 第二,空间曼巴和光谱曼巴合作丰富了小目标的语义特征. 第三,双帕聚合(DPA)网络使用小目标的显著性和高频属性. 混合代表学习单元(HRLM)改进了当地特征,以描述完好无损的边缘结构。 实验显示,SAMNet超越了之前的14个算法.

blocks.en: In 2026, in the context of heterogeneous backgrounds , Sui et al. ( 585 ) design a Stream Alignment Mamba for Motion In-frared Small Target Detection (SAMamba). First, a Stream Mamba Block based on a dynamic state space model employs bidirectional spatiotemporal scanning to explore inter-frame relationships in sequential images preserving spatial correlations and exploitin the causality of temporal cues for global background representation. Second, a Cross-Frame Feature Enhancement Block aligns feature streams by computing local responses between neighboring and reference frames. Third, a H-erarchical Feature Alignment Block with adaptive adjustment strategies and position-aware mechanisms handle spatial misalignment during upsampling. Experiments on the IRDST, IRSatVideo-LEO, and TSIRMT datasets show that SAMamba provides significant advantages compared to previous SOTA methods. Tang et al. ( 586 ) propose an orientation-guided Mamba framework (TAMamba) with a Texture-Aware State-Space Module (TSSM) and a Deep Focus Algorithm (DFA). First, TSSM employs explicit physical orientation priors to provide dynamic texture mask. Second, DFA enhances target representations by performing selective normalization that enhances sparse small-target signals while avoiding background interference. Experiments on the NUAA-SIRST, IRSTD-1 k, and NUDT-SIRST datasets show that TAMamba provides SOTA performance with only 2.3 M parameters, reducing parameters by 51 % 51\% while maintaining superior accuracy and robustness in complex scenarios.
blocks.zh: 2026年,在背景各异的情况下,Sui et al. (585)设计一个流线对齐的Mamba用于运动红外小目标探测(Samamba). 首先,基于动态状态空间模型的Stream Mamba块采用双向瞬时扫描法,在连续图像中探索框架间关系,保存空间相关性,并利用时间提示的因果关系进行全球背景显示。 第二, 跨Frame 特性增强 Block通过计算邻居和参考框架之间的本地响应来对特征流进行校正. 第三,具有适应性调整策略和位置感知机制的H-超结构特征对接区块在取样时处理空间错配。 在IRDST,IRSatVideo-LEO,TSIRMT数据集上的实验显示,与以前的SOTA方法相比,Samamba提供了显著优势. 唐等编著. (586 )提出定向制导的曼巴框架(TAMamba),其中包含一个纹理-阿瓦雷状态-空间模块(TSSM)和一个深聚焦算法(DFA). 首先,TSSM使用明显的物理方向前缀来提供动态纹理面具. 第二,外交部通过有选择地实现正常化,在避免背景干扰的同时增强稀少的小型目标信号,从而加强目标表述。 在NUA-SIRST,IRSTD-1 k,NUDT-SIRST数据集上的实验显示,TAMamba只提供2.3M参数的SOTA性能,将参数减少51%-51%\%,同时在复杂的情景中保持优越的准确性和稳健性.

blocks.en: In 2026, Zhang et al. ( 576 ) design Mamba-IRSTD 68 68 68 https://github.com/Fidods/Mamba-IRSTD based on an encoder–decoder architecture. In the encoder, a dual-residual-path Mamba block combines the complementary advantages of CNNS and Mamba-based state space models for global context modeling. A multi-scale feature adaptive aggregation block enhances the representation of features across multiple scales. In the decoder, an edge-aware attention module is coupled with a multi-scale shape-adaptive fusion head to focus explicitly on edge features Experiments show that Mamba-IRSTD outperforms AGPC, FDPF, ViAMLN, HFMNet and WaveTD in terms of FLOPs and fps. Wu et al. ( 128 ) develop a method guided by Causal Predictive state space and reconstruction refinement named CPMamba. During feature extraction, inherent discriminative power is done by separating predictable low-rank background components from anomalous small targets. The Causal Predictive State–Space Model (CP-SSM) exploits ”discriminability” contextual information to guide attention. A Feature Reconstruction Refinement Block (FRRB) use a detail-oriented pathway for structural recovery and a semantic-aware pathway for noise suppression. Extensive experiments on the NUDT-SIRST, IRSTD-1K, and SIRST-UVAB datasets show that CPMamba provides most of the time beter results than PConv ( 7 ) , ACMNet, UIU-Net ( 155 ) , DenseNet and SCTransNet. Li et al. ( 98 ) propose a Bidirectionally Driven Saliency Fusion network (BDSFusion 69 69 69 https://github.com/kyrietop11/BDSFusion ). First, a feature extraction module named CSA-CM based on a Conv-Mamba (CM) module and a Channel Self-attention (CSA) module allows to reduce the channel redundancy of the Mamba module. Second, a spatial-frequency cross-domain feature integration module (SFCIM) exploits the complementary characteristics of spatial and frequency-domain information from source images. A task-driven joint loss function combines intensity loss, Haar wavelet mask loss, and background residual loss to guide the fusion network. Experiments on MWIR and LWIR images show that BDSFusion outperforms ACM-Net, DNA-Net ( 53 ) , IR-TransDet ( 236 ) , and ILNet ( 233 ) .
blocks.zh: 2026年,张等人(576人)设计了Mamba-IRSTD 68 68 https://github.com/Fidods/Mamba-IRSTD,基于一种编码器–decoder架构. 在编码器中,一个双残留-路径的Mamba块结合了CNNS和以Mamba为基础的状态空间模型对全球背景模型的补充优势. 一个多尺度的特征适应性集合块可以提高多个尺度的特征的体现. 在解码器中,一个边缘感知的注意力模块与一个多尺度的形状适应聚变头结合,明确聚焦于边缘特征 实验显示,从FLOPs和fps的角度来看,曼巴-IRSTD在AGPC,FDPF,ViAMLN,HFMNet和WaveTD上的表现都超过了. 吴等. (128)在Causal预测状态空间和名为CPMamba的重建完善的指导下,开发一种方法. 在地物提取过程中,通过将可预见的低级背景成分与异常的小目标区分开来实现固有的歧视性力量. 原因预测状态-空间模型(CP-SSM)利用 " 可区分性 " 的背景资料来指导人们的注意。 特性重建完善区块(FRRB)采用面向细节的结构恢复途径和语义意识抑制噪音途径。 对NUDT-SIRST、IRSTD-1K和SIRST-UVAB数据集的广泛试验表明,CPMamba提供了大部分时间下注结果,而不是PConv(7),ACMNet,UIU-Net(155),DenseNet和SCTransNet. Li等人(98)提出双向驱动的Saliency Fusion网络(BDSFusion 69 69 https://github.com/kyrietop11/BDSFusion ),首先,基于Conv-Mamba(CM)模块和通道自留(CSA)模块命名为CSA-CM的功能提取模块可以减少Mamba模块的信道冗余. 第二,空间频跨域功能集成模块(SFCIM)利用源图像提供的空间和频域信息的互补特征. 任务驱动的联合损失功能结合强度损失,哈尔波莱特面具损失,以及背景剩余损失来引导聚变网络. 关于MWIR和LWIR图像的实验表明,BDSFusion优于ACM-Net,DNA-Net(53),IR-TransDet(236)和ILNet(233).

blocks.en: In 2026, in the context of multi-frame detection , Qiu et al. ( 579 ) propose a Spatial–Temporal (STLMamba) framework based on long-range dependency modeling with local feature sensitivity and guided by infrared video and frequency priors. First, an Adaptive Multidirectional Frequency Enhancement (AMFE) module leverages spatial frequency cues to enhance targets. Second, a Efficient Local-motion Mamba (ELM) with a learnable local dynamic Gaussian motion (LDGM) mechanism captures motion patterns and suppresses background noise. Experiments show that STLMamba provides 43.14 fps and 49.22 fps for the NUDT-MIRSDT and TSIRMT, respectively. Xie et al. ( 580 ) develop a Trajectory-Aware Mamba Propagation Network (TAPM-Net) which models the spatial diffusion behavior of target-induced feature disturbances. TAPM-Net comprises two modules: a Perturbation-guided Path Module (PGM) and a Trajectory-Aware State Block (TASB). First, PGM constructs perturbation energy fields from multi-level features and extracts gradient-following feature trajectories that reflect the directionality of local responses. The resulting feature trajectories are fed into a Mamba-based state-space unit that models dynamic propagation along each trajectory while incorporating velocity-constrained diffusion and semantically aligned feature fusion from word-level and sentence-level embeddings. TAPM-Net tackles anisotropic, context-sensitive state transitions along spatial trajectories while keeping global coherence at low computational cost. Experiments on the NUAA-SIRST and IRSTD-1K datasets show that TAPM-Net achieves SOTA performance.
blocks.zh: 2026年,在多帧探测的背景下,邱等. (579)提议一个空间-时空(STLMamba)框架,其基础是具有局部特性敏感性的远程依赖性模型,并以红外线视频和频率前传为指导。 首先,一个适应性多向频率增强模块利用空间频率提示来增强目标。 第二,具有可学习的本地动态高斯运动(LDGM)机制的高效局部运动曼巴(ELM)能捕捉运动模式并抑制背景噪声. 实验显示STLMamba提供43.14 fps和49. 22 fps分别用于NUDT-MIRSDT和TSIRMT. 谢等. (580)开发一个Traprextory-Aware Mamba传播网络(TAPM-Net),以模拟目标引发的特征扰动的空间扩散行为. TAPM-Net由两个模块组成:扰动制导路径模块(PGM)和Traphory-Aware状态块(TASB)。 首先,PGM从多层次特征构建扰动能量场,并提取梯度跟随的特征轨迹,以反映本地响应的方向性. 由此产生的特征轨迹被输入一个基于曼巴的状态-空间单元,该单元沿每个轨迹进行动态传播,同时将速度受限制的传播和从字位和句子级嵌入的集合特征组合起来。 TAPM-Net沿着空间轨迹处理异同位素的、对上下文敏感的状态过渡,同时以低计算成本保持全球一致性。 NUAA-SIRST和IRSTD-1K数据集上的实验显示,TAPM-Net实现了SOTA性能.

blocks.en: 7 Transformers-based Neural Networks
blocks.zh: 7个基于变形器的神经网络

blocks.en: Table 9 shows an overview of the existing methods based on a Transformers-based Neural Networks.
blocks.zh: 表9概述了基于变形器神经网络的现有方法。

blocks.en: In 2022, Chen et al. ( 235 ) design a Hierarchical Overlapped Small Patch Transformer (HOSPT) to encode multi-scale features from the single-frame image. A Top-down Feature Aggregation Module (TFAM) fuses features from adjacent scales. Experiments show that IRSTFormer outperforms most of the time DNA-Net ( 53 ) , AGPCNet ( 245 ) , LSPM and MDvsFA. Zhang et al. ( 610 ) provides a Runge-Kutta Transformer (RKformer) with random-connection attention. The Parallel Encoder Block (PEB) of the transformer and convolution take their advantages in long-range dependency modeling and locality modeling. Two PEBs are stacked with several residual connections under the guidance of RK methods for solving ODE as the basic encoder block. the Random-Connection Attention (RCA) block learns sparse attention through random connections during training. Experiments show that RKformer provides SOTA performance.
blocks.zh: 2022年,陈等. (235) 设计一个高阶叠加的小补丁变形器(HOSPT),从单帧图像编码多级特性. 自上而下的特点聚合模块(TFAM)引信的特性来自相邻的尺度。 实验显示,IRSTFormer在DNA-Net(53),AGPCNet(245),LSPM和MDvsFA的大部分时间表现优于. 张等人(610年)提供Runge-Kutta变形器(RKformer)随机连接关注. 变压器的平行编码器块(PEB)和演化器在远程依赖性模型和地点模型的制作中具有优势. 两个PEB在 RK 方法的引导下作为基本的编码器块解析ODE 上堆叠着几个剩余连接. 随机连接注意(RCA)块在训练期间通过随机连接学习到的注意力稀少. 实验显示RKFormer提供SOTA性能.

blocks.en:
In 2023, Lin et al. ( 236 ) propose IR-TransDet which combines advantages of the CNN and the Transformer. First, an Efficient Feature Extraction Module (EFEM) employs depthwise convolution and Point-Wise Convolution (PW Conv) to capture the features of the target. Second, a Residual Sim Atrous Spatial Pyramid Pooling (ASPP) module enhances the edge information of the target. Third, an IR-Transformer module employs a self-attention mechanism to exploit the relationship between the global image, the target, and neighboring pixels. Experiments show that IRTransDet provides SOTA performance. Liu et al. ( 237 ) develop a method with the transformer. First, the self-attention mechanism of the transformer learns the correlation of image features in a larger range. Second, a feature enhancement module learns discriminative features. Third, a decoder with the U-Net-like skip connection operation allows to capture more information. Experiments show the proposed method offers SOTA performance with a stronger generalization ability and better robustness to noise. Li et al. ( 608 ) propose an
Infrared Small Target Transformer Network (IST-TransNet). An Anti-aliasing Contextual Feature Fusion (ACFF) module improves the translation invariance during contextual feature fusion for locating infrared small targets. A Spatial and Channel Attention (SCA) module allows to To suppress complex background interference and highlight the features of infrared small target. A vision-transformer branch (VTB) suppresses the interference of local flash elements by introducing non-local correlation features. Experiments show that IST-TransNet outperforms the model-driven methods (IPI, NRAM, PSTNN, RIPT) and data-driven methods (DNANet ( 53 ) , AGPCNet).
blocks.zh:
2023年,Lin等人(236人)提出IR-TransDet,其中结合了CNN和变形金刚的优势. 第一,一个高效的地物提取模块(EFEM)采用深度演化和点-智慧演化(PW Convolution)来捕捉目标特征. 其次,一个残留的Sim Athrous空间金字塔聚泳(ASPP)模块可以增强目标的边缘信息. 第三,一个IR-Transformer模块采用了一种自我关注机制,以利用全球图像,目标,以及相邻像素之间的关系. 实验显示IRTransDet提供SOTA性能. 刘等. (237)与变压器一起开发一种方法. 首先,变压器的自感机制在更大的范围内学习图像特征的关联性. 其次,一个特征增强模块学习了歧视性特征. 第三,与U-Net相似的跳过连接操作的解码器可以捕捉到更多的信息. 实验显示,拟议方法提供了SOTA性能,具有更强的泛化能力和更强的噪声强度. 李等人(608人)提议
红外小目标变换器网络(IST-TransNet). 反异化背景特性聚变(ACFF)模块在定位红外小目标时改进了背景特性聚变过程中的变异性. 空间和通道注意(SCA)模块可以压制复杂的背景干扰,突出红外小目标的特点. 一个视觉转换分支(VTB)通过引入非局部相关特性来抑制局部闪光元素的干扰. 实验显示,IST-TransNet超越了模型驱动方法(IPI, NRAM, PSTNN, RIPT)和数据驱动方法(DNANet(53),AGPCNet).

blocks.en:
In 2023, in the context of tiny ship detection , Wu et al. ( 609 ) design a Multilevel TransUNet (MTU-Net 70 70 70 https://github.com/TianhaoWu16/Multi-level-TransUNet-for-Space-based-Infrared-Tiny-ship-Detection ). It consists of a vision Transformer (ViT) CNN hybrid encoder to extract multilevel features. First, local feature maps are extracted by several convolution layers and then fed into the multilevel feature extraction module to capture long-distance dependency. A Copy–Rotate–Resize–Paste (CRRP) data augmentation approach accelerates the training phase. A FocalIoU loss achieves both target localization and shape description. Experiments on the NUDT-SIRST-Sea dataset show that MTU-Net outperforms model-driven and previous data-driven model in SIRST methods in terms of probability of detection, false alarm rate, and intersection over union.
address this problem by proposing a novel RKformer model with an encoder-decoder structure, where four specifically designed Runge-Kutta transformer (RKT) blocks are stacked sequentially in the encoder. Technically, it has three key designs. First, we adopt a parallel encoder block (PEB) of the transformer and convolution to take their advantages in long-range dependency modeling and locality modeling for extracting semantics and preserving details. Second, we propose a novel random-connection attention (RCA) block, which has a reservoir structure to learn sparse attention via random connections during training. RCA encourages the target to attend to sparse relevant positions instead of all the large-area background pixels, resulting in more informative attention scores. It has fewer parameters and computations than the original self-attention in the transformer while performing better. Third, inspired by neural ordinary differential equations (ODE), we stack two PEBs with several residual connections as the basic encoder block to implement the Runge-Kutta method for solving ODE, which can effectively enhance the feature and suppress noise. Experiments on the public NUAA-SIRST dataset and IRSTD-1k dataset demonstrate the superiority of the RKformer over state-of-the-art methods.
blocks.zh:
2023年,吴等人(609人)在微小的船舶探测中设计了多级跨UNet(MTU-Net 70 70 70 https://github.com/TianhaoWu16/Multial-level-TransUNet- for-Space-Infred-Tiny-ship-Detection),由视觉变形器(ViT)CNN混合编码器组成,以提取多级特征. 首先,局部特征图由几个演化层提取,然后输入多层特征提取模块,以捕捉长距离依赖. 复制-旋转-恢复-备份(CRRP)数据增强方法可加快培训阶段。 焦距U损失既实现了目标本地化,也实现了形状描述. 在NUDT-SIRST-Sea数据集上的实验显示,MTU-Net在SIRST方法中的模型驱动和之前的数据驱动模型在检测概率,假警报速率,以及交汇于结合之上方面都超过了性能.
解决这个问题的方法是提出一种带有编码器-解码器结构的新式RKformer模型,其中四个专门设计的Runge-Kutta变压器(RKT)块在编码器中依次堆放. 从技术上讲,它有三个关键设计. 首先,我们采用变压器的平行编码器块(PEB)并进,以利用它们在提取语义和保存细节的远程依赖模型和局部模型方面的优势. 第二,我们提出一个新的随机连接注意(RCA)块,该块具有储水层结构,在训练期间通过随机连接学习稀疏的注意. RCA鼓励目标关注稀少的相关位置,而不是所有大面积背景像素,从而获得更多的信息关注分数. 它在性能较好的同时,其参数和计算比变压器中原有的自我注意更少. 第三,受神经普通微分方程(ODE)的启发,我们堆放两个PEB与几个剩余连接作为基本的编码器块,以实施Runge-Kutta方法解决ODE,这可以有效地增强特性和抑制噪音. 在公共的NUAA-SIRST数据集和IRSTD-1k数据集上的实验表明RKformer优于最先进的方法.

blocks.en: In 2023, Peng et al. ( 602 ) design CourtNet 71 71 71 https://github.com/PengJingchao/CourtNet to dynamically balance the precision and recall rates. CourtNet consists of three sub-networks. First, a prosecution network improves the recall rate. Second, a defendant network increases the precision rate. Third, a jury network weights their results to adaptively balance the precision and recall rates. CourtNet employs the structure of Transformers, whose feature resolution remains unchanged. The prosecution network employs a densely connected structure, which can prevent small targets from disappearing in the forward propagation. A fine-grained attention module performs attention inside patches to locate the small targets. Experiments on the ISTD, MFIRST and SIRST datasets show that CourtNet outperforms traditional and data-based methods with a detection speed of 60.61 fps and the best score of 0.73 in SIRST and 0.62 in MFIRST
blocks.zh: 2023年,彭等人(602年)设计CourtNet 71 71 https://github.com/PengJingchao/CourtNet,以动态平衡精度和召回率. CourtNet由三个子网络组成. 首先,起诉网络提高了收监率。 二,被告网络提高精准率. 第三,陪审团网络对其结果进行加权,以适应性地平衡精确率和召回率。 CourtNet采用了变形器的结构,其特性解析度保持不变. 起诉网络采用连接密集的结构,可以防止小目标在前方传播中消失。 一个精细的注意模块在补丁内进行注意以定位小目标. ISTD,MFIRST和SIRST数据集的实验显示,CourtNet的检测速度超过传统的和基于数据的方法,SIRST的检测速度为60.61英尺,最佳得分为0.73分和MFIRST的0.62分.

blocks.en: In 2024, Yuan et al. ( 285 ) design a Spatial-channel Cross Transformer Network (SCTransNet 72 72 72 https://github.com/xdFai/SCTransNet ) which exploits Spatial-Channel Cross Transformer Blocks (SCTBs) on top of long-range Skip Connections (SKs). In SCTBs, the outputs of all encoders are interacted with cross transformer to provide mixed features, which are redistributed to all decoders to reinforce semantic differences between the target and clutter at full levels. SCTB comprises two modules. First, a spatial-embedded single-head channel cross-attention (SSCA) allows to exchange local spatial features and full-level global channel information to suppress ambiguity among the encoders and facilitate high-level semantic associations of the images. Second, a Complementary Feed-forward Network (CFN) enhances the feature discriminability through a multiscale strategy and cross-spatial-channel information interaction to promote transfer. SCTransNetencodes the semantic differences between targets and backgrounds to boost its internal representation. Experiments on the NUDT-SIRST, NUAA-SIRST, and IRSTD-1K, datasets show that SCTransNet outperforms several previous SOTA methods. Huang et al. ( 595 ) develop a Local Motion Aware Transformer Network (LMAFormer 73 73 73 https://github.com/lifier/LMAFormer ). First, a local motion-aware spatiotemporal attention mechanism aligns and enhances multi-frame features to extract local spatiotemporal salient features of targets while suppressing interference from moving backgrounds. Second, a multiscale fusion transformer encoder computes self-attention weights across and within scales during encoding to obtain multiscale correlations among different regions of temporal images, enabling motion background modeling. Third, a multi-frame joint query decoder is employed. The shallowest feature map is mapped to initial query weights. Experiments on the NUDT-MIRSDT, IRDST, and TSIRMT datasets show that LMAFormer provides similar results than previous SOTA methods.
blocks.zh: 2024年,袁等人(285人)设计了空间通道跨变形器网络(SCTransNet 72 72 https://github.com/xdFai/SCTransNet),利用空间-通道跨变形器块(SCTBs)在远程跳过连接(SKs)之上. 在SCTBs中,所有编码器的输出都与交叉变速器相互作用,以提供混合特性,这些特性被重新分配到所有解码器中,以加强目标与整流层的语义差异. SCTB包含两个模块. 首先,空间嵌入式单头通道交叉式(SSCA)可以交换局部空间特征和全层全球通道信息,以抑制编码器之间的模糊性,并促进图像的高层次语义协会. 第二,一个补充性饲料前进网络(CFN)通过多种规模的战略和跨空间信息互动,加强特征的区别性,以促进转让。 SCTransNeten编码了目标与背景之间的语义差异,以提高其内部代表性. 在NUDT-SIRST,NUA-SIRST,以及IRSTD-1K上的实验,数据集显示SCTransNet的性能超过了之前的几种SOTA方法. Huang等人(595)开发了本地运动感知变形器网络(LMAFormer 73 73 https://github.com/lifer/LMAFormer.),首先,本地运动感知spatioporal的注意机制将多帧特征对齐并增强,以提取目标的局部spatioporal显著特征,同时抑制来自移动背景的干扰. 第二,多尺度聚变器编码器在编码过程中计算出跨度和尺度内自留量的重量,以获得不同时间图像区域之间的多尺度关联,从而能够运动背景建模. 第三,使用多帧联合查询解码器。 最浅的特征映射为初始查询权重. 在NUDT-MIRSDT,IRDST,TSIRMT数据集上的实验显示,LMAFormer提供的结果与之前的SOTA方法类似.

blocks.en: In 2024, in the context of hybrid models , Yang et al. ( 16 ) design a Feature Adaptive Transformer and CNN network (FATCNet 74 74 74 https://github.com/miliner/FATCNet ). It is a dual branch decoder structure network that employs CNN and Transformer to obtain local and global features. An attention guided adaptive fusion block integrates global and local feature information, suppress semantic gaps, and dynamically fuse features based on network learning. The network encoder incorporates the hierarchical attention module. Experiments on the BSIRST-v2 dataset show that FATCNet outperforms previous SOTA algorithms in terms of probability of detection, F1 score, and intersection over union.
blocks.zh: 2024年,在混合模型中,杨等人(16人)设计了一种特性适应变形器和CNN网络(FATCNet 74 74 74 74 https://github.com/miliner/FATCNet. 它是一个双分支的解码器结构网络,使用CNN和变形器来获得本地和全球的特色. 受引导的适应性聚变块融合了全球和地方特征信息,抑制语义差距,以及基于网络学习的动态引信特征. 网络编码器包含了分级关注模块. BSIRST-v2数据集上的实验显示,FATCNet在检测概率,F1分数,以及结合度的交叉点方面,比之前的SOTA算法都强.

blocks.en: In 2024, in the context of heteregeneous backgrounds ,Wu et al. ( 14 ) propose a a Swin Transformer and multiscale atrous spatial pyramid pooling Network (STASPPNet 75 75 75 https://github.com/hwuscut/STASPPNet ). First, A Swin-convolution (Swin-Conv) backbone enhances feature extraction Second, a Multiscale Atrous Spatial Pyramid Pooling module (MASPPM) exploits atrous convolutions and max pooling layers to enhance feature representation. Third, a Multiscale Feature Detection Fead (MFDH) allows the detection of targets with as few as a dozen pixels and enhances the performance for weak infrared targets. Experiments show that STASPPNet offers an average accuracy of 96.9 % 96.9\% for mAP50 and 49.7 % 49.7\% for mAP50-95 on the NUAA-SIRST dataset.
blocks.zh: 2024年,Wu等人(14人)在异质背景的背景下,提议建立一个Swin Transformer和多尺度的原子金字塔集合网络(STASPNet 75 75 75 https://github.com/hwuscut/STASPPNet),首先,Aswin-convolution(Swin-Conv)骨干增强特征提取第二,一个多尺度的Athrous空间金字塔集合模块(MASPPM)利用激发层和最大集合层来增强特征的体现. 第三,一个多尺度的地物探测费德(MFDH)可以探测到只有十几个像素的目标,并增强弱红外目标的表现. 实验显示,在NUAA-SIRST数据集上,STASPPNet提供的mAP50的平均精度为96.9%96.9\%,mAP50-95的平均精度为49.7%49.7\%.

blocks.en: In 2025, Hu et al. ( 596 ) provide a Dynamic Attention Transformer Network (DATransNet 76 76 76 https://github.com/greekinRoma/DATransNet ). DATransNet employs the Dynamic Attention Transformer (DATrans), simulating central difference convolutions (CDC) to extract gradient features. A Global Feature Extraction Module (GFEM) provides a comprehensive perspective to prevent the network from focusing solely on details while neglecting the global information. Experiments show that DATransNet outperforms most of the time ACM ( 37 ) , UIU-Net ( 155 ) , ALCNet ( 312 ) , AGPCNet ( 245 ) , RDIAN ( 202 ) , DNA-Net ( 53 ) and SCTransNet. Zhu et al. ( 597 ) develop a Spatial-Temporal-Channel Collaborative feature learning network (STC 77 77 77 https://github.com/UESTC-nnLab/STC ). STC consists of three distinct transformer encoders which extract spatial, temporal and channel information, respectively. Furthermore, a transformer decoder fuses the three attention features. A Semantic-Aware positional encoding method for video clips incorporates temporal information into positional encoding and is scale-invariant. Experiments show that STC outperforms SCTransNet. Liu et al. ( 321 ) propose a Semantic Token transformer Patch Spatial Attention Network (STPSA-Net). Images are represented as compact semantic tokens by a Semantic Token Transformer (STT) module. STT models spatiotemporal context to refine the original features and enhance the representation capability of small target features. The Patch Spatial Attention Module (PSAM) divides extracted features into patches and integrates spatial and semantic information to restore spatial information. Experiments on the SIRST, MFIRST, and NUDT-SIRST datasets show the STPSA-Net provides superior performance compared with previous SOTA approaches.
blocks.zh: 2025年,胡等人(596人)提供动态关注变换器网络(DATransNet 76 76s://github.com/greekin Roma/DATransNet). DATransNet使用动态关注变换器(DATrans),模拟中位差异折射(CDC)来提取梯度特征. 全球地物提取模块提供了一个全面的视角,防止网络在忽略全球信息的同时只注重细节。 实验显示,DATransNet在大部分时间里表现优于ACM(37),UIU-Net(155),ALCNet(312),AGPCNet(245),RDIAN(202),DNA-Net(53)和SCTransNet. Zhu等人(597人)开发了一个空间-时空-频道协作特征学习网络(STC 77 77 77 https://github.com/EUCC-nnLab/STC). STC由三个不同的变速器编码器组成,分别提取空间,时空和信道信息. 此外,一个变压器解码器将三个注意特征引信。 视频片段的一种语义-智能位置编码方法将时间信息纳入位置编码,具有规模-变量. 实验显示STC超越SCTransNet. 刘等. (321)提出语义Token变压器补丁空间注意网络(STPSA-Net). 图像通过一个语义Token变形器(STT)模块作为紧凑的语义符号来表示. STT模型spatiotemporal上下文,以完善原始特征,增强小目标特征的表达能力. 补丁空间注意模块(PSAM)将提取的特征分为补丁,整合空间和语义信息以恢复空间信息. 在SIRST,MFIRST和NUDT-SIRST数据集上的实验显示,与以往的SOTA方法相比,STPSA-Net提供了优异的性能.

blocks.en: In 2025, in the context of hybrid models , Li et al. ( 599 ) design an Hybrid Spatial–channel Sparse Transformer Network (HSTNet 78 78 78 https://github.com/juranccc/HSTNet ). First, a hybrid Spatial–Channel Sparse Transformer (SCST) modulesparsely models the relationship between targets and background. Second, a Multiscale Detail Enhancement (MSDE) module preserves small target details during the feature compression process. Third, a Scale-Location aware Joint (SLJ) loss improves target perception at various scales and locations. Experiments on the NUAA-SIRST, IRSTD-1k, and IRSTD-Large datasets show that HSTNet offers SOTA performance. Luo et al. ( 601 ) ) propose a 3D Spatial-Temporal knowledge aware-based Unsupervised Network (STUTD). First, a Spatial-Temporal Swin Transformer Block (ST-STB) employs a Multiscale Feature Extraction and Aggregation (MFEA) module for feature extraction. Second, a Variational Autoencoder (VAE)-style background reconstruction module with a multi-head gating mechanism allows background reconstruction. Third, a sparse cardinality selection of residuals performs element-wise filtering on the residuals between the original tensors and the reconstructed background to provide a target tensor. Experiments show that STUTD offers satisfactory overall performance and real-time performance.
blocks.zh: 2025年,在混合模型的背景下,Li等人(599人)设计了一个混合空间通道Sparse变换器网络(HSTNet 78 78 78 https://github.com/juranccc/HSTNet). 第一,混合空间-Channel Sparse变换器(SCST)模块对目标与背景的关系进行了分割模型. 第二,一个多尺度详细增强(MSDE)模块在特性压缩过程中保留小目标细节. 第三,规模-定位意识联合损失(SLJ)改善不同尺度和地点的目标感知。 NUA-SIRST,IRSTD-1k,IRSTD-Large数据集上的实验显示,HSTNet提供SOTA性能. Luo等人(601)提议建立一个基于3D空间-时空知识的无监督网络。 首先,空间-时空变换器区块(ST-STB)采用多尺度地物提取和聚合模块进行地物提取。 第二,一个具有多头齿轮机制的Variational Autoencoder(VAE)风格的背景重建模块允许背景重建. 第三,很少选择主要残留物,对原有的角质与重建的背景之间的残余物进行元素筛选,以提供一个目标角质。 实验显示STUTD提供了令人满意的整体性能和实时性能.

blocks.en:
In 2025, in the context of diverse scenarios (day/night variations, sky/maritime/ground environments) , Qian et al. ( 603 ) design a meta-learned framework named IrisNet which dynamically adapts detection strategies to the input infrared image status. A dynamic mapping is employed between infrared image features and entire decoder parameters through an image-to-decoder transformer. Second a parameterized decoder is represented as a structured 2D tensor preserving hierarchical layer correlations and allows the the transformer to model inter-layer dependencies via self-attention while providing adaptive decoding patterns through cross-attention. Third,a high-frequency components supplement target-position and scene-edge information. Experiments on the NUDT-SIRST, NUAA-SIRST, and IRSTD-1K datasets show that IrisNet outperforms SOTA algorithms (ACM ( 37 ) , ALCNet ( 312 ) , ISNet ( 73 ) , RDIAN ( 202 ) , DNA-net ( 53 ) , UIU-Net ( 155 ) , ISTDU, Dim2Clear, L2SKNet ( 214 ) ) and transformers based methods (RKformer ( 610 ) , TCI-Former, SCTransNet). Li et al. ( 13 ) propose an attention-based nested network with a bottleneck Swin Transformer (STNA-Net). A residual-attention structure incorporating serial channel and spatial attention is combined with a nested U-Net architecture. A Wavelet Down-sampling Block supersedes traditional pooling layers. A Bottleneck Swin Transformer Block processes deep feature maps, and a shifted window self-attention mechanism enhances the global feature extraction ability of the deep neural network. Experiments on the IRSTD-1k and NUDT-SIRST datasets show that BSTNA-Net outperforms
ACM ( 37 ) , ALCNet ( 312 ) , ISNet ( 73 ) , DNA-Net ( 53 ) , ISTDU-Net, UIU-Net ( 155 ) , SCTransNet ( 285 ) and HDNet. Shen et al. ( 611 ) ) propose LVNet that redefines low-level feature learning in hybrid frameworks for multi-frame IRSTD. Because a standard linear patch embeddings in Vision Transformers are insufficient to capture the scale-sensitive local features critical, a a multi-scale CNN front-end t models local features by exploiting the local spatial bias of convolution. Second, a U-shaped video Transformer for multi-frame spatiotemporal context modeling captures the motion characteristics of targets. Experiments on the IRDST and NUDT-MIRSDT datasets show that LVNet outperforms LMAFormer.
blocks.zh:
2025年,在多种情景(日/夜变化,天空/海洋/地面环境)的背景下,Qian等人. (603)设计一个名为IrisNet的元学习框架,这个框架能动态地使检测策略适应输入红外图像状态. 通过一个图像对解码器变压器,在红外线图像特征和整个解码器参数之间采用动态映射. 其次,一个参数化的解码器被代表为结构化的2D变压器,保存了层次层的关联性,并允许变压器通过自觉性来建模层间依赖性,同时通过跨自觉性来提供适应性的解码模式. 第三,a高频组件补充目标位置和场景前沿信息。 NUDT-SIRST,NUA-SIRST,以及IRSTD-1K数据集的实验显示,IrisNet在SOTA算法(ACM(37),ALCNet(312),ISNet(73),RDIAN(202),DNA-net(53),UIU-Net(155),ISTDU,Dim2Clear,L2SKNet(214))和基于变压器的方法(RKFormer(610),TCI-Former,SCTransNet)上表现优异. 李等人(13)提出以关注为主的巢网,并配有瓶颈的斯温变形器(STNA-Net). 包含串流道和空间注意力的留守结构与嵌入式U-Net结构相结合。 一个波列下采样块取代了传统的集合层. Bottleneck 变形器 块处理深层特征图,一个转动窗口自留心机制可以增强深层神经网络的全球特征提取能力. 在IRSTD-1k和NUDT-SIRST数据集上的实验显示,BSTNA-Net的性能超过
ACM(37),ALCNet(312),ISNet(73),DNA-Net(53),ISDU-Net,UIU-Net(155),SCTransNet(285)和HDNet. 沈等人(611年)提出LVNet,重新定义多框架IRSTD混合框架中的低级特征学习. 由于在Vision Transformers中嵌入的标准线性补丁不足以捕捉对尺度敏感的局部特征至关重要,所以通过利用演化的局部空间偏差,一个多尺度的CNN前端t模型局部特征. 第二,一个U形的视频变形器,用于多帧的spatiopal上下文模型,可以捕捉目标的运动特性. 在IRDST和NUDT-MIRSDT数据集上的实验显示,LVNet超越了LMAFormer.

blocks.en: In 2025, Li et al. ( 15 ) design a U-shaped segmentation network named Knowledge-Embedded CSwin-UNet (KECS-Net 79 79 79 https://github.com/Lilingxiao-image/KECS-Net ). First, KECS-Net incorporates a CSwin transformer module into the encoder of the UNet backbone allowing the extraction of multiscale features Second, a Multiscale Local Contrast Enhancement Module (MLCEM) employs hand-crafted dilated convolution operators to enhance locally salient target responses and suppress background noise. Third, a Slicing-Aided Hyper-Segmentation (SAHS) method resizes and rescales the output image. Experiments show that the proposed KECS-Net outperforms previous SOTA methods in both quantitative metrics and visual quality.
blocks.zh: 2025年,李等编著. (15) 设计一个名为Knowledge-Embeded CSwin-UNet(KECS-Net 79 79 https://github.com/Lilingxiao-image/KECS-Net)的U形分区网络,首先,KECS-Net将一个CSwin变压器模块纳入UNet主干编码器中,允许提取多尺度特性;其次,一个多尺度局部对比增强模块(MLCEM)使用手工制作的稀释转录操作器,以加强当地突出的目标反应并抑制背景噪音。 第三,一种Sliching-Aided Hyper-Segmentation(SAHS)方法对输出图像进行大小调整和缩放. 实验表明,拟议的KECS-Net在定量度量和视觉质量上都超过了以前的SOTA方法.

blocks.en: In 2026, in the context of hybrid models , Feng et al. ( 606 ) design a Global Feature Integration Mamba–Transformer Hybrid Network hybrid (GMTNet) which fuses global semantics and local details. GMTNet consists of three modules. First, a Directional State-space Transformer (DiST) module combines direction-aware long-range modeling with fine local cues. Second, a Wavelet-based Multidimensional Lossless Downsampling (WMLD) module preserves high-frequency information during resolution reduction. Thids, a DualAug module combines geometric and photometric perturbations for robustness. Experiments on the IRSTD-1K, NUAA-SIRST, and NUDT-SIRST show that GMTNet outperforms previous SOTA methods.Lin et al. ( 598 ) propose a Hybrid Network with Geometric Enhancement and Sparse Extraction (HSHNet). Jiang et al. ( 600 ) design a Cross-layer Relative Position Embedding transformer detection Network (CRPE-Net) which integrates location awareness from multiple perspectives. First, a Spatial Fine-grained Interaction Pyramid (SFIP) at the token level completes multi-scale interaction by dividing feature token groups to capture fine-grained small target information along the spatial dimension. Second, the absolute-position embeddings is replaced by a Cross Relative-Position Embeddings (CRPE) to enhance the cross-layer feature information. Third, a Multi-Head Intensive Prediction learning strategy (MHIP) enhances the detection accuracy by using multi-head detection. Experiments show that CRPE-Net outperforms ALCNet ( 312 ) , ISTDU, RDI-Net, and UIU-Net.
blocks.zh: 2026年,在混合模型背景下,冯等. (606)设计一个全球地物集成Mamba-Transformer混合网络混合体(GMTNet),将全球语义和本地细节融为一体. GMTNet包含三个模块. 首先,一个方向状态-空间变换器(DiST)模块结合了方向感知远程模型和精细的局部提示. 第二,一个基于Wavelet的多维无损降采样(WMLD)模块在解析过程中保存高频信息. Thids,一个DualAug模块结合了几何和光度扰动以达到强性. 关于IRSTD-1K,NUAA-SIRST和NUDT-SIRST的实验显示,GMTNet比之前的SOTA方法表现得更好. 林等编. (598)提议建立一个具有几何增强和Sparse Integration(HSHNet)的混合网络。 蒋等. (600)设计一个跨层相对位置嵌入式变压器检测网络(CRPE-Net),从多个角度整合位置意识. 首先,一个空间精细介面相互作用金字塔(SFIP)通过分割特征符号组,在空间维度上捕捉精细介面的小目标信息,完成多尺度交互. 其次,绝对位置嵌入被Cross相对位置嵌入(CRPE)所取代,以加强跨层特征信息. 第三,采用多头强化预测学习战略,利用多头检测,提高检测准确性。 实验表明,CRPE-Net优于ALCNet(312),ITDU,RDI-Net和UIU-Net.

blocks.en: In 2026, in the category of detection methods , Chen et al. ( 604 ) design a method based on Local adaptive perception-guided sharpening and improved RT-DETR (LCR-RTDETR) that combines adaptive sharpening preprocessing with an improved real-time detection transformer (RT-DETR). First, a Local Adaptive Perception-Guided Sharpening data augmentation strategy (LAPGS) improves feature expression quality by enhancing edge details and local contrast. Second, a Contrast-aware and value-Range-guided Self-Attention mechanism (CRSA) integrates with an Adaptive Image Feature fusion module (AIFI) to obtain the CRSA-AIFI. Third, a Relative Position-based Attention enhancement module (RPAC3) and a Context-Cross feature Fusion Module (RPAC3-CCFM) incorporating RPAC3 enhance spatial modeling and contextual expression abilities. Experiments show that LCR-RTDETR provides mAP@50 of 86.7 % 86.7\% , 88.1 % 88.1\% , and 99.5 % 99.5\% on the SIRST, IRSID-1 K, and NUDT-SIRST datasets, respectively. The parameter count and computational load are reduced by 14.4 % 14.4\% and 10.9 % 10.9\% , respectively. The inference speed on the Jetson Orin NX embedded platform is improved by 5.8 FPS, 3.4 FPS, and 5.7 FPS. Cui et al. ( 605 ) develop a cross-scale structural reconstruction detection network (EUSS-DETR) based on Real-Time Detection Transformer (RT-DETR). First, a hierarchical multi-representation adaptive module (ESM-Block) enhances structural consistency for weakly textured targets by coupling local details with deep-level semantics. Second, a Spatial Shift Modulation Unit (UCSM) establishes cross-channel directional spatial interactions to enhance weak target responses. A cross-scale Structural alignment module (Saf-Cat) mitigates structural degradation due to scale variations and edge blurring. A Dynamic Scale Aggregation Module (SC3D) integrates targets at different resolutions adaptively through scale sequence modeling. These four modules allow to model chain, spanning from structural enhancement to scale coordination. Experiments show that EUSS-DETR achieves mAP@0.5 of 90.7 % 90.7\% , 98.0 % 98.0\% , and 98.4 % 98.4\% on three public datasets.
blocks.zh: 2026年,在检测方法的类别中,陈等. (604)基于局部适应感知导磨和改良的RT-DETR(LCR-RTDETR)设计一种方法,将适应性的磨削预处理与改进的实时检测变压器(RT-DETR)相结合. 首先,通过增强边缘细节和局部对比性,一个本地适应感知-Guided Sharpening数据增强策略(LAPGS)提高了特征表达质量. 第二,一个反射和值程导自留机制(CRSA)与适应图像特性聚变模块(AIFI)结合,以获得CRSA-AIFI. 第三,一个基于相对位置的注意增强模块(RPAC3)和一个包含RPAC3的特性聚合模块(RPAC3-CCFM)增强了空间模型和背景表达能力. 实验显示,LCR-RTDETR提供mAP@50,分别为86.7%的86.7\%,88.1%的88.1\%,以及99.5%的99.5\%在SIRST,IRSID-1 K和NUDT-SIRST数据集上. 参数计算和计算负荷分别减少14.4%、14.4%和10.9%。 Jetson Orin NX嵌入式平台的推论速度由5.8 FPS,3.4 FPS,5.7 FPS改进. Cui 等 (英语). (605)开发基于实时检测变换器(RT-DETR)的跨尺度结构重建检测网络(EUSS-DETR). 首先,一个分级的多代表适应模块(ESM-Block)通过将本地细节与深层语义结合,增强了对纹理薄弱目标的结构一致性. 第二,空间移动调制股(UCSM)建立跨通道方向空间相互作用,以加强薄弱的目标反应。 跨尺度结构对接模块(Saf-Cat)减轻了规模变化和边缘模糊导致的结构退化. 一个动态缩放聚合模块(SC3D)通过缩放序列模型以适应性的方式整合不同分辨率的目标. 这四个模块可以模拟链条,从结构增强到规模协调。 实验显示,EUSS-DETR在3个公共数据集上实现了mAP@0.5的90.7%90.7\%,98.0%98.0\%,98.4%98.4\%.

blocks.en: In 2026, Hu et al. ( 607 ) design a Dual-Transformer Feature Enhancement Network (DTFE-Net) which integrates spatial and frequency domain representations. It consists of three components: a Dual-Transformer Frequency Selector (DTFS), a Spatial Feature Selector (SFS), and a Spatial-Augmented Frequency Representation (SAFR). First, DTFS uses a dual-transformer mechanism exploiting both wavelet transform and fast Fourier transform. Second, SFS extracts effective spatial features from both local and global perspectives. Third, SAFR refines the spatial–frequency representation via a fine-grained fusion to improve target discernibility. Experiments on the NUAA-SIRST, IRSTD-1K, and NUDT-SIRST datasets show that DTFE-Net provides better performance than previous algorithms.
blocks.zh: 2026年,胡等编著. (607)设计一个双变形功能增强网络(DTFE-Net),融合空间和频率域表示. 它由三个部分组成:双变频选择器(DTFS)、空间地物选择器(SFS)和空间增强频率表示器(SAFR)。 首先,DTFS采用双向转换机制,既利用波浪变换,又利用快速的傅里叶变换. 第二,SFS从当地和全球两个角度提取有效的空间特征. 第三,SAFR通过精细的聚变来完善空间-频率代表,以提高目标可辨性. 在NUA-SIRST,IRSTD-1K和NUDT-SIRST数据集上的实验显示,DTFE-Net提供比之前算法更好的性能.

blocks.en:
In 2026, to avoid the dilution of the representation of subtle local motion patterns , Zhang et al. ( 623 ) propose a Spatial-Semantic Guided Motion Perception (SGMP). First, SGMP exploits spatial features to obtain salient semantic query vectors and value maps for extracting potential semantic priors of targets. Second, SGMP employs a Transformer encoder to model long-range motion features, aligning global motion context with local semantic cues across modalities. Thus,
a lightweight and efficient detection framework (SGMP-UNet) exploits motion aware
representations for end-to-end small target detection. Experiments on the NUDT-MIRSDT, IRSDT and TSIRMT datasets show that SGMP-UNet consistently outperforms LMAFormer.
blocks.zh:
2026年,为了避免细微的局部运动模式的体现被淡化,张等. (623)提出空间语义导动感知(SGMP). 首先,SGMP利用空间特征获取显著的语义查询矢量和值图,以提取目标的潜在语义前缀. 第二,SGMP使用变形器编码器来模拟远程运动特性,使全球运动背景与跨模式的本地语义提示保持一致. 因此,
轻量级和高效探测框架(SGMP-UNet)
表示端到端小目标检测. 在NUDT-MIRSDT,IRSDT和TSIRMT数据集上的实验显示,SGMP-UNet的性能一直高于LMAFormer.

blocks.en: In the following sections, we review adversarial networks, language models and graph/hypergraph models The reader can refer to Table 2 for an overview.
blocks.zh: 在以下各节中,我们审查对抗性网络、语言模型和图/图模型。 读者可参考表2进行综述.

blocks.en: 8 Adversarial Networks
blocks.zh: 8个横向网络

blocks.en:
1. Context Adversarial Networks: In 2019, Wang et al. ( 243 ) propose a generative adversarial learning network in which the generator is divided into two subtasks: miss detection and false alarm. This method is named MDvsFA-cGAN. 2. Generative Adversarial Networks: In 2020, Zhao et al. ( 238 ) design a GAN model to learn the features of targets and directly predict the intensity of targets. More specifically, the target is recognized and reconstructed by the generator with an U-Net architecture. A five-layer discriminator allows to enhance the data-fitting capability of generator. A l 2 l_{2} loss is employed into adversarial loss for the localization. Thus, the detection problem is formulated as an image-to-image translation problem implemented by GAN. Experiments show that this method on various backgrounds and targets achieves better intersection over union (IoU) values than state-of-the-art methods.
To tackle the inadequate modeling of the dynamic degradation process, Jin et al. ( 239 ) develop a Dynamic Adversarial Enhancement Network (DAENet). First, a degradation-enhancement dynamic adversarial pretraining strategy is employed to improve the model’s adaptive capacity to nonstationary variations in thermal radiation. More specifically, this method simulates the physical degradation process of infrared imaging to inject degradation priors, and incorporates a dynamic adversarial mechanism. Second, a frequency-gradient collaborative enhancement module allows to extract frequency-domain directional texture features via the coupling of wavelet decomposition and Gabor filtering. This mechanism allows to introduce an adaptive gradient enhancement branch to reinforce spatial directional gradients and boosts the saliency of the discriminative features of weak targets. Experiments show that DAENet outperforms state-of-the-art algorithms in complex environments.
blocks.zh:
一、导 言 横向背景 网易:2019年,王等编著. (243)提出基因对抗性学习网络,将生成器分为两个子任务:误测和假警报. 这种方法命名为MDvsFA-cGAN. 2. 遗传性横向 网易:2020年,赵等. (238 )设计一个GAN模型,以学习目标的特征,并直接预测目标的强度. 更具体地说,该目标由具有U-Net架构的生成器确认并重建. 一个五层的区别对待者可以提高发电机的数据适应能力. 损失是当地化的对抗性损失。 因此,检测问题被表述为GAN实施的图像到图像翻译问题. 实验表明,这种针对不同背景和目标的方法比最先进的方法在结合值(IoU)上实现更好的交叉.
为解决动态退化过程模型化不足的问题,Jin等人, (239)开发动态横向增强网络(DAENet). 首先,采用了降解增强动态对抗性预训练战略,以提高模型适应热辐射非固定变化的能力。 更具体地说,这种方法模拟了红外线成像的物理降解过程,以注入降解前缀,并包含了动态对抗机制. 第二,一个频率渐变的协作增强模块允许通过波列分解和加波尔滤波的耦合来提取频率域定向纹理特征. 这一机制允许引入一个适应性梯度增强分支,以加强空间方向梯度,提高弱目标歧视特征的显著性。 实验显示,DAENet在复杂环境下的顶尖算法表现优于顶尖.

blocks.en: 9 Mixture-of-Experts (MoE)
blocks.zh: 9 专家混合

blocks.en: To break through single-domain learning by implementing only one universal detector simultaneously on multiple datasets, Duan et al. ( 246 ) design a cross-domain joint learning task framework with prototype-guided Mixture-of-Experts (CoMoE). More specifically, a hyperspherical prototype learning adaptively maintain both domain-specific prototypes and global prototypes improving the cross-domain feature representation. A domain-aware Mixture-of-Experts with Top- K K routing strategy allows to select the optimal domain experts. Finally, an adaptive cross-domain feature modulation with noise-guided contrastive learning is employed to enhance the cross-domain feature alignment.
blocks.zh: 为突破单域学习,在多个数据集上只同时执行一个通用探测器,Duan等人. (246)设计跨域联合学习任务框架,采用原型制导的Mixture-of-Experts(CoMoE). 更具体地说,一个超球形原型学习在适应性上维持了域特异性原型和全球原型,改善了跨域特征的体现. 具有Top-K K 路由策略的域-意识混合专家可以选择最佳域专家. 最后,采用了适应性跨域特征调制法,以噪声导对比性学习,以加强跨域特征的对齐.

blocks.en: In 2026, Du et al. ( 90 ) propose a Frequency-Adaptive Mixture-of-Experts Network (FAME-Net) which models the frequency heterogeneity of infrared scenes. First, a Cross-Frequency Mixture-of-Experts (CF-MoE) module constructs expert banks to model high-frequency structural cues and low-frequency thermal contexts. Second, a Mutual-Guided Routing strategy exploits cross-frequency information for joint expert selection. Thus, the network adaptively activates appropriate processing patterns under diverse target morphologies and background complexities. Third, a Semantic-Guided Gating (SGG) mechanism suppresses intrinsic background noise in skip connections. A Boundary-aware Contrastive (BC) loss enhances pixel-level discriminability in thermally blurred boundary regions. Experiments demonstrate that FAME-Net achieves SOTA performance in detection accuracy and boundary recovery across multiple benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 2026年,杜等编著. (90)提出一个频率可调性混合专家网络(FAME-Net),用于模拟红外线场景的频率异质性. 首先,一个跨频率混合技术(CF-MoE)模块构建了专家库,用于模拟高频结构提示和低频热环境。 第二,相互指导的游轮战略利用跨频率信息进行联合专家选择。 因此,该网络在不同的目标形态和背景复杂性下,适应性地启动适当的处理模式。 第三,一个语义引导的Gating(SGG)机制在跳过连接中抑制内在背景噪声. 在热模糊的边境地区,边界感应比对(BC)损失会增强像素水平的区别性。 实验证明,FAME-Net在探测精度和跨越多个基准的边界回收方面实现了SOTA性能.

blocks.en: 10 Language Models
blocks.zh: 10 语言模型

blocks.en: Language models allow to add contextual information via additional text in addition of the visual information provided by the infrared data obtained by the sensors.
blocks.zh: 除了传感器获得的红外线数据提供的视觉信息外,语言模型还允许通过额外文本添加背景信息.

blocks.en: 10.1 Large Language Models (LLMs)
blocks.zh: 10.1 大语言模型(LLM)

blocks.en: The previous deep neural networks methods typically rely solely on image modalities which fail to fully capture contextual information and lead to limited detection accuracy and adaptability in complex environments. To address these limitations, Zhang et al. ( 249 ) design a Segment Any Infrared Small Target (SAIST) method which employs textual information with image modalities. SAITS consists of two main parts, namely Scene Recognition Contrastive Language-Image Pretraining (SR-CLIP) and CLIP-guided Segment Anything Model (CG-SAM). First, SR-CLIP provides a set of visual descriptions through object-object similarity and object-scene relevance embedding them into learnable prompts to refine the textual description set. Second, CG-SAM employs the prompts generated by SRCLIP to guide the Mask Decoder in learning prior knowledge of background features, while incorporating infrared imaging equations to improve small target recognition in complex backgrounds and reduce the false alarm rate. Experiments show that SAIST outperforms ISNet ( 73 ) , GCINet, UIU-Net ( 155 ) , DNA-Net ( 53 ) , Dim2Clear ( 317 ) , ALCNet ( 312 ) and ACMNet on the MIRSTD dataset ( 249 ) . In a similar work, Zhang et al. ( 250 ) propose a Multimodal Vision-Language Segment Anything Model (MIRSAM). Given the differences in noise and structural information between infrared and natural images, Zhang et al. ( 250 ) adapt Segment Anything Model (SAM) by employing a Contourlet Denoising Adapter Module (CDAM). This module allows to suppress noise during feature extraction and encoding. To incorporate textual information, Zhang et al. ( 250 ) use a text encoder of Contrastive Language-Image Pre-Training (CLIP) to convert text into high-dimensional feature vectors. These vectors are employed as prompts to extract relevant details from the features. Experiments on the IR-TXPair ( 250 ) dataset show that MIRSAM outperforms MDvsFA ( 243 ) , ACM ( 37 ) , ALCNet ( 312 ) and ISNet ( 73 ) .
blocks.zh: 以往的深层神经网络方法一般只依靠图像模式,无法完全捕捉到背景信息,导致在复杂环境中检测精度和适应性有限. 为解决这些局限性,张等. (249) 设计任何红外小目标(SAIST)方法,采用带有图像模式的文字信息。 SAITS由两个主要部分组成,即场景识别对比语言-图像预训(SR-CLIP)和CLIP制导的片段任意动作模型(CG-SAM). 首先,SR-CLIP通过对象的相似性和对象空间相关性提供一组视觉描述,将它们嵌入可学习的提示中,以完善文字描述集. 第二,CG-SAM利用SRCLIP生成的提示来指导Mask解码器学习对背景特征的事先知识,同时纳入红外成像方程,以提高复杂背景中的小目标识别,降低假警报率. 实验显示,SAIST在ISNet(73),GCINet,UIU-Net(155),DNA-Net(53),Dim2Clear(317),ALCNet(312)和AMMNet在MIRSTD数据集(249)上的表现都超过了. 在类似的作品中,张等. (250) 提议采用多式联运远景-语言段(MIRSAM)。 鉴于红外线和自然图像在噪声和结构信息上的差异,Zhang等人(250人)采用Contourlet Denoising适配器模块(CDAM)来适应任何部分模型(SAM)。 这个模块允许在特性提取和编码时抑制噪音. 为了纳入文字信息,张等人(250人)使用对比语言-图像预训(CLIP)的文字编码器将文字转换成高维特性矢量. 这些矢量被用作从特征中提取相关细节的提示. 在IR-TXPair(250)数据集上的实验显示,MIRSAM的性能超过了MDvsFA(243),ACM(37),ALCNet(312)和ISNet(73).

blocks.en: In 2025, Huang et al. ( 251 ) propose a semantic text method to guide infrared small target detection (Text-IRSTD). First, a fuzzy semantic text prompt allows to accommodate ambiguous target categories. Second, a Progressive Cross-modal Semantic Interaction Decoder (PCSID) is employed to facilitate information fusion between texts and images. Experiments on the FZDT dataset ( 251 ) show Text-IRSTD achieves better detection performance and target contour recovery than DNA-Net ( 53 ) , UIU-Net ( 155 ) , RDIAN ( 202 ) , DMFNet ( 434 ) and SCTransNet ( 285 ) . In an other work, Chib and Singh ( 624 ) propose a Language-Guided attention Networks (LGNet) derived from the language prior to improve the model’s ability presenting an approach that combines textual information with image data. Using the GPT-4 vision model, Chib and Singh ( 624 ) obtain text descriptions that provide the locations of small targets employing prompt engineering to ensure accuracy.
blocks.zh: 2025年,黄 al等人(251人)提出了指导红外小目标探测的语义文字方法(Text-IRSTD). 首先,模糊的语义文字提示可以容纳模棱两可的目标类别. 第二,采用渐进式跨模式语义相互作用解码器(PCSID)来促进文本和图像之间的信息融合。 在FZDT数据集(251)上的实验显示,Text-IRSTD比DNA-Net(53),UIU-Net(155),RDIAN(202),DMFNet(434)和SCTransNet(285)更能实现检测性能和目标轮廓恢复. 在另一部作品中,Chib和Singh(624)提出了一种语言引导的注意网络(LGNet),这个网络源于语言,在提高模型的能力之前,提出了一种将文字信息与图像数据相结合的方法。 Chib和Singh(624)使用GPT-4视觉模型,获得文本描述,提供小目标的位置,使用即时工程确保准确性.

blocks.en: In 2026, Zhu et al. ( 252 ) provide a Text-guided Iterative Polymerization with Prototyping (TIPP) framework for incremental few-shot learning. TIPP exploits text features to obtain modulation factors to iteratively guide the polymerization of spatiotemporal features. Using statistical features, TIPP learn one unique prototype to identify one task. Experiments on the IRDST, DAUB ( 625 ) , and ITSDT datasets show the effectiveness and superiority of TIPP.
blocks.zh: 2026年,朱等编著. (252 )提供了一个以文字为指南的迭代多聚体化,并带有增量几弹学习的原型(TIPP)框架. TIPP利用文本特性获得调制因子,迭代地引导spatiopal特性聚合. 利用统计特征,TIPP学习了一个独特的原型来识别一个任务. 在IRDST,DAUB(625),ITST数据集上的实验显示TIPP的有效性和优越性.

blocks.en: 10.2 Vision-Language Models (VFMs)
blocks.zh: 10.2 视野语言模型

blocks.en: The conventional deep neural networks (CNNs, GANS, Tranformers) methods present the following weaknesses ( 257 ; 258 ; 259 ; 626 ) : 1. The global context and semantic modeling are insufficient because they focus on architectural modifications and local clue amplification. Thus, their ability to characterize global context and high-level semantic relationships is limited with unstable performance in the presence of complex backgrounds. 2. The trade-off between performance and efficiency is limited because they employ many parameters generating computational overhead and making them not deployable for real-time or resource-constrained scenarios. 3. They focus on the pure-vision features usually by fully-supervised learning requiring extensive high-cost manual annotations. 4. They almost have not concerned the potentials of multi-modal (e.g., vision and text) learning. 5. Spatial feature Submergence: Hierarchical backbones progressively aggregate information through deep token mixing and large effective receptive fields, leading to missed detections. 6. Temporal Appearance Ambiguity: Transformers and memory-attention-based architectures perform association by matching appearance features across frames, which is effective when objects have distinctive semantic attributes but infrared small targets are nearly textureless. 7. Motion representations have been proven to be one of the most crucial feature kinds for infrared small target detection. Conventional deep neural networks methods can only capture coarse motion representations from temporal domain. To address the limitations 1 and 2, Yu et al. ( 258 ) propose in 2025 a frozen representations from VFMs designing a Foundation-Driven Efficient Paradigm (FDEP) which adapts to existing encoder-decoder-based methods and increases accuracy. More specifically, a Semantic Alignment Modulation Fusion (SAMF) module achieves dynamic alignment and deep fusion of the global semantic priors from VFMs with task-specific features. To avoid the inference time burden, a Collaborative Optimization-based Implicit Self Distillation (CO-ISD) strategy allows implicit semantic transfer between the main and lightweight branches through parameter sharing and synchronized backpropagation. Experiments show that FDEP improves the accuracy detection of ACM ( 37 ) , ALCNet ( 312 ) , MLCL-Net ( 407 ) , ALCL-Net, DNA-Net ( 53 ) , GGL-Net, UIU-Net ( 155 ) and MSDA-Net using Holistic SIRST Evaluation (HSE) series accuracy metrics.
blocks.zh: 传统的深神经网络(CNNs,GANS,Tranformers)方法提出了以下弱点(257;258;259;626): 1. 全球背景和语义建模不足,因为它们侧重于建筑改造和当地线索放大. 因此,他们描述全球背景和高级语义关系的能力有限,在复杂的背景面前表现不稳定。 2. 业绩和效率之间的权衡有限,因为它们使用许多参数产生计算间接费用,使其不能用于实时或受资源限制的情况。 3. 它们注重纯视觉特征,通常通过全面监督的学习,需要大量高成本的人工说明。 4. 它们几乎并不涉及学习多式联运(例如愿景和文本)的潜力。 5. 空间特征分层:分层主干网通过深度信使混合和大型有效接受域逐步汇总信息,导致检测缺失. 6. 瞬间外观外观外观:变形器和基于内存的外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外 7. 事实证明,动议说明是红外小目标探测的最重要特征之一。 常规的深神经网络方法只能捕捉来自时间域的粗运动表达. 解决限制问题1和2,余等. (258) 2025年,VFM公司提出冻结的表述,设计了一个Foundation-Driven 高效参数(FDEP),适应现有的编码器-解码器方法,提高准确性. 更具体地说,一个语义调和模组(SAMF)模块实现了具有任务特定特征的VFM全球语义前缀的动态调和和深聚. 为了避免推论时间负担,一种基于协作优化的隐形自我消化(CO-ISD)策略允许主分支和轻量级分支之间通过参数共享和同步反扩散进行隐含语义转移. 实验表明,FDEEP改进了对ACM(37),ALCNet(312),MLCL-Net(407),ALCL-Net,DNA-Net(53),GGL-Net,UIU-Net(155)和MSDA-Net的精度检测,使用全SIRST评价(HSE)系列精度测量.
