blocks.zh: 事实证明,移动表示是红外小目标探测中最重要的特征类型之一。 常规的深神经网络方法只能捕捉来自时间域的粗运动表达.

blocks.en: In 2026, Duan et al. ( 257 ) adresses the limitations 3 and 4 by designing a semi-supervised vision-language (SeViL) framework with adaptive text prompt guiding. SeViL takes text prompts as prior knowledge to adaptively enhance target regions and then filter the low-quality pseudo-labels generated on unlabeled data. An adaptive cross-modal masking strategy allows to align text and vision features, promoting cross-modal deep interactions. Experiments on three public datasets namely DAUB ( 625 ) , ITSDT-15K and IRDST show that SeViL outperforms other semi-supervised methods and similar performance to fully-supervised methods, with 10 % 10\% labeled training samples.
blocks.zh: 2026年,Duan等人(257 )通过设计一个具有适应性文本即时引导的半监督视觉语言(SeViL)框架,对限制3和4做出了规定. SeViL将文本提示作为前期知识,以适应性增强目标区域,然后过滤在无标签数据上产生的低质量伪标签. 适应性的跨模式遮盖战略可以使文本和愿景特征保持一致,促进跨模式的深度互动。 对DAUB(625),ITSDT-15K和IRDST三个公共数据集的实验显示,SEViL比其他半监督方法及类似性能达到全监督方法,10%的标注培训样本.

blocks.en: To address the challenges 5 and 6, Xu et al. ( 259 ) design a Spatiotemporal Physics-Informed Representation for Infrared Targets (SPIRIT) framework that adapts semantics-oriented VFMs to IRSTD by employing physically constraints into feature representation and attention modules. These modules are lightweight plugins that are integrated into different VFM backbones with minimal changes. More specifically, Xu et al. ( 259 ) employ a Physics-Informed Feature Refinement (PIFR) that is used as a differentiable physical filter inside the encoder for the spatial aspect. PIFR approximates rank-sparsity decomposition in the feature domain, suppressing low-rank background components and enhancing sparse target-like responses. For temporal aspect, a Prior Guided Memory Attention (PGMA) mechanism injects a feasibility prior into memory cross-attention. SPIRIT operates in both single-frame and video cases. When temporal information is unavailable, SPIRIT is reduced to a spatial detector making it flexible for deployment under dynamic operational requirements. Experiments show that SPIRIT outperforms ACM ( 37 ) , AGPCNet ( 245 ) , DNA-Net ( 53 ) and UIU-Net ( 155 ) .
blocks.zh: 应对挑战5和6,徐等人. (259) 设计一个Spatiotemporal Physics-Informed Presentation for Infred targets(SPIRIT)框架,通过将物理约束用于特征表达和注意力模块,使面向语义的VFM适应IRSTD. 这些模块是轻量级插件,被集成到不同的VFM主干线中,变化最小. 更具体地说,徐等人. (259)使用物理-成形特性精度(PIFR),在编码器内部用作空间方面的不同物理滤波器. PIFR在特征域中大致分级分解,压制低级背景成分,增强零散的目标类反应. 对于时间方面,一个Performed Guided内存注意(PGMA)机制在内存交叉注意之前注入了一种可行性. SPIRIT既适用于单一框架,也适用于视频。 在没有时间信息的情况下,SPIRIT被缩小为空间探测器,使其在动态操作要求下灵活部署。 实验表明,SPIRIT的绩效超过了ACM(37),AGPCNet(245),DNA-Net(53)和UIU-Net(155).

blocks.en: To address the limitation 7, Shen et al. ( 255 ) design a vision-language framework with Motion Prior Knowledge Learning (MoPKL 80 80 80 https://github.com/UESTC-nnLab/MoPKL ) which uses homogeneous language descriptions, formatted for moving targets, to directionally guide vision channel learning motion prior knowledge. The motion of infrared small targets is refined by graph attention to obtain more fine motion representations. Experiments on ITSDT-15K and IRDST datasets show that MoPKL outperforms several previous algorithms. In a further work, Shen et al. ( 256 ) develop an an improved version of MoPKL named iMoPKL which also uses homogeneous language descriptions to directionally guide vision channels to learn the motion prior knowledge of targets. First, iMoPKL learns the distribution of target motion reconstruction corresponding to the language description as a type of prior knowledge. Second, the motion of infrared small targets is refined by motion-relation learning to obtain more fine motion representations. Experiments on ITSDT-15K, DAUB-R, and IRDST-H datasets show that iMoPKL outperforms MoPKL.
blocks.zh: 解决限制7,沈等. (255) 设计一个带有Motion Prior Knowledge learning(MoPKL 80 80 https://github.com/UTEC-nnLab/MoPKL)的视觉语言框架,使用统一语言描述,格式化为移动目标,以方向引导视觉通道学习运动前知识. 红外小目标的运动通过图式的注意来细化,以获得更多的精细的运动表现. 在ITSTDT-15K和IRDST数据集上的实验显示,MOPKL超越了之前的几个算法. 在进一步的工作方面,沈等. (256)开发一个名为iMoPKL的MoPKL的改进版,它也使用同质语言描述来定向引导视觉通道,以学习运动对目标的先知. 首先,iMoPKL学习与语言描述相对应的目标运动重建的分布,作为一类前知. 其次,红外小目标的运动通过运动关系学习得到更精细的运动表现来完善. ITSTT-15K,DAUB-R,以及IRDST-H数据集上的实验显示,iMoPKL超越了MOPKL.

blocks.en: 11 Graph/Hypergraph Learning Methods
blocks.zh: 11 图/历史学习方法

blocks.en: 11.1 Preliminaries
blocks.zh: 11.1 初步情况

blocks.en: Graph Neural Networks 81 81 81 https://sites.google.com/view/gsp-website/graph-neural-networks/graph-neural-networks ( 627 ) is a deep learning method that takes graph data as input. Graph Neural Networks can be divided into Convolutional Graph Neural Networks, Recurrent Graph Neural Networks, Graph Auto-Encoders, and Spatial-Temporal Graph Neural Networks. Convolutional. Graph Neural Networks can be decomposed into two branches: Spectral-based GNNs where graph spectral theory was applied to learn node representations, and spatial-based GNNs based on local-dependence assumption of graph structured data that graph convolution is defined in the spatial domain as aggregating and transforming local information. Thus, spectral-based GNNs extends classical signal processing to graph data, designing graph filters in the frequency domain by borrowing from graph signal analysis, and realizing graph convolution whereas spatial-based GNNs describe the pairwise relations between objects. Transductive and inductive learning schemes are possible ( 1 ) . Transductive learning involves making predictions on partially labeled datasets, using the structure of the data to predict the remaining unlabeled instances. Moreover, transductive learning does not have a clear distinction between the training and testing phases, as it leverages both labeled and unlabeled data simultaneously. Inductive learning involves training machine learning models on labeled datasets to make predictions on new unseen data. This approach has been widely applied in tasks such as image classification, object detection, and semantic segmentation ( 628 ) .
blocks.zh: 图神经网络 81 81 81 https://sites.google.com/view/gsp-website/graph-neural-networks/graph-neural-networks(627)是一种将图表数据作为输入的深度学习方法. 图形神经网络可以分为革命图形神经网络,经常性图形神经网络,图形自动编码器,以及空间-临时图形神经网络. 革命论. 图形神经 网络可以分解为两个分支:以Spectral为基础的GNNs,其中应用了图谱理论来学习节点表达法;以基于对图结构化数据的局部依赖性假设为基础的空间GNNs,在空间域中将图演化定义为集合和转化局部信息. 因此,基于光谱的GNNs将古典信号处理延伸至图数据,通过从图信号分析中借阅来设计频率域中的图滤波器,实现图演化,而基于空间的GNNs则描述物体之间的对等关系. 转导和导引的学习计划是可能的(1). 转录学习涉及对部分标注的数据集进行预测,利用数据结构来预测剩余的未标注实例. 此外,转录学习在培训和测试阶段之间没有明显的区别,因为它同时利用标注和未标注的数据。 入门学习涉及在贴有标签的数据集上培训机器学习模型,以便对新的无形数据作出预测。 这种方法被广泛应用于图像分类,对象检测,语义分解(628)等任务中.

blocks.en: Although GNNs show excellent performance in handling graph data, the potential higher-order relations among objects will be lost if there are simply represented by a graph. Hypergraph Neural Networks 82 82 82 https://sites.google.com/view/gsp-website/graph-neural-networks/hypergraph-neural-networks ( 629 ) is recognized as a flexible modeling tool for complex and higher-order data, including a vertex set and a hyperedge set. Objects are considered vertices, multiple vertices are connected to form a hyperedge representing higher-order relations. Graph representation and learning has been recently employed in infrared small target detection.
blocks.zh: 尽管GNNs在处理图表数据方面表现出了出色的性能,但如果仅用一个图表来表示,对象之间潜在的更高排序关系就会丢失. 超图神经网络 82 82 82 https://sites.google.com/view/gsp-website/graph-neural-networks/hypergraph-neural-networks(629)被公认为是用于复杂和更高顺序数据的灵活的建模工具,包括一个顶点集和一个超尖点集. 物体被认为是顶点,多个顶点被连接,形成一个代表高阶关系的超顶点. 最近,在红外小目标探测中采用了图示和学习方法。

blocks.en: 11.2 Application to Infrared Small Target Detection
blocks.zh: 11.2 红外小目标探测应用

blocks.en: In literature, there are only two key works using graph representation and learning: 1. Graph Learning: In 2024, Zheng et al. ( 630 ) design a Cycle Shift Vision Graph Convolution Network (CS-ViG-UNet 83 83 83 https://linaom1214.github.io/CSViG-UNet ) which uses a cyclic shift sparse graph attention mechanism to solve the issue of reduced expressive power. The CS-ViG module constructs an effective graph structure using image patches to capture feature information relevant to target recognition. Experiments on the SIRST AUG and IRSTD-1K show that CS-ViG-UNet provides F1 scores of 0.8561 and 0.745, respectively. On the RTX3090 with TensorRT acceleration, CS-ViG-UNet process approximately 357 images of size 256 × 256 ​ p ​ i ​ x ​ e ​ l ​ s 256\times 256pixels per second. In 2025, Shen et al. ( 263 ) were the first authors to propose a graph learning approach for infrared small target detection. More specifically, a Graph-based Context Learning Network (GCLNet) integrates a global graph reasoning with local feature learning to perceive context information across multiple scales. To this end, local feature learning blocks are embedded into the encoder to extract detailed textures. At deep layers, the multiple graph reasoning module employs a multi-graph interaction structure to encourage information transfer, allowing for the optimization of global context learning. Then, the patch-based graph reasoning module divides the low-level features into multiple patches where the context information is explored to capture the saliency of small targets. Experiments show that that GCLNet outperforms the state-of-the-art methods, achieving the intersection over union (IoU) of 80.26 % 80.26\% and 94.84 % 94.84\% on the NUAA-SIRST and NUDT-SIRST datasets, respectively. 2. Hypergraph Learning: In 2026, Qi et al. ( 105 ) design HyperTea which integrates global and local temporal perspectives to model high-order spatiotemporal correlations of features. HyperTea comprises three modules: the Global Temporal Enhancement Module (GTEM) which realizes global temporal context enhancement via semantic aggregation and propagation, and the Local Temporal Enhancement Module (LTEM) which capture local motion patterns between adjacent frames. In addition, a Temporal Alignment Module (TAM) tackle potential cross-scale feature misalignment. HyperTea is the first work in which CNNs, RNNs, and hypergraph neural networks (HGNNs) are integrated for MIRSTD. Experiments on DAUB and IRDST datasets show that HyperTea outperforms ISNet ( 73 ) , RPCANet and SSTNet ( 152 ) .
blocks.zh: 在文学中,只有两部关键作品使用图表达和学习: 1. 图学习: 2024年,郑等人(630年)设计了循环移位图图集网络(CS-ViG-UNet 83 83 https://linaom1214.github.io/CSViG-UNet),使用循环移位图稀疏的图集关注机制来解决表达力下降的问题. CS-ViG模块利用图像补丁构建有效的图表结构,以获取与目标识别相关的特征信息. 在SIRST AUG和IRSTD-1K上的实验显示,CS-ViG-UNet分别提供了0.8561和0.745的F1分数. 在TensorRT加速度的RTX3090上,CS-ViG-UNet处理大约357幅大小256×256p i x e l s 256\times每秒256像素的图像. 2025年,沈等人(263人)率先提出红外小目标探测的图学学习方法. 更具体地说,一个基于图表的背景学习网络(GCLNet)将一个全局的图表推理与局部特征学习结合起来,以在多个尺度上看到背景信息. 为此,将本地特性学习块嵌入编码器中,以提取详细的纹理. 在深层,多图推理模块采用多图交互结构来鼓励信息传输,从而可以优化全球背景学习. 随后,基于补丁的图表推理模块将低级特征分为多个补丁,其中对上下文信息进行探索,以捕捉小目标的显著性. 实验表明,GCLNet超越了最先进的方法,在NUA-SIRST和NUDT-SIRST数据集上分别实现了80.26%80.26%和94.84%94.84%的结合(IoU)的交叉. 2. Hypergraph Learning:2026年,齐等. (105) 设计HyperTea,将全球和地方时间视角结合起来,模拟地物的高序瞬间关联。 HyperTea包含三个模块:通过语义聚合和传播实现全球时间背景增强的全球时间增强模块(GTEM)和捕捉相邻框架之间局部运动模式的本地时间增强模块(LTEM)。 此外,一个临时调整模块(TAM)处理潜在的跨尺度特征错配问题。 HyperTea是CNN,RNN和超图神经网络(HGNNs)为MIRSTD集成的第一部作品. 关于DAUB和IRDST数据集的实验表明,HyperTea的绩效超过了ISNet(73),RPCANet和SSTNet(152).

CS-ViG模块利用图像补丁构建有效的图表结构,以获取与目标识别相关的特征信息. 在SIRST AUG和IRSTD-1K上的实验显示,CS-ViG-UNet分别提供了0.8561和0.745的F1分数. 在TensorRT加速度的RTX3090上,CS-ViG-UNet处理大约357幅大小256×256p i x e l s 256\times每秒256像素的图像. 2025年,沈等人(263人)率先提出红外小目标探测的图学学习方法. 更具体地说,一个基于图表的背景学习网络(GCLNet)将一个全局的图表推理与局部特征学习结合起来,以在多个尺度上看到背景信息. 为此,将本地特性学习块嵌入编码器中,以提取详细的纹理. 在深层,多图推理模块采用多图交互结构来鼓励信息传输,从而可以优化全球背景学习. 随后,基于补丁的图表推理模块将低级特征分为多个补丁,其中对上下文信息进行探索,以捕捉小目标的显著性. 实验表明,GCLNet超越了最先进的方法,在NUA-SIRST和NUDT-SIRST数据集上分别实现了80.26%80.26%和94.84%94.84%的结合(IoU)的交叉.

blocks.en: Hypergraph Learning: In 2026, Qi et al. ( 105 ) design HyperTea which integrates global and local temporal perspectives to model high-order spatiotemporal correlations of features. HyperTea comprises three modules: the Global Temporal Enhancement Module (GTEM) which realizes global temporal context enhancement via semantic aggregation and propagation, and the Local Temporal Enhancement Module (LTEM) which capture local motion patterns between adjacent frames. In addition, a Temporal Alignment Module (TAM) tackle potential cross-scale feature misalignment. HyperTea is the first work in which CNNs, RNNs, and hypergraph neural networks (HGNNs) are integrated for MIRSTD. Experiments on DAUB and IRDST datasets show that HyperTea outperforms ISNet ( 73 ) , RPCANet and SSTNet ( 152 ) .

blocks.en: 13 Prospective Research
blocks.zh: 13 展望研究

blocks.en: We first provide an analysis of the current methods and evaluation protocols. Second, we review the current solved and unsolved challenges. Third, we provide theoretical perspectives for each category of methods.
blocks.zh: 我们首先对现行方法和评价规程进行分析。 第二,我们回顾目前已经解决和尚未解决的挑战。 第三,我们为每一类方法提供理论观点。

blocks.en: 13.1 Analysis of Current Methods
blocks.zh: 13.1 对现行方法的分析

blocks.en:
Deep neural network based methods have significantly increased the performance of small target detection by automatically extracting features from large
datasets. Compared to conventional unsupervised methods, they handle complex images better through multilayer feature extraction improving accuracy. However, they present the following weaknesses both in sparse and dense scenes: 1. They require large annotated datasets increasing data collection costs. 2. In small target detection, critical semantic information may be lost. 3. Their high computational complexity limits their deployability by requiring powerful hardware. Even if deep learning methods (i.e data-driven methods) excel in many cases, its reliance on data and resources remains a challenge in the presence of unseen data. In contrast, conventional unsupervised methods (i.e model-driven methods) though less effective in complex scenes, offer robustness, interpretability, and efficiency in resource-limited settings. However, both model-driven and data-driven methods face limitations due to the lack of temporal information in single-frame detection, making it difficult to ensure high detection accuracy.
blocks.zh:
基于神经网络的深层方法通过自动提取大型的特性,大大提高了小目标探测的性能.

blocks.en: 13.2 Evaluation Protocols
blocks.zh: 13.2 评价议定书

blocks.en: About the conventional evaluation protocols, several weaknesses appear to have a fair evaluation and comparison for ranking. First, they rely on fragmented pixel- and target-level specific metrics and thus they fail to provide a comprehensive view of model capabilities. Second, the emphasis on overall performance scores do not allow a precise error analysis required to identify failure modes and improve real-world system performance. Third, the employed dataset are dataset-specific training-testing paradigm and to no allow the understanding of model robustness and generalization across diverse infrared scenarios.
blocks.zh: 关于传统评价协议,一些弱点似乎对排名有公平的评价和比较。 首先,它们依靠零散的像素和目标级的具体度量衡,因此无法提供模型能力的全景. 其次,由于强调总体性能分数,无法进行精确的错误分析,以识别故障模式,改善现实世界的系统性能。 第三,所使用的数据集是针对数据集的培训测试范式,不允许理解模型的稳健性和各种红外情景的概括性。

blocks.en: 13.3 Prospective Solutions
blocks.zh: 13.3 前景解决办法

blocks.en: Solved and unsolved challenges can be investigated either according to single-frame/multi-frame detection and to sparse/dense targets detection and are reviewed in the paper titled "Unsupervised and Supervised Approaches for Infrared Small Target Detection : Overview, Challenges and Perspectives (Part 2)". Here, we present perspectives for deep neural networks supervised models.
blocks.zh: 解决和未解决的挑战可以按照单帧/多帧探测和稀疏/密集目标探测来调查,并在题为“红外小目标探测的未经监督和监督的方法:概览、挑战和观点(第二部分)”的文件中加以审查。 在这里,我们提出了深层神经网络 监督模型的前景。

blocks.en: 13.3.1 Perspectives for Researcher Solutions
blocks.zh: 13.3.1 研究人员解决方案的前景

blocks.en:
Prospective solutions to handle the unsolved challenges can be the use of recent graph-based learning methods requiring less labeled data, different learning strategies and hypergrah methods: 1. Graph Learning: Graph learning is a deep learning method that takes graph data as input. Graph neural networks have demonstrated valuable performance in the close research field of moving object detection in video surveillance in the presence of challenging environments ( 631 ; 632 ) . 2. Transductive/Inductive Learning: The existing deep learning based methods employed in infrared small target detection employed a transductive learning scheme. This scheme involves making predictions on partially labeled datasets, using the structure of the data to predict the remaining unlabeled instances. In addition, transductive learning does not have a clear distinction between the training and testing phases, as it leverages both labeled and unlabeled data simultaneously. In contrast, the
inductive learning scheme is a paradigm that involves training machine learning models on labeled datasets to make predictions on new unseen data. This approach has been widely applied in tasks such as image classification, moving object detection ( 633 ) , and semantic segmentation. Thus, inductive learning is more robust in the presence of unseen cases ( 634 ) . 3. Contrastive Graph Learning : Self-supervised learning is a key method for training deep learning models when labeled data is scarce or unavailable. While graph machine learning holds great promise across various domains, the design of effective pretext tasks for self-supervised graph representation learning is challenging. Contrastive learning, a popular approach in graph self-supervised learning, leverages positive and negative pairs to compute a contrastive loss function. Current graph contrastive learning methods often attempt to fully use structural patterns and node similarities and have been applied with success in moving object detection ( 635 ) . In 2026, Liao and Yin ( 483 ) propose a Contrastive-aided Distractor Discriminator (CaDD). The aim is to enforce adaptive similarity computation both locally and globally between the real targets and the backgrounds. This approach allows the authors to more precisely discriminate distractors, so as to reduce the false alarm rate. 4. Hypergraph Learning: Although GNNs show excellent performance in handling graph data, the potential higher-order relations among objects will be lost if there are simply represented by a graph. Hypergraph Neural Networks recognized as a flexible modeling tool for complex and higher-order data, including a vertex set and a hyperedge set. Objects are considered vertices, multiple vertices are connected to form a hyperedge representing higher-order relations.
blocks.zh:
处理尚未解决的挑战的前瞻性解决办法可以是使用最近的基于图表的学习方法,这些方法需要较少的标签数据、不同的学习策略和超格拉方法: 1. 图学习: 图形学习是一种以图形数据为输入的深层学习方法. 图表神经网络在有挑战性环境(631;632)的情况下,在视频监视中移动物体探测的近距离研究领域展现了宝贵的表现. 2. 转换/诱导学习: 红外小目标探测中使用的现有深层学习方法采用了转录学习计划。 这个方案涉及对部分标注的数据集进行预测,利用数据结构来预测剩余的未标注的实例. 此外,转录学习在培训和测试阶段之间没有明显的区别,因为它同时利用标注和未标注的数据。 相反,
诱导性学习计划是一种范式,它涉及对贴有标签的数据集的机器学习模型进行培训,以便对新的无形数据作出预测。 这种方法被广泛应用于图像分类,移动对象检测(633),语义分割等任务中. 因此,在隐形病例(634)面前,诱导性学习更为有力。 3. 对照图学习:自我监督的学习是培训深层学习模型的关键方法,因为贴有标签的数据很少或没有。 虽然图表机器学习在各个领域都有很大希望,但设计自我监督的图表表现学习的有效借口任务却具有挑战性。 对比性学习(Contrastic learning),是图中自我监督的学习的一种流行方法,利用正负对来计算一个对比性损失函数. 目前的图对比性学习方法往往试图充分利用结构模式和节点相似性,并在移动对象检测(635 )中成功应用. 2026年,廖和殷(483人)提出"矛盾助力的干扰者歧视者"(CaDD). 目的是在实际目标和背景之间,在地方和全球范围实行适应性相似的计算。 这种做法使作者能够更准确地区分分心者,从而降低虚假的警报率. 4. 超图学习: 尽管GNNs在处理图表数据方面表现出了出色的性能,但如果仅用一个图表来表示,对象之间潜在的更高排序关系就会丢失. Hypergraph神经网络被认为是一个用于复杂和更高顺序数据的灵活的建模工具,包括一个顶点集和一个超尖端集. 物体被认为是顶点,多个顶点被连接,形成一个代表高阶关系的超顶点.

blocks.en: 14 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 14 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we have firstly presented a full review about infrared small target detection by covering 30 years of research. In this context, we categorized the deep neural networks supervised models. For each categories, the methods have been surveyed in a rationale and historical manner with the corresponding first works, the similar research, their variants/improvements and their last developments. Moreover, we have presented the specific metrics and the ranking protocols employed for performance evaluation. Finally, we provide theoretical perspectives as well as AI-assisted research solutions.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们首先对红外小目标探测进行了全面的回顾,涵盖了30年的研究. 在这方面,我们分类了受监管的深层神经网络模型。 对每一类方法都以理由和历史方式进行了调查,调查了相应的第一批著作、类似的研究、其变种/改进及其最后的发展。 此外,我们介绍了用于业绩评估的具体衡量尺度和排名协议。 最后,我们提供了理论观点以及AI协助的研究解决方案。
